rites.name: Tesia Telaulium
rites.text: A passive instinct that lets each blow of a strike spill over onto one more foe standing close by. It is a craft of raw, clan-born ferocity.

rites.name: Nuallaena
rites.text: Nuallaena is the concept of the first sounding in Ameosastia, the note by which the roots of the world condense out of undifferentiated hum. It is not a being but the principle that makes condensation possible, present wherever a resonance first settles into form.

rites.name: Drarne
rites.text: Drarne is the concept of resonance that binds the first roots of Ameosastia as they condense out of the Singing. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is invoked as the pattern by which heat and sound take shape.

rites.name: Coreontor
rites.text: A simple inherent craft that lets a bearer turn aside some blows when holding a guard. It works quietly in the background of every struggle.

rites.name: Valianorum
rites.text: A basic inborn talent that quietly strengthens the bearer against frost and chill. It requires no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Oraniarnium
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens a fighter's blade strikes against swords, making each cut hit harder and making foes less likely to parry.

rites.name: Valanum Coriaraunia
rites.text: A basic, ever-active discipline that lets a warrior raise a shield more often to turn aside blows. It also speeds the warrior's recovery after each guarded strike.

rites.name: Telaures Serontus
rites.text: A quiet, lasting knack that lets a bearer strike faster with rod-like weapons and gives them a bit more protection against harm.

rites.name: Telosiror
rites.text: A spell that raises a band of bone-bodied fighters who stand as loyal allies beside the caster. The fighters answer only the one who called them.

rites.name: Maullium Valoliarnus
rites.text: A minor hand-bound incantation that hurls green blade-shaped bolts which leap from foe to foe in every direction. It is the humblest of a graded set of gauntlet charms.

rites.name: Osyuzeth
rites.text: Osyuzeth is a concept in Ameosastia, the principle that a sworn word can hold a door shut between worlds for as long as it is kept. It was first named in the Courts during the councils that set the doors of the first sovereign's age, and groves still grow where its oaths were written.

rites.name: Lyamiel
rites.text: Lyamiel is the concept of a binding oath sworn over living groves, a principle that the Courts of Ameosastia hold as the seed of every lasting promise. It was named in the Age of the first sovereign, when groves were the first measure of a kingdom's reach.

rites.name: Valaurus
rites.text: A quiet, innate discipline that lets a wielder of cleaving blades strike harder and swing faster. It is learned through repetition rather than ritual.

rites.name: Raurniallus
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that sharpens the strikes of clawed hands, making each blow hit harder and find its mark more reliably.

rites.name: Seriresium
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that lets a caster scatter a lingering current of quickened motion where they stand. These currents refuse to pile atop one another, so the quickening never grows beyond a modest ceiling, and whether this limit was ever meant remains unsettled.

rites.name: Vaunus
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that lets a caster's spells strike harder, cast faster, and restore their inner reserves more quickly.

rites.name: Serium
rites.text: A quiet practice that lets a wielder of small blades strike harder with toxins. Blows that land true carry a greater chance to seed lingering venom that festers longer.

rites.name: Seraurosium
rites.text: A trained discipline of the battle-hardened guardian that hardens the body against blows and dodging strikes. It also sharpens the practitioner's strength and wounding power when striking with a handheld blade or club.

rites.name: Mellauria
rites.text: A quiet discipline taught to archers that sharpens the odds of a decisive, devastating shot. When the bow is drawn well, each strike lands harder than an ordinary arrow would.

rites.name: Mosor
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens the hand of a fighter armed with hooked talon, short blade or long edge, letting strikes find vital points more often.

rites.name: Oraulostor
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a guardian spirit shrug off flame, while an aura around it leaves foes more vulnerable to blows and burns and weakens their own strikes.

rites.name: Niantia
rites.text: A binding charm that lets a cast spell ignite whenever the bearer slays a foe with a close-quarters strike. It only answers blows dealt by hand or blade, not by distant magic.

rites.name: Cillesor
rites.text: A ritual working that tears open a ring of force, dealing bodily harm to all nearby. It sets off any lingering shards left upon the ground and any blades summoned by the caster, and when paired with a whirling spiral it consumes every charge of that spiral at once, forming a widening ring around the caster.

rites.name: Meornes
rites.text: A temple-bound discipline that lets a devoted caster hold more gathered force and steadier reserves of endurance. It is taught to those who serve the highest ranks of a sacred order.

rites.name: Liasantium
rites.text: A sacred invocation that calls forth an alternate skill effect for a bearer's craft. It was once sealed within a chance-based relic chest of divine and infernal origin.

rites.name: Caulornes
rites.text: A surge of heightened vigor that quickens a bearer's strikes, steps, and spellcasting while softening the force of incoming blows. It fades as the surge passes.

rites.name: Valoneolium
rites.text: A linked charm that intensifies the searing harm of the skills it is paired with. It amplifies the lasting heat that clings to victims.

rites.name: Testirnium
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that sharpens a fighter's killing strikes when armed with clawed weapons. Its practitioners sometimes leave foes dazzled and stumbling after a decisive blow.

rites.name: Soriasum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that stores a surge of gathered force each time its bearer ends a foe's life. The stored force can be drawn upon as strength, swiftness, or stamina.

rites.name: Amaullium
rites.text: A held close-combat technique where the wielder strikes rapidly at a shifting foe ahead, cutting nearby foes too. Releasing it unleashes additional strikes scaled to how long it was sustained.

rites.name: Resaulium
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that enlarges a bearer's vital reserve and lets every strike mend them from the harm it causes.

rites.name: Vinia
rites.text: A basic innate discipline that quickens the strikes of a fighter's clawed limbs and deepens the harm each blow inflicts.

rites.name: Corenia
rites.text: A tainted sickness seeps into a creature and slowly wears away its body over time. It is not the same as an open wound that simply drains a little life each moment.

rites.name: Veoranum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that sharpens a bearer's nimbleness and deftness of limb. It works without any effort or conscious call from the one who carries it.

rites.name: Lanialor
rites.text: A quiet, innate knack that lets its bearer sidestep incoming blows more often than others, requiring no conscious effort to keep working.

rites.name: Tillum
rites.text: A disciplined fighting craft taught to elite warriors of an order. It grants a practitioner greater ability to dodge blows, sturdier protection, and harder strikes.

rites.name: Serillus Teleontus
rites.text: A soothing glow that spreads outward from a caster, restoring the inner energy of nearby companions as well as its wielder.

rites.name: Milia
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a practitioner's strikes harm wounded foes more fiercely. Open wounds on enemies also ache sooner and more sharply, while the practitioner suffers less from them.

rites.name: Serianes
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that hardens the body against blows and grants steadier defenses against fire, frost, and lightning. Practitioners learn it early and keep it as a constant, unseen guard.

rites.name: Mornenus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that raises how much vitality a bearer can hold. It also strengthens the body and lets the bearer draw renewed life from each foe felled.

rites.name: Talus
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets a wielder of heavy clubs and ceremonial staves strike harder and faster with greater aim. It also quickens their steps after a foe has recently been struck, and strengthens lingering afflictions dealt with these weapons.

rites.name: Causium
rites.text: A bound craft that slows nearby foes each moment and weaves a sticky snare around them, so that they suffer greater harm from every blow. It can be stitched into worn gear by a careful artisan working from a night-beast's recipe.

rites.name: Coriarnia
rites.text: A minor lasting gift of swiftness and guarding, granted to those who walk a chosen calling. It is a small, steady talent rather than a great power.

rites.name: Coraulles
rites.text: A lingering affliction that dims a bearer's aim and weakens their ability to dodge. Its effect lowers both measures by a fifth.

rites.name: Ventia
rites.text: A basic innate craft that quickens the strikes of a wielder handling blades and hatchets. It grants faster swings whenever such edged weapons are held.

rites.name: Varisor
rites.text: A trained gift passed between smiths of the old forges that sharpens the force and precision of a wielder's heavy crushing blows. It makes strikes with blunt iron tools hit harder and more often find a fatal opening.

rites.name: Oraulleonor
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lets a wielder strike harder whenever drawing a curved wooden launcher. It needs no ritual, only steady hands and practice.

rites.name: Serallanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wielder of heavy chopping weapons strike harder, and recover a portion of their vitality from each blow that lands.

rites.name: Riantanum
rites.text: A tradition that lets a practitioner pay for their workings with their own vitality rather than with reserved inner energy. Those who follow it keep no reserve at all.

rites.name: Vilases
rites.text: A learned discipline that hardens a wearer's protective layers and sharpens their ability to slip past blows. It also lends resistance against the raw forces of the elements.

rites.name: Siarornum
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lets a steady glow of influence spread wider around its bearer. It is learned early and needs no conscious effort to keep.

rites.name: Amiroles
rites.text: A ranged craft that looses every missile a bowman or caster carries in a rapid, unbroken sequence. Each shot follows the last in quick succession, turning a single draw into a storm of arrows.

rites.name: Merasum
rites.text: A ritual rite in which the dead are consumed to bind a protective ward onto one's servants. For a short while they can turn aside blows and spells, and each turned blow restores their vigor.

rites.name: Noliantor
rites.text: A basic passive discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes made with hooked talons and lets their blows sometimes leave lingering venom in the foe.

rites.name: Amiantia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a warrior's strikes carry searing flame. Burning afflictions also tear at their victims more swiftly, feeding a steady heat that grows with practice.

rites.name: Taustium
rites.text: A sanctified ward that a guardian can call upon to grow briefly unshakeable against blows. Those standing close enough share in its steadiness, and recent strikes or spells let them turn aside more harm.

rites.name: Moria
rites.text: A channelled curse that slowly festers corruption through every foe gathered before its caster. The longer the caster holds it, the deeper the rot spreads.

rites.name: Celium
rites.text: A sacred discipline that renders its bearer untouchable by corrupting storms, yet reduces their bodily vitality to a single spark. They must live wholly upon a shimmering barrier of woven light.

rites.name: Sentanum
rites.text: A quiet, trained steadiness of hand that sharpens the aim of anyone who draws a longbow. It is taught gradually and rewards patient practice.

rites.name: Sonelles
rites.text: A temple discipline that lets a wielder of heavy blunt weapons strike harder and faster. Each blow drains a little vitality back into the striker.

rites.name: Viaranum
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the body against blows and sharpens its ability to slip past strikes. It also grants a measure of protection against the forces of the elements.

rites.name: Veosium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a practitioner's strikes and steadies their nerves. It also quickens their footsteps and deepens their agility and reasoning.

rites.name: Siantaulia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the strikes of a warrior wielding two blades, quickening their hands and steadying their guard. It also toughens the bearer's body, adding to how much harm they can endure.

rites.name: Lianorus
rites.text: A learned temple discipline that sharpens an initiate's aim and strike of heavy rods, sending a foe reeling back whenever a precise blow lands.

rites.name: Aminum
rites.text: A discipline that spends stored inner energy to shift between two modes of a practitioner's craft. One mode widens reach while softening impact, and the other concentrates force within a narrower circle. Certain techniques change their behavior depending on the chosen mode.

rites.name: Reolliarnia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that strengthens a caster's spells, quickens their casting, and sharpens their mind. It is a lasting gift that rewards mastery of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Corirnium
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that sharpens a practitioner's dark, corrosive force, quickening their rituals of ruin while hardening them against the same rot and deepening its slow, creeping harm.

rites.name: Serolanum
rites.text: A quiet inherent knack that lends its bearer extra physical might without any effort. It works constantly in the background, shaping how strong the wielder is.

rites.name: Sernaurum
rites.text: A channeling craft that lets bow and staff strikes loose extra missiles one after another, mimicking a rapid volley of arrows.

rites.name: Vesia
rites.text: A binding ritual marks every foe within a region, leaving them open to storm-fire and more likely to be stunned by it.

rites.name: Teniarnium
rites.text: A dormant battle-trance that quickens a warrior's strikes and swells the fury they can hold within. It is widely taught among those who fight without restraint.

rites.name: Valenus
rites.text: A basic innate gift that grants its bearer an added measure of protection against disorder-born harm. It is quietly carried rather than actively wielded.

rites.name: Laurnium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that deepens the lingering hold of decay upon whatever it touches. Adepts who train it find their blight-marks spread with greater force.

rites.name: Ceolium
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that sharpens the strikes of drawn bows and quickens the wearer's stride. It also hastens the renewal of swift evasive arts.

rites.name: Sialeornes
rites.text: A crackling discharge that leaps from one target to the next in a chain. It is a spell drawn from the flow of storm-current.

rites.name: Riarnia
rites.text: A mystic discipline that channels arcane force into sharper spellwork and a wider reach for incantations. Practitioners who have recently claimed a life find their magic spreading farther still.

rites.name: Liasirnium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that gives a bearer a chance to shrug off blows aimed at the body. It can only be bestowed by blessing a chosen object with sacred oil.

rites.name: Lesteornium
rites.text: Glowing orbs that gather around a being to count stored energies, each kind tied to a core trait. Their benefits grow stronger as more of a given kind are gathered.

rites.name: Orarum
rites.text: A ritual craft that stirs a discarded blade or plate of armour from the earth and binds it into a loyal servant. The animated guardian fights on its caster's behalf.

rites.name: Telaulum
rites.text: A crimson ring spreads across the ground, shaped in a circle, and is cast by a city leader. It marks the place where the rite unfolds.

rites.name: Teliasteror
rites.text: A linked charm that wakes a bound spell whenever its bearer takes a set measure of harm. It turns each wound into a sudden casting of a prepared incantation.

rites.name: Oriarnanum
rites.text: A timed tear that opens in the land and spills monsters out of it. Any stretch of ground may suddenly be drawn into one.

rites.name: Castanum
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a sword wielder strike harder and faster, reaching a little farther while cutting through an opponent's armored defenses.

rites.name: Ventes
rites.text: A quiet, constant craft that sharpens the strikes of a fighter's hooked talons, short knives and long edges, letting every cut land harder.

rites.name: Ameontenium
rites.text: A ritual discipline that sharpens a wielder's strikes with blades, quickening their hands. Those who hold a ward or fight with two weapons may turn aside blows, and a parried blow can stir a surge of fury.

rites.name: Tiastaullor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a wielder's frost, making cold strikes bite harder, more often locking foes in ice, and letting that stillness linger longer. It also deepens the slow creep of chill and the lingering wound of cold.

rites.name: Serentes Seronaurus
rites.text: A foretelling that forms the first link in a sequence of visions. It belongs to a wider chain of linked omens.

rites.name: Tones
rites.text: A close-range strike that hits every foe within a broad forward crescent using all carried blades. Wielding two arms at once divides the force between them, lessening the harm each one delivers.

rites.name: Saulanum
rites.text: A chilling shield is woven around the bearer, drinking in frigid blows until its reserve is spent, then fading for a short while.

rites.name: Tirium
rites.text: A ritual working that draws every marked sigil back to the caster and ignites them all at once. It is a craft for gathering scattered marks into a single flare.

rites.name: Leontium
rites.text: A close-quarters strike that hits a foe nearby and damages everything in the arc before the wielder. Aimed at a far target, it flings a barbed line that catches the enemy and draws the wielder toward them, and each blow stirs fury.

rites.name: Teolenum
rites.text: A hardened inner discipline that raises the vigor a bearer can endure. It also steadies the body against flame, reinforcing how much heat it can withstand.

rites.name: Sanor
rites.text: A linking rune that binds to a striking technique so that each blow lands on two foes at once. The bond picks out any valid targets within reach without the wielder choosing them.

rites.name: Reosialor
rites.text: A minor inherited discipline that hastens a warrior's strikes and sharpens the bite of their blows. It is taught to initiates who have already walked a sworn path.

rites.name: Corallus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that sharpens a caster's spells, making them more likely to strike with decisive force and multiplying the damage when they do.

rites.name: Coristia
rites.text: A bound craft that gathers fragments of pierced foes and corpses, then releases the stored force back outward in a burst around the practitioner. The gathered fragments also feed the practitioner's other techniques.

rites.name: Vallaunus
rites.text: A basic discipline of the order that hardens the body's protective plating while quickening the wearer's stride. It is taught as one of the early passive gifts granted to initiates.

rites.name: Valarnanum
rites.text: A basic innate discipline that quickens a bearer's strikes and sharpens their nimble precision. It works quietly and constantly, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Solastor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that slowly mends the bearer's wounds while kindling a lingering, creeping heat within their strikes.

rites.name: Vornia
rites.text: A quiet, constant discipline that hardens a wearer's protective shell and slowly knits wounds closed. It works without effort and is always active once learned.

rites.name: Coriasoles
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a archer's shafts strike harder and find vital spots more often when drawn from a curved staff.

rites.name: Tastaurium
rites.text: A triggered incantation that hurls searing flame across a wide area when invoked. Its heat strikes everything within the zone it covers.

rites.name: Ameontes Sarnia
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that lets a practitioner strike harder while in a bloodied posture and widen the reach of their work while settled in a dune-like stance.

rites.name: Sereostanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that widens the reach and strength of a bearer's sustained auras while lowering the inner strain of holding skills. It is practiced among the duelists' circles, beside the mastery of great two-handed blades.

rites.name: Meorianes
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that lets a fighter with paired blades or a bulwark turn parries into a slightly better chance to stop incoming strikes, and recover faster afterward.

rites.name: Telerum
rites.text: A binding craft that brings a discarded blade lifting off the ground into a floating companion that fights beside its caster. The animated weapon serves as an ally that strikes at the caster's foes.

rites.name: Marirnia
rites.text: A ritual craft that summons a storm of spectral edges from the heavens. Each wave spreads wider while cutting less deeply, and foes caught where the waves overlap are struck repeatedly.

rites.name: Nianum
rites.text: A radiant aura that wraps its bearer and nearby companions, lending their strikes and incantations a searing heat.

rites.name: Riantum Rintia
rites.text: A quiet, lasting training that lets a practiced archer strike harder and hit truer with any drawn bowstring.

rites.name: Sintor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens the swing of a cleaving blade in its bearer's hands. It also slows the natural draining of inner fury.

rites.name: Serores
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lends a fighter extra brute force and harder blows, and quickens their strikes when swinging a great two-handed weapon.

rites.name: Lauseontor
rites.text: A battle shout that draws the attention of foes nearby and hardens the bearer, with greater protection and reach the more dangerous those foes are. The following blows also strike two more enemies.

rites.name: Serelles
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a fighter raises a shield, staff, or pair of weapons to turn aside incoming strikes and avoid harm.

rites.name: Lernisanum
rites.text: A fighter's rage is channeled into a surge that sharpens strikes and quickens movement while toughening the body. The surge fades once the rage is spent.

rites.name: Corirnium Nenus
rites.text: A temple-taught rite where a caster's strikes kindle a lingering surge within them. The surge grows stronger the more the rite is practiced.

rites.name: Tenaustor
rites.text: A bloodletting ritual that bleeds its wielder slowly while quickening their strikes and drawing life from each blow. Every foe felled while the rite holds renews its duration and may kindle a surge of fury.

rites.name: Tianauria
rites.text: A quiet practice that grants a small extra chance to keep flames from taking hold of the body. It is learned gradually and works without any deliberate effort.

rites.name: Corinerum
rites.text: A sung rite that calls a leader's followers back to their side and restores their vitality. It is practiced among the wandering servants of an old order.

rites.name: Telentium
rites.text: A basic inborn knack that lets a fighter strike harder when wielding blades or hatchets. It is a quiet, constant strength carried by anyone trained in cutting steel.

rites.name: Serialirus
rites.text: A quiet inherited wisdom that a person carries from their forebears, sharpening the mind without any effort or training. It makes the holder naturally more clever.

rites.name: Ciasernum
rites.text: A quiet, constant discipline that sharpens a bearer's aim and hardens their body against the four primal forces of flame, frost, storm, and earth. It is taught early and needs no ritual to maintain.

rites.name: Tiarauntor
rites.text: A ward that draws on the caster's reserved spirit to harden them against blows and flame while they stand still. Those who strike them are numbed by a cold aura, and each step leaves a frozen trail behind.

rites.name: Volauses
rites.text: A learned discipline that hardens a fighter's strikes with a blade, quickening each swing, sharpening aim, and lengthening reach.

rites.name: Liasteria
rites.text: A quiet trained discipline that lets a fighter strike faster when wielding curved hooks, short blades, or long edges. It is practiced by many who learn to move with their weapons.

rites.name: Reolus
rites.text: A basic training discipline that hardens a warrior's protective plating and slowly restores a fraction of their vitality each second.

rites.name: Teliasum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a warrior's ability to dodge, strengthens their protective plating, and deepens their reserves of vitality.

rites.name: Lintus
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that sharpens a fighter's aim, striking tempo and casting rhythm. It works constantly without any active effort.

rites.name: Valaurnoles
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that can be awakened only in a bearer already marked by an enchantment. It also lies dormant within a rare, mid-sized cluster gem.

rites.name: Tallium
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens an archer's eye, letting every arrow loosed from a longbow more often find a deadly weak point.

rites.name: Orianor
rites.text: A cold ward that the caster raises around themselves for a time. It drains their barrier to soak a share of incoming harm, and sharpens their chance of landing powerful sorcery while it holds.

rites.name: Ameostillor
rites.text: A state in which a being's vitality stands at its maximum, and it remains in that condition while protected by a ward against corrupting chaos.

rites.name: Mosus Tiriarnanum
rites.text: A ward that some fearsome creatures carry, shielding them completely from hexes. Nothing can break through it, not even the most determined sorcery.

rites.name: Sistor
rites.text: A ritual rite in which the bodies of the dead are burned as an offering, granting one's servants a brief surge of speed.

rites.name: Teosialanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with two blades held together in both hands, landing sharper blows more often. It works only when wielding a blade in each hand, and it hits harder against foes who are still unhurt.

rites.name: Sarum
rites.text: A devotee's rite that lets them devour a fallen body nearby to restore their vitality and focus. Neglecting this feeding leaves them more vulnerable to harm.

rites.name: Toleontus
rites.text: A ghostly spectral fire coils around a wielder's edged weapons, lending them a rapid flurry of strikes. It cannot be acquired through trade or purchase.

rites.name: Coriles
rites.text: A fiery rite-effect that a worshipper can channel when rushing forward. It is sealed inside a sacred chest and can be obtained in exchange for a modest tally of tokens.

rites.name: Ameles
rites.text: A ritual craft that hurls a flying burst of searing flame toward a target. On impact it deals fire damage and has a heightened chance to trigger a further effect.

rites.name: Valolantes
rites.text: A learned combat technique that a certain single-handed blunt weapon grants to its wielder. It lets the bearer deliver blows that carry heat and flame into the target.

rites.name: Naulor
rites.text: A close-range strike that strikes the earth so a rolling shockwave rushes ahead, battering foes in its path and often leaving them dazed.

rites.name: Rinausor
rites.text: A close-quarters fighting technique in which the wielder swings a melee weapon twice in rapid succession at a single foe. It inflicts extra harm on opponents who are already bleeding.

rites.name: Amaustesium
rites.text: A hexing rite that places a curse over everyone within a circle, weakening their strikes and dulling their aim. It has no effect on harm that is turned back onto the attacker.

rites.name: Oralium
rites.text: A quiet, innate talent that strengthens a bearer's blows, widens the reach of their effects, and quickens the flight of thrown or loosed missiles.

rites.name: Amaunia Nellanor
rites.text: A quiet inborn talent that lets its bearer's harms deepen and spread gradually across a span of time. It is a basic gift, taken up early by many who train in the old orders.

rites.name: Tarum
rites.text: A sheet of burning light is raised by a caster and scorches foes standing close to it over time. Missiles that cut through the sheet take on extra heat, and a creature can only suffer from one such sheet at once.

rites.name: Lontilum
rites.text: A charged incantation that hurls a broad bolt of storm-fire at foes. Holding still while chanting gathers more power, making the bolt hit harder and narrower.

rites.name: Oreosernum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wielder of short blades strike harder and deal stronger killing blows whenever a dagger is in hand.

rites.name: Sillastor
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a wielder of short blades strike harder with every thrust. It needs no training to activate and simply lingers in the hand.

rites.name: Misium
rites.text: A calming aura channeled by a caster that quickens the strikes, incantations, and footsteps of the caster and nearby companions.

rites.name: Veornaulus
rites.text: A quiet, innate discipline that lets a practitioner strike with greater force whenever a blow lands true. It is taught early and needs no ritual to maintain.

rites.name: Corollus
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that carries chill through a bearer's hands. It only awakens in relics bound with a particular ward or in tokens carrying three drawn marks.

rites.name: Sinanum
rites.text: A fiery incantation that hurls scorching heat across a narrow strip before the caster. Foes already aflame suffer an extra measure of harm from it.

rites.name: Vausanum
rites.text: A blow that strikes a ring of ground around the target, unleashing one of three elemental forces at random each time. The strike grows fiercer against foes already burdened by the chosen element's afflictions.

rites.name: Oriarus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets its bearer stand against heat more easily. It is a simple, ever-present trait that needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Vilanor
rites.text: A ranged strike sends a shaft that clings to a foe or surface and bursts after a short delay in a wide blast of flame. Each further shaft lodged in the same target adds its force and widens the burst.

rites.name: Leorus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a wielder's lingering harms strike harder over time while their body mends itself more swiftly.

rites.name: Oriles
rites.text: A ritual craft that ignites a fallen body into a burst of flame. The fire spreads outward through the surrounding ground and harms everything nearby.

rites.name: Coraulantes
rites.text: A battle-shout that draws enemies' attention and calls up phantom fighters from the fallen nearby. Each phantom strikes once with a linked technique, then fades away.

rites.name: Sestium
rites.text: A ritual aura that lends a shimmering, corrosive chaos to the strikes and incantations of its wielder and nearby companions. It turns every blow and spell into something a little more poisonous.

rites.name: Meleosus
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that sharpens a wielder's strikes with blades, making each blow hit harder and more often land a lethal, devastating cut.

rites.name: Rollarnia
rites.text: A shimmering aura woven by a caster that lends nimble dodging to the caster and nearby companions. It lets allies slip past blows more easily.

rites.name: Listanor
rites.text: A passive discipline that adds force to blows struck after a battle cry. Such strikes are the ones a warrior spends their rising fury on.

rites.name: Orises
rites.text: A ritual working that raises a small sanctuary from nothing. The sanctuary takes the form of a minor shrine, humble in scale but real in presence.

rites.name: Caunteornia
rites.text: A basic inherited discipline that hardens a bearer's guard when a carried ward is held. It raises the protection of armour, the ability to slip blows, and a shimmering barrier of energy.

rites.name: Orestium Corernum
rites.text: A basic inherited discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes and aim whenever they carry two blades at once. It needs no training to activate and works quietly in the background.

rites.name: Oreollanum
rites.text: A withering area curse that is cast in pulses by pain-idols during a blood rite at an altar. It wears away the body over time, and it cannot be cleansed by ordinary remedies meant to stop bleeding.

rites.name: Amistanum
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that lets a bearer's venom strike harder and linger longer. It also steels the body against corrupting energies and deepens the slow, creeping harm that poison inflicts over time.

rites.name: Nenum
rites.text: A cursing rite that hexes everyone within a region, weakening their resistance to the elements. When the caster performs it upon themselves, a gathering dread builds that makes the curse bite harder.

rites.name: Valauntes Amantes
rites.text: A minor passive craft that quickens spellcasting and sometimes restores escape techniques for wielders who carry a weapon in each hand. It is taught as a simple discipline to beginners.

rites.name: Tiantor
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth the dead and blights a stretch of earth. Whatever stands upon the blighted ground is scorched by corrupting force for as long as it lasts.

rites.name: Meorium Montaulia
rites.text: A ritual rite that bursts a fallen body into a roaring fountain of flame, hurling fiery shards that detonate on impact and scorch everything nearby.

rites.name: Orostus
rites.text: A battle-shout that draws the attention of foes gathered nearby and briefly mends the shouter's flesh. It stores up protective charges that harden the shouter against elemental harm and blows, and it leaves the shouter's strikes untouched.

rites.name: Mellia
rites.text: A ceremonial rite performed within a circular arena where ring-set obelisks hurl crackling orbs across to one another. Each obelisk fires only after it has been struck by an orb, passing the spark around like a cycle of hands.

rites.name: Seostium Visallum
rites.text: A dark rite drains vitality from one bound servant nearby, releasing a wave of corrupting force that leaps to other servants close by. When no servant is near, the caster's own life is offered instead.

rites.name: Rianarum
rites.text: Two basic passive talents that a wearer may awaken within a flesh-bound or stone-hardened lineage of gifts. Only one of them also grants a second, unnamed boon.

rites.name: Amanerium
rites.text: A binding sworn between a dark practitioner and the dead it raises. Each recently consumed body quickens the practitioner's strikes and spells, and the risen husks grow hardier and send cold and jolting pain into nearby foes.

rites.name: Meoliastus
rites.text: A ritual working that calls down many burning bolts across a marked area, each bolt scorching everything near where it lands.

rites.name: Rirnausium
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that sharpens a warrior's strikes with chopping blades, quickening their swings and deepening the lasting wounds they leave. It also swells the fury a fighter can hold within.

rites.name: Telonanum Causum
rites.text: A sacred discipline that sharpens a fighter's close-range strikes, raising the chance of decisive blows and empowering elemental force. It also bolsters both bodily might and inner insight.

rites.name: Teleonanum
rites.text: A simple inborn craft that lengthens how long a gathered reserve of resilience keeps its strength. It works quietly in the background of a practitioner's training.

rites.name: Corillonor
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens a practitioner's striking and casting speed, and amplifies their magic, whenever they bear two blades at once.

rites.name: Oreosium Seraulles
rites.text: A common inherited discipline that grants a wielder a protective hum of added vitality and a boost to the power of their elemental strikes.

rites.name: Teontium
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a wielder strike harder and faster when holding a short blade. It needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Nelles
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline found only among bearers who carry certain sacred enchantments. It lets their blows pierce foes more often and keeps those wounds open for one extra strike.

rites.name: Cosillum
rites.text: A hexing rite that binds everyone within a circle under a sickening curse. The cursed suffer heavier wounds from corrupted force, slow bleeding decay, and sharper strikes of ruin.

rites.name: Coriaranum
rites.text: A basic passive discipline that sharpens a wielder's blows when two blades are carried, one in each hand. It grants greater striking force to the bearer while bearing a weapon in each grip.

rites.name: Ceores Telestium
rites.text: A quiet, lasting gift of the eye that sharpens aim and lets a practitioner strike true with greater frequency. It also brings a measure of nimbleness to the hand.

rites.name: Mentum Meniastor
rites.text: A quiet discipline in which a fighter may gather lasting stamina after each slain foe. It keeps a minimum reserve of that stamina ready and sharpens the strikes that are fed by it.

rites.name: Cinarnes
rites.text: A cone-shaped rite that lashes out crimson strands to batter foes, and the wounds keep bleeding over time, building up to three layers. Its strands can be woven to strike several foes at once.

rites.name: Serasteolum
rites.text: A passive craft that stirs up sudden blasts of force, found only in bearers of a certain sealed enchantment or among certain relics. It answers the bearer's own charged aura.

rites.name: Vesor
rites.text: A practiced craft that wraps its wielder in a shielding glow, soaking up incoming flame until the shield's strength is spent and it fades away for a while.

rites.name: Tentes Vistallus
rites.text: A movement craft in which the practitioner instantly leaps to a chosen spot, scorching anyone caught in the arrival and leaving a trail of smoldering ground behind.

rites.name: Tostum
rites.text: A ward laid in advance that, once triggered, conjures a turning column of fire. Anything that touches the spinning blaze is quickly scorched by heat.

rites.name: Rosteosanum
rites.text: A chilling incantation that hurls a rolling wave of sharp ice shards across a wide area. Its harm turns the blunt force of blows into a bitter frost.

rites.name: Sostilum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that quickens the strikes and incantations of one's bound dead. It also allows the summoner to keep one more risen corpse under their command at a time.

rites.name: Seronum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a wanderer's dodging, quickens their stride, and hastens the renewal of their swift leaps. Brief bursts of motion further hasten their strikes and incantations.

rites.name: Leolium
rites.text: A trained battle discipline that sharpens a warrior's chance of landing decisive blows. After a strike that finds its mark, the fighter's next attacks hit harder and with added bite.

rites.name: Lerniastum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that bolsters the vitality of one's companions while lending a veil of spirit-woven protection to oneself.

rites.name: Verus
rites.text: A quiet training discipline that sharpens a wielder's strike and steadies the aim of short blades. Those who practice it hit harder and more surely when armed with a small knife.

rites.name: Rastum Mirnum
rites.text: A basic innate gift that lets a caster weave binding hexes more swiftly. It is always active without any effort from its bearer.

rites.name: Corostum
rites.text: A lasting inner rite that turns a person's protective glow into restored vitality, though it dampens the natural mending of the body and the drawing of life from foes.

rites.name: Teniarnium Lelia
rites.text: A banned incantation that hurls volleys of volatile shards at foes within a region, its strength drawn from the caster's vitality and protective ward. Extra shards strike other enemies nearby.

rites.name: Vantus
rites.text: A close-range strike that shakes the ground in a wide circle and splits it open. After a short delay, the fissure erupts again, striking a broader area with greater force.

rites.name: Tesanum Santeranum
rites.text: A bound flame technique awakened by a specific battle shout. It draws a fiery burst from a sacred stone, and its power is shaped by the chant that calls it forth.

rites.name: Cesia
rites.text: A hexing working that spreads over a region and leaves everything inside it more vulnerable to heat, so that blows are likelier to set their targets alight.

rites.name: Minus
rites.text: A ward-aura of calm that the caster projects over nearby companions. It raises a protective shield of spirit energy around each person it touches.

rites.name: Amallus
rites.text: A chilling binding that falls over every foe in a surrounding area, leaving them weaker against frost and prone to being locked in ice.

rites.name: Ceorestum
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which the practitioner's inner reservoir of power grows and shields the body from harm. Shifts in that reservoir also strengthen the force of the practitioner's strikes.

rites.name: Tenor
rites.text: A flame-technique that a weapon can channel once every short pulse of time. It is unlocked by an attached enhancement and grows no stronger when other gear-tuning charms are applied.

rites.name: Riarneosia
rites.text: A basic innate discipline that quickens a wielder's strikes and spellcasting whenever both hands carry blades. It is taught early to every fighter who learns to fight with a weapon in each hand.

rites.name: Vaulles
rites.text: A basic passive technique that sharpens a blade-wielder's chance to strike true, amplifies the force of those precise blows, and deepens the venom carried on the edge.

rites.name: Telantiasia
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets its bearer strike harder with the raw forces of flame, frost, and storm. Some forms also widen the reservoir of inner energy a person can hold.

rites.name: Valaranum
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a shielding ward around their body that soaks up incoming elemental harm until its strength runs out, then fades after a short span of time.

rites.name: Lalium Orilum
rites.text: A close-quarters ground-striking technique that sends several splitting rifts across the earth, each ending in a rising stone point. When a heavy blow or battle cry strikes those points, they burst outward and harm everything nearby.

rites.name: Telaurnes
rites.text: A sustained close-combat technique in which the wielder spins steadily and strikes every foe within a ring around them. The ring widens the longer the spin is held, and the wielder may keep moving while spinning, armed or bare-handed.

rites.name: Seriantia
rites.text: A basic passive discipline that quickens the strikes of a fighter who carries two blades at once. It grants faster attacks whenever both hands are armed.

rites.name: Maria Oralia
rites.text: A fighter grips a short blade in each hand, trading the brute force of a great weapon for a middle path between striking hard and guarding well.

rites.name: Corernus Telantor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a practitioner's reserve of arcane energy and lets it refill faster. It also sharpens the mind, adding to its reasoning strength.

rites.name: Amolleornus
rites.text: A ritual binding that conjures a sheet of hard rime across the battlefield. Any foe striking it is chilled and driven backward by its bitter force.

rites.name: Maunanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a warrior grow harder to strike as stored battle-fury gathers within them. The more fury banked, the more readily blows slip past.

rites.name: Amirenium
rites.text: A chilling incantation conjures a floating sphere that pulses rapidly before bursting, sapping the vitality of those nearby and freezing the ground in a wide circle.

rites.name: Oraulor
rites.text: A chilling incantation that hurls a slow-drifting shard of frost through every foe in its path. It can also carry other enchantments onward, letting them ride the icy shard instead of the caster.

rites.name: Ameosilor
rites.text: A lingering curse woven during a lavish sacred rite, where glittering tokens drop from the heavens onto anyone beneath them. The afflicted take added harm from every foe until they step clear of the falling wealth or the rite is finished.

rites.name: Senium Sontes
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a fighter's blows and strengthens the dark force carried in their strikes. It is practiced by anyone who trains at the basics of combat.

rites.name: Amornares
rites.text: A close-quarters blow that delivers rot-like harm and seeps venom into its target. When the stricken foe collapses, the venom leaps to nearby enemies, wracking them with a lingering corruption.

rites.name: Losaurnium
rites.text: A lingering hex passed by a creature that carries a certain warping trait, slowing the one who is struck so that their every action comes more sluggishly for a set span of time.

rites.name: Veoria
rites.text: A basic inner discipline for a sacred caster that quickens the flow of their reserve energy and enlarges how much they can hold.

rites.name: Teones
rites.text: A lingering aura that the caster channels to deepen the harm dealt over time. It also prolongs the effects of abilities for the caster and nearby companions.

rites.name: Ciallanum Tarnum
rites.text: A lingering affliction that slows a struck foe's pace for a short span, and never stacks with itself. It can coexist with a separate slowing curse, and it empowers certain lore-marked fighting techniques.

rites.name: Tiasirnus
rites.text: A bound ritual tenet that strengthens the damage of one's summoned servants and deepens the wellspring of one's inner power. It is taken up by those who command the dead.

rites.name: Siastum
rites.text: A basic inborn discipline that quietly strengthens a warrior's close-quarters blows. It needs no ritual to hold, only steady practice at arm's length.

rites.name: Tauntelia
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a fallen foe back to stand as a loyal servant of the caster. The risen servant fights on the caster's side.

rites.name: Orontaulia
rites.text: A glowing sphere of focus that a bearer gathers during a clash, sharpening the mind and channeling hidden energies. Each new sphere refreshes the time left on all others.

rites.name: Miantorus
rites.text: A chilling ward that surrounds its bearer and nearby companions, strengthening their resistance to frost. It hums quietly as it shields them.

rites.name: Caustus
rites.text: A creeping tainted affliction that slowly wears away at a victim's vitality. It harms the afflicted with corrupting chaos energy over a span of time.

rites.name: Taurnintus
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps its bearer and close companions in a shield against heat and flame. It steadies their defenses against fire, and it strengthens the protection the bearer can ever hold.

rites.name: Villia
rites.text: A devotional discipline practiced by sacred wardens, where consecrated ground lets restorative vitality also mend a protective ward. Its holy effects persist briefly after the bearer steps away.

rites.name: Orasolium
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a fighter's aim for lethal blows when wielding heavy blunt weapons. Each dazing strike has a chance to kindle a surge of stored energy.

rites.name: Viasentium
rites.text: A discipline of the body that sharpens each blow and hardens the fighter's frame. It also weakens the protection an opponent's flesh gains against strikes.

rites.name: Ciallantum
rites.text: A ritual discipline taught to dark-arts adepts that strengthens the strikes of raised servants and amplifies the lingering auras they carry. It is granted as a rank-advancing gift to those who command the dead.

rites.name: Teleosium
rites.text: A ritual inscription that makes every third blow struck by a bearer land with greater force and leave the foe reeling longer. It is taught to warriors who train at the strong-arm temples.

rites.name: Coreolanum
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens close-quarters blows, letting the practitioner hit harder with the body and steadily mend their own wounds. It also strengthens the arm and extends the reach of blades and bare fists alike.

rites.name: Corentes
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that bolsters a summoner's servants, granting them greater vitality and strength. Those who master it find their bound followers hardier and more fearsome in battle.

rites.name: Coreoloria
rites.text: A close-quarters strike that hits an area before the wielder, with its reach widening each time it connects in succession. The widened reach slowly fades when the strikes miss.

rites.name: Sonauntus
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a wielder turn back an incoming strike toward its source. It draws its power from a blade bound to the practitioner.

rites.name: Tones Orianium
rites.text: A melee strike that drives into a foe and transforms part of its force into searing heat. Each blow hurls several glowing orbs that burst in a small circle, scorching whatever lies near the impact.

rites.name: Cirnes
rites.text: A basic inherited discipline that strengthens the blows of one's followers and bound servants. It is a quiet, constant gift taught to every initiate.

rites.name: Raulenum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that quickens the swing of hand-held striking blades, letting a fighter strike more often in close combat.

rites.name: Coraules
rites.text: A trained bodily knack that lets a warrior strike harder when gripping a great heavy blade with both hands. It also lets blows draw back a bit of vitality and weakens the armor of foes.

rites.name: Amostia
rites.text: A property of thrown or launched missiles that lets them pass clean through whatever they strike and keep flying along the same path.

rites.name: Teleonases
rites.text: A basic, always-active craft that makes launched missiles fly swifter and strike harder. It is taught as one of the simplest disciplines a novice can carry.

rites.name: Sornestor
rites.text: Allied creatures are called forth by a summoner to fight on their behalf. Each one deals its own harm and acts apart from its master, yet the summoner still shares in what they win.

rites.name: Telines Coriantarum
rites.text: A basic inner discipline taught to fighters of the warrior-rage order, granting heavier blows and a greater chance of striking a decisive, devastating hit.

rites.name: Valeosus
rites.text: A discipline of close-quarters striking where a wielder's blows draw their force from whatever blade or club is held. Without any tool, the same strikes rely on the body's raw strength alone.

rites.name: Corosastor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes and footwork while steadily strengthening their endurance. It is prized by wandering guardians who rely on it to dodge blows and outlast foes.

rites.name: Rellor
rites.text: A slow mending that quietly restores a being's vital reserves, sometimes including its shielding and its inner energy, as time passes without any deliberate effort.

rites.name: Vontes
rites.text: A quiet ritual bond that strengthens the blows of one's servants and lets them draw life back from the foes they strike. It is taught to novices as a plain, everyday discipline.

rites.name: Mostenanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a fighter's blows so they strike harder, while also strengthening the body's reserve of vitality.

rites.name: Renum
rites.text: A binding hex that marks every creature within its reach with a lingering curse. Afflicted foes suffer extra harm when wounded and, when slain, rebound a jolt of force back at the ground around them.

rites.name: Coraullanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a practitioner's reserve of arcane essence and sharpens the force of their enchantments. It requires no active invocation, since it hums steadily beneath the surface of the body.

rites.name: Valiarnes
rites.text: A basic discipline practiced by warriors of a certain order, granting heightened striking force and quicker blows when they fight with their hands or blades.

rites.name: Mausarum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that strengthens the hardiness of one's bound followers, letting them endure more harm and mend themselves steadily over time.

rites.name: Castiarnes
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter strike harder while bearing a guard on the arm. The benefit applies only when that protective plate is held ready.

rites.name: Corastiles
rites.text: A flung ball of molten stone arcs through the air and bounces along a curved path before bursting in a blaze that scorches a wide area. Any charm that adds extra rebounds makes the ball bounce more times instead.

rites.name: Teleornanor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that softens the force of decisive blows against its bearer. It also hardens the body's guard and weakens the hold of hexes laid upon them.

rites.name: Tintus
rites.text: A temporary blessing that stirs a warrior's blood, giving a chance to build up a rush of fury each time a foe falls.

rites.name: Corialus
rites.text: A passive mark of command that amplifies the battle cries a warrior lets loose. Foes who are provoked by those shouts suffer greater harm from every blow.

rites.name: Verium
rites.text: A ritual binding where a practitioner sacrifices fallen bodies to empower their followers. Nearby remains are drawn in to lengthen or strengthen the blessing, and only one such rite may hold sway at a time.

rites.name: Lostum
rites.text: A binding craft that strips the protective gains of a warrior's shield and passes them onto the summoned dead who march beside the caster.

rites.name: Coronia Seroranum
rites.text: A basic innate discipline that quietly sharpens the force of thrown and loosed missiles. It requires no practice to sustain once learned by the wielder.

rites.name: Coreriasus
rites.text: A ritual craft that consumes a fallen body to call forth a bound servant of the dead. The servant fights close with strikes and a crushing slam that hits everything nearby.

rites.name: Mastolia
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that sharpens the aim and strengthens the force of thrown or loosed missiles. It also steadies the hand and deepens the eye for the mark.

rites.name: Talor
rites.text: A mounting fury that certain warriors of a sworn martial brotherhood build within themselves. The more of it they gather, the harder they strike and the faster they move.

rites.name: Tanor
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that is found only on one special kind of charm. Its bearer gains a rare leadership talent, and the charm's random blessings shape how it works.

rites.name: Talanum Amoles
rites.text: A basic discipline practiced by one class of ritual caster, quickening the flow of inner reserves and the speed at which anchored sigils are set into the ground.

rites.name: Taustalles
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that steadies the arm and sharpens the blow of a fighter wielding close weapons. It raises how much force the body can bear and how hard each strike lands.

rites.name: Orenolia
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that lets the body hold more vitality than usual and grants added resistance to corrupting, chaotic forces.

rites.name: Tausarium
rites.text: A sworn archer's discipline that sharpens the force of thrown shafts and lengthens the duration of a spectral marksman that fights alongside the wielder.

rites.name: Tianteonor
rites.text: A lasting discipline that hardens the body against blows and helps the bearer slip past strikes. It also steadies the bearer against the raw forces of fire, frost, and lightning.

rites.name: Telolianor
rites.text: A basic learned discipline that quickens the strikes of a heavy blunt club and makes each blow hit harder. It is practiced by anyone who swings a mace.

rites.name: Seosanum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that lets a warrior strike harder in close combat and swing more quickly. It lasts only a brief moment before fading away.

rites.name: Coraunelus
rites.text: A radiant ward that surrounds its bearer and nearby companions, granting them greater resistance against storm-born energy. Its protection grows stronger for everyone within its reach.

rites.name: Teonistor
rites.text: A quiet, innate discipline that sharpens the force of blows struck with a single-handed bladed or blunt implement. It requires no effort to maintain and simply deepens every strike.

rites.name: Tiasium
rites.text: A quiet, lasting protection that can only be bound into a charm or a relic bearing a particular sealed inscription. It belongs among the lesser passive gifts that such bindings can hold.

rites.name: Sollor Salanum
rites.text: A rare inner discipline that bends the sense of dread a bearer can spread. Whenever the bearer lays a hex upon foes, those foes are also shaken and unsettled.

rites.name: Amirnor
rites.text: A swift counter-strike that springs forth automatically whenever a defender stops a blow. When two blades are held, both are swung in the reply.

rites.name: Serinum
rites.text: A ward that wraps its bearer in a hardened shell of heat, granting extra toughness and soaking up blows. When the shell fades or has taken enough strikes, it bursts outward in flame scaled to the harm it absorbed.

rites.name: Naullianium
rites.text: A reckless fury that quickens the strikes and strides of one's servants, sharpening their blows and hastening their movement. It is a rite taught to those who command the bound dead.

rites.name: Tonanum Orirnium
rites.text: A quiet mastery that strengthens the carved guardians a caster raises, letting one more siege engine stand beside them and lending extra force to the spirit idols that empower allies.

rites.name: Miarnanum Cialintanum
rites.text: A discipline of the arena-born that lets a fighter who was just wounded turn the sting into a sharper guard. Blocked blows leave no stagger behind, and the counterstrikes that follow hit far harder.

rites.name: Rallium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a whirling ally bound to the caster's side. While the ally stands manifest, the caster surges with relentless momentum yet must lay down all arms.

rites.name: Lanor
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that lets a warrior strike harder with bodily blows. It works without effort and always stays active once learned.

rites.name: Nestisia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that steadies the hand and sharpens the reach of thrown or loosed missiles. It grows a little deeper with each practice.

rites.name: Teorus
rites.text: A disciplined inner craft that lets a fighter's blows strike harder and quickens the battle-shouts that rally their allies. It is taught to those who walk the path of the furious warrior.

rites.name: Amarnium
rites.text: A sacred rite that hurls a line of holy burning light forward, then marks the ground where it fell. A later ring of force bursts outward and strikes those who stand upon the marked ground.

rites.name: Reostaurus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that enlarges a practitioner's reserve of arcane force and quickens how fast it refills. It also strengthens both the body and the mind, and adds to the charges held in carried vials.

rites.name: Neostorium
rites.text: A ghostly strength that channels bodily force into arcane workings. It lends extra striking power to incantations and magical acts.

rites.name: Valonor
rites.text: A dark affliction that slows the movements and weakens the strikes of whoever it grips. Certain writhing horrors can inflict it, and skilled practitioners can call it forth by projecting a chilling dread.

rites.name: Taustor
rites.text: A flying charge is loosed from a caster's working or a drawn bow and streaks onward without its maker's guidance. It ends its path when it strikes a foe or barrier, or when it runs out of range.

rites.name: Amaulornes
rites.text: A dormant binding that makes servants burst into flame when their strength wanes low. The blast scorches nearby foes for a portion of the servant's full vitality.

rites.name: Tarnor
rites.text: A quiet, inborn discipline that sharpens a wielder's aim when fighting with a single-handed blade or club. It is a steady, everyday knack taught to beginners in the training yards.

rites.name: Amialeror
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth two bound phantom arachnids to serve the caster as loyal companions in battle.

rites.name: Meollanum Corostaunus
rites.text: A basic inherent knack that lets a wielder strike more truly and deal extra elemental harm when swinging heavy clubs. It is learned by practice rather than gained through ritual.

rites.name: Cialium
rites.text: A quiet discipline taught to heavy-club wielders, sharpening the force of their blows and making foes easier to daze when struck with a blunt staff.

rites.name: Teleosum
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a wielder's piercing strikes linger in a foe's flesh, and each lingering wound hardens the wielder and nearby companions and sharpens their blows.

rites.name: Raunus Amosales
rites.text: A minor practiced technique that strengthens the harm caused by buried traps and eases the spiritual toll of setting them. Practitioners learn it early as a simple, steady discipline.

rites.name: Amesia
rites.text: A ritual gift that lets a caster's hexes take hold on guarded foes. Cursed creatures may burst into a corrupting blast when they fall to the caster or the caster's servants.

rites.name: Costiria
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that steadies the body and lends extra brute force to every effort. It works without conscious thought, flowing through the limbs of anyone who carries it.

rites.name: Calanum
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that lets a person endure more harm and hold more inner fire. Its bearers grow sturdier in body and deeper in spiritual reserve over time.

rites.name: Seraustanum
rites.text: A temple-taught discipline that lets a practitioner bind more hexes onto foes at once, strengthening each one. Cursed enemies grow weaker in their strikes while becoming more vulnerable to harm.

rites.name: Visaurium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that quickens the flow of inner reserves and lengthens the hold of lingering sparks of vigor and might. It is practiced by those who channel sacred work.

rites.name: Meonorium
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift that lends its bearer extra physical force without any effort on their part. It works constantly in the background, requiring no call to action.

rites.name: Veniantus
rites.text: A discipline of striking foes from afar using launched weapons such as drawn bows and channeling rods. Its harm depends on which implement the practitioner carries.

rites.name: Lianerus
rites.text: A quiet, foundational knack that shapes how its bearer works. Its origin is unknown, though its effects hint at a connection to angling and waters.

rites.name: Oriselor
rites.text: A basic innate gift that enlarges a bearer's store of inner energy and makes restorative vials refill that energy more fully.

rites.name: Telisaror
rites.text: A fighter pounds the earth to make several sharp stone points erupt around them, hitting everything in the surrounding area. Its effect shifts depending on the fighter's current combat posture.

rites.name: Sostianor
rites.text: A bound discipline that lengthens the lingering force of a summoner's working and sharpens the blows of the dead servants who answer to them.

rites.name: Leosares
rites.text: A sacred rite of the guardian order, where a stirring cry grants a brief surge of swiftness and strength to the caller and nearby companions. The cry also comes without delay or cost to the caller.

rites.name: Nerum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft granted only to certain items bearing aura or frost-ward enchantments, or to items that always carry three randomly chosen gifts.

rites.name: Coraseonium
rites.text: A blessing that lets a warrior gather a lasting reserve of stamina whenever a foe falls. The gathering comes only by chance, not every time.

rites.name: Mesanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a practitioner draw a small share of their strikes' force back into their own reserve of spirit. It also gradually strengthens that flow over time.

rites.name: Seollium Niarum
rites.text: A common inner discipline that sharpens the body's striking force and the raw wildness of corrupting energies. It also deepens the practitioner's reservoir of vitality.

rites.name: Callerus
rites.text: A bowman's technique that looses a flurry of shafts skyward, which then fall in a sequence and strike a wide zone with harm over a brief span.

rites.name: Vauntesanum
rites.text: A quiet old craft that lets servants draw a small measure of vitality back into themselves whenever they strike. The bond strengthens the followers who serve a master.

rites.name: Amianosanum
rites.text: A hexing cry that drags down a traveler's pace, lingering in layers that each fade on their own clock. Only certain sea-dwelling hags can cast this exact wail, though lesser beasts echo its noise without its bite.

rites.name: Saullus
rites.text: A battle-shout that draws the attention of foes nearby and bolsters the strength of companions. Its force grows with the might of those gathered around, and the next blows struck carry extra weight.

rites.name: Ciarellor
rites.text: A stony binding that locks a being in place, halting all of its movement and actions until it fades. Certain watchtowers can also set this hardening upon creatures touched by rot.

rites.name: Nantum
rites.text: A devotional discipline taught to temple-keepers that quickens the flow of inner reserves and strengthens the surge of hidden power within the practitioner.

rites.name: Valestus
rites.text: A harmful ground effect that a creature of the realm can call forth to entangle those nearby. It is wielded by certain beasts that prowl the wilds.

rites.name: Veontanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that steadies the body, adding to how much harm a wielder can endure. It also sharpens the force of blows struck with close-quarters arms.

rites.name: Telalinus
rites.text: A bonded discipline that hardens its bearer against the elements. Those who fight beside the bearer grow stronger, and a large gathering of companions brings a surge of relentless momentum.

rites.name: Sosum
rites.text: A deceptive art taught to shadowy operatives who set snares. Each snare has a chance to spring anew, and every trap laid strikes harder, while the cost of setting them falls.

rites.name: Teontaurum
rites.text: A dormant sigil-craft that a chosen wanderer may awaken to gain a notable passive gift of the path. It bonds to one bearer and grows with that bearer's trials.

rites.name: Carus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a bearer turn aside blows and incantations more often while carrying a ward. It also softens the sting of fire, frost, and lightning.

rites.name: Sernanum Meolium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a person endure greater harm and mend faster from draughts. It also makes the potions they drink work more strongly on them.

rites.name: Mernium Valintor
rites.text: A learned craft in which a wanderer grows steadier at gathering and mixing healing leaves. Practitioners draw lasting benefit from long study of the green world.

rites.name: Ronasor
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a wielder who holds still steadily gather living tendrils around them. The tendrils gather continuously while the wielder remains motionless.

rites.name: Mellanum
rites.text: A trained habit of the striker that quickens blows and deepens their force when wielding blunt clubs and ceremonial staves. Its reach widens when a foe has recently been left reeling.

rites.name: Sallentanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a practitioner channel disorder into greater destructive force. It also hardens the body against corrupting void energies.

rites.name: Amastanum
rites.text: A flying blast of heat that bursts into a wide ring of harm where it lands. It is a craft taught only to a select few, and it closely resembles the flying portion of a fire technique.

rites.name: Sialontum
rites.text: A learned bowman's discipline that sharpens every shot taken from a bow. It hastens the loose, steadies the aim, and sends each arrow flying faster.

rites.name: Niastium
rites.text: A basic innate gift that quietly raises a bearer's capacity for reasoning and the rate at which their inner arcane reservoir refills. It requires no conscious effort to maintain.

rites.name: Veontallium
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that strengthens the endurance of a bound servant, letting each follower bear more harm before it falls.

rites.name: Risaunia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that deepens a practitioner's reserve of arcane energy. It also lets their spells draw less from that reserve when cast.

rites.name: Rostiaria
rites.text: A measure of the arcane energy a practitioner must surrender to invoke a single technique one time. Each invocation draws down the reserve that fuels such workings.

rites.name: Mollium Riarnantus
rites.text: A quiet, innate knack that quickens the strikes of a warrior wielding a single-hand blade or club. It is among the simplest disciplines taught to novice fighters.

rites.name: Corirus
rites.text: A quiet inner reservoir that swells a practitioner's capacity for arcane energy and refills it whenever a foe falls. It needs no conscious call and works constantly in the background.

rites.name: Telosistium
rites.text: A retaliatory strike that answers any successful guard without being called by hand. The blow lands on all foes near the defender.

rites.name: Valarnium
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught in the inner orders that lowers the cost of workings and strengthens a practitioner's protective aura in proportion to their reserve of inner power. It also widens the reach of their spells as that reserve grows.

rites.name: Sasilor
rites.text: A quiet, ever-present craft that slowly mends the wounds of bound servants and followers. It needs no ritual, only the steady patience of its bearer.

rites.name: Seror Taustonia
rites.text: A quiet discipline taught to warriors who wield a single blade in one hand. It sharpens their instinct for finding the decisive opening, so their strikes land true more often.

rites.name: Nauntelor
rites.text: A sacred discipline granted to a tribal war-leader, letting strikes set foes alight, pierce their flame-resistance, and deepen the burning that lingers after each blow.

rites.name: Telarilor
rites.text: A sacred brand pressed onto a wanderer by a dark overlord and his lieutenants. It calls twisted creatures to hunt the marked one, and they burst apart upon reaching them.

rites.name: Corarnonus
rites.text: A linking charm that, when bound to a sealed trap-stone, lets the bearer lay more hidden snares at once and keep a greater number of them armed together.

rites.name: Teonum
rites.text: A sacred rite that quickens a bearer's strength and vitality, growing stronger with each marker of devotion planted in the ground. Each placed sigil lends its wielder extra might and renewed energy.

rites.name: Orollinia
rites.text: A devoted discipline practiced by a sacred caster that lets them raise more standing wardens and keeps those wardens lasting longer. They also set the wardens into place more quickly.

rites.name: Risium
rites.text: A stackable hex that dulls a bearer's stature and strength. It lingers in a cursed king's chamber and in the wake of a possessed talisman's creature, and a rare beast of the wilds can cast it as well.

rites.name: Coristes Teollanum
rites.text: A bound charm that lets a linked rite hold one extra ready casting, though each casting then takes longer to recover from.

rites.name: Callor Taustum
rites.text: A trained knack for the hands that lends extra force and swiftness to strikes made with a single blade or club held in one grip.

rites.name: Oraustes Orerus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lends extra brawn to the hands of those who train it. Blows land harder and swift blades strike more often when wielded in one hand.

rites.name: Amaunus Orenteosia
rites.text: A quiet inherited practice that lengthens how long etched marks hold their power and how often they can be kindled. It also deepens the harm such marks inflict on whatever they are bound to.

rites.name: Teones Vaullenanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a caster channel stronger arcane force through every working they perform. It is a basic gift taught to novices before any formal training.

rites.name: Corestolia
rites.text: A tag that marks certain close-quarters blows as ground-shaking strikes that also hit an area around the target. Such techniques bear the mark, though not every close-combat art carries it.

rites.name: Orolanum
rites.text: A glowing ward is drawn on the ground around a caster and holds for a set time. Allies inside it crackle with storm energy, and feeding it power strengthens the effect until foes within weaken their blows.

rites.name: Corollium Teleostium
rites.text: A steady inner discipline that lets a bearer catch incoming blows more often while a raised bulwark gives extra protection. It is taught to those who hold a guard.

rites.name: Niantaulium
rites.text: A stackable blessing that can be layered repeatedly on a bearer. It is bestowed at a ritual altar, lending the same swiftness to both a beast and its companion at once.

rites.name: Tiasanum Cinor
rites.text: A passive discipline that lowers the spiritual cost a practitioner pays to hold their workings. It also strengthens the protective wards that the practitioner projects over their surroundings.

rites.name: Linium
rites.text: A quiet trained posture taught to staff-bearers, which sharpens the odds of a decisive blow and deepens the damage such a blow deals while the staff is held.

rites.name: Corinia
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a practitioner bend cold into their own purpose. It is taught as a refined inner craft among those who study the elements.

rites.name: Sianum Contiarus
rites.text: A chilling shroud cast by a frost-bound ally onto nearby companions, granting them a heightened chance to evade blows and incantations while they stand within its reach. Its strength rises with the caster's rank, up to a set ceiling.

rites.name: Coriastania
rites.text: A battle roar that goads foes within earshot, hurling them backward and breaking their focus. It steadies the caller against stagger, and each following ground-pound strike spreads wider than the last.

rites.name: Amernarium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a wanderer's evasion and softens harm from foes struck by dazzling light. It also gives a faint chance to slip free of such blinding.

rites.name: Siantus
rites.text: A ranged technique where the archer looses a volley of shafts that fan outward in a spread. Practitioners of the bow use it to strike several targets at once.

rites.name: Tenus Amantia
rites.text: A binding ember that is set alongside a practiced technique and lowers the resistance of foes to being knocked senseless. Each strike empowered by it is more likely to leave the target reeling.

rites.name: Reosiares
rites.text: A bearer hurls their guardian plate forward at a chosen spot, striking everyone caught in the path, flinging foes aside and dazing them. The force of the blow is measured by the strength of the plate itself.

rites.name: Serorus Vistasia
rites.text: A quiet, constant inner discipline that grants a bearer added brawn and nimbleness without any conscious effort. It is among the simplest gifts a practitioner can carry.

rites.name: Cisor
rites.text: A basic inherited discipline that sharpens a bearer's strike and aim when wielding a long shaft of wood. It needs no effort to keep and works quietly in the background.

rites.name: Telasteror
rites.text: A bowman's craft that calls forth a standing siege engine, which looses a spray of arrows across a wide arc. The strength of each volley grows with the skill of the archer's own bow.

rites.name: Rialinum
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens a warrior's guard, raising protection from armour, dodging, and shimmering barriers while a shield is held.

rites.name: Nellonia
rites.text: A binding hex that strips a victim's ability to chant incantations or raise battle cries for a brief moment. Strikes made with raw force still land unhindered, and mortals cannot learn to wield it.

rites.name: Meones Corallium
rites.text: A bolt-craft that hurls crackling flares of storm energy which wander erratically through the air until they strike a foe.

rites.name: Oraunellium
rites.text: A ghostly technique where a fighter hurls their held blade at a foe. The blade flies through the air, cutting whatever stands in its path before returning to the wielder's hand.

rites.name: Vornia Seornontor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quietly sharpens the chance of a decisive hit from magical casting and the force of burning flames it kindles.

rites.name: Lirneonor
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that lets a bearer of a long wooden rod strike harder and swing faster. It is taught to apprentices who carry staffs.

rites.name: Meostilia
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a wielder of heavy blunt clubs deal harsher blows and more easily stagger foes. Strikes that leave an opponent reeling can finish off the weakened.

rites.name: Liaraulus
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that sharpens a caster's chance to land decisive blows with spells. It deepens the harm dealt to enemies already aflame and lengthens the scorching that follows a critical strike.

rites.name: Valaulium Taules
rites.text: A quiet, always-on discipline that lends its bearer extra physical might and sharper reasoning. It needs no effort to maintain, flowing through its holder continuously.

rites.name: Amellum Amilostanum
rites.text: A trained knack for staff fighters that heightens their blows, sharpens their chance of landing decisive hits, and extends their reach. Each decisive strike may also store a surge of stamina.

rites.name: Amirnium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a caster's reasoning and deepens the force of their conjured arts. It works constantly in the background, requiring no effort to maintain.

rites.name: Ceornolanum
