rites.text: A sacred mark that a temple keeper may claim for their own craft. As the bond fades, the marks flare more often, and the keeper's rituals recover more swiftly.

rites.name: Raleostes
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that sharpens the strikes of its bearer and quickens the speed at which spirit markers are set into the ground.

rites.name: Telistia Amiarnanum
rites.text: A caster plants marks upon chosen ground, and after a brief wait each mark is struck by a falling lightning bolt that scorches the surrounding area.

rites.name: Sarnaullor
rites.text: A channeled offensive art that strikes foes with harm shaped by attuned crystal shards. Its force is one of four recognized sources of destructive power.

rites.name: Seontia
rites.text: A ritual binding that, for a short moment after a spirit-idol is raised, sharpens the wielder's chance to land decisive blows. It also amplifies the force of those blows when channeled through sigil-marks.

rites.name: Valestium
rites.text: A learned passive discipline that grants a warrior an extra chance to stop incoming strikes while bearing a shield. It is taught within a circle of martial training halls.

rites.name: Lestium Vollia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a practitioner hold a larger reservoir of arcane energy. It also refills that reservoir a little whenever a foe is felled.

rites.name: Saunteollia
rites.text: A lingering dread radiates from creatures of the wild and weighs on anyone nearby, dragging their steps while leaving their quick hands untouched. Those under its pull shimmer faintly with a rosy violet haze.

rites.name: Teliniantes
rites.text: A crackling sickness born of storm-light that leaves its victim open to harm from every direction. Whatever strikes a stricken body lands with greater force than it otherwise would.

rites.name: Lanialor Nesum
rites.text: A lasting discipline that hardens the bearer's defenses against blows and raises the limits to which they can resist the elements.

rites.name: Seranus
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a fighter strike harder against foes already crippled. It also gives blows a chance to cripple the enemy they land on.

rites.name: Riarnum
rites.text: A quiet inscribed discipline that strengthens the force of hexes laid upon foes. Practitioners carry it always, drawing sharper ill fortune from every binding they speak.

rites.name: Restia Telirnosum
rites.text: A lingering blight that clings to certain grim chambers and their warped variants during a dark phase. It shares its mark with a familiar technique.

rites.name: Orellintes
rites.text: A quiet discipline that quickens a fighter's strikes and deepens the harm of tainted wounds. Each blow carries a greater chance to seep a lingering toxin that gnaws at the victim faster.

rites.name: Milus
rites.text: A spell that calls forth a bound servant-spirit to fight beside its summoner. The rite can only be learned through a hidden sacred channel.

rites.name: Teosium
rites.text: A reproduction of an ancient burning power that a creature can call upon in battle. Its exact nature is only hinted at in the old records.

rites.name: Oriarolus
rites.text: A bestowed art lets a practitioner call forth a mighty herald of hidden magic. The gift is handed down by an unnamed giver.

rites.name: Viales
rites.text: A quiet, lasting craft that lets a wielder of rods strike harder with every blow. It is learned early and needs no conscious effort to keep.

rites.name: Ranornes
rites.text: A ritual craft that hurls several buried remains through the air, where they pierce foes and burst on landing to strike everything nearby.

rites.name: Orileria
rites.text: A ritual craft that raises a host of bone-bound wardens under the command of a single hollow captain. The rite draws its power from a volatile, forbidden well of essence.

rites.name: Mostanum
rites.text: A bonded discipline of the wardens that steadies the aim of a heavy fighter, granting sure strikes equal to double the body's might. Every fixed measure of precision also quickens the swing of the arm.

rites.name: Rarneoses
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that lends its bearer extra raw power in the body. It works without any conscious effort and steadily deepens the strength already present.

rites.name: Milles Amianor
rites.text: A ground-breaking technique in which a wielder slams the earth to set off a trailing tremor that bursts outward, striking a wider zone. Only one such tremor may linger at a time, and moving releases a few more.

rites.name: Lialor
rites.text: A ritual bolt of gathered force lances toward each foe nearby. Every enemy it fells leaves behind a surge of stored energy for the caster.

rites.name: Neollia
rites.text: A sorcerous rite that calls forth a mighty herald of savage violence. The summoned herald is bound to the caster's will for a time.

rites.name: Leria Nerus
rites.text: A dark discipline that lends the bound dead a surge of corrupting force. Those who master it find their servants strike with an added, poisonous power.

rites.name: Tesolus
rites.text: A simple inherent gift that raises the odds of a decisive, devastating blow whenever a bladed weapon is wielded. It is among the first skills a fighter learns.

rites.name: Siasteoria
rites.text: A quiet discipline that teaches the bearer to find the weakest point of an opponent. Mastery of it adds extra force to every decisive blow.

rites.name: Tillanium
rites.text: A gateway-working woven from two unnamed elements brought together into one combined effect. It opens a passage through the fabric of the world.

rites.name: Amaulostum
rites.text: A hardened bodily discipline that raises the vitality a person can hold. It also lets them shrug off chilling cold, binding ice, jolting shock, and searing flame more often.

rites.name: Telenum
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a loyal serpent creature to serve its caster as an ally. It is taught only through a single hidden source known to a select few.

rites.name: Solernium
rites.text: A practiced warrior drives a fist into the earth before them, sending a fan-shaped shock through the ground that harms everything caught within it. The wider the strike spreads, the more stored resolve the fighter has gathered.

rites.name: Coriantor Siania
rites.text: A creeping sickness that binds a traveler's feet whenever they stand still, growing heavier with each pause. Walking it off clears the burden one step for every layer that remains.

rites.name: Telaustolor
rites.text: A foundational discipline that quietly strengthens the blows of warriors who grip heavy blades or hammers with both hands. It adds force to every swing made with such two-handed arms.

rites.name: Vosia
rites.text: A sworn discipline that hardens a devoted warden against blows and steadily mends the wounds of both the warden and companions, drawn from each protective ward they keep active.

rites.name: Valestirnia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a fighter draw back life from every blow struck, and that raises how much life can be taken in and how steadily it flows.

rites.name: Veostanum Lestum
rites.text: A ritual flame craft in which a caster releases a ring of burning orbs, one after another, sweeping around their body in a turning circle until the full count is spent.

rites.name: Amialia
rites.text: A common inherited discipline that lets a fighter channel elemental force into their blade, strengthening every strike made with a weapon.

rites.name: Ameonanum Veolor
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a bound servant of the hour to fight beside its caster. Its use is restricted to those granted access through a sanctioned channel.

rites.name: Sauntiares
rites.text: A quiet, ever-present knack that lets a hunter fling snares faster and widens the ring around each one, so that prey wanders into the trap's grasp more readily.

rites.name: Corantaurus
rites.text: A quiet, lasting tradition that makes rod-bearing hands strike harder. Apprentices learn it early, and it adds force to every blow struck with a rod.

rites.name: Vantia
rites.text: A disciplined way of holding a long staff that strengthens its wielder's strikes and raises the chance of turning aside incoming blows. Those who have recently warded off harm gain added protective hardness in their armour.

rites.name: Sianeles
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a practitioner hold attention without drifting. It is found only within a single rare sacred stone that bestows random lessons.

rites.name: Nestium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that steadies the arms of one who wields a great blade with both hands, sharpening the force and aim of each heavy blow without needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Meolus Taunirnor
rites.text: A binding craft that quickens a sealed flame-charm so it ignites more often, though each burst lasts a shorter span. Practitioners set it into focus stones to trade endurance for rapid pulses.

rites.name: Valialus Coreonentes
rites.text: A quiet, steady discipline that strengthens a wielder's strikes whenever a bladed weapon is held in hand. It needs no effort to maintain and simply sharpens the force behind each cut.

rites.name: Tintus Coriasontus
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that appears only on certain relics bearing a special sigil, or on a charm carrying three random notable traits. It waits unseen until the bearer's craft is called upon.

rites.name: Vistosium
rites.text: A ritual bow technique that looses repeated waves of shafts skyward to rain down upon a chosen zone. Those struck are crippled, their stride slowed to a crawl.

rites.name: Vausor
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that lets a bearer raise carved guardians more swiftly. It also quickens the casting and striking of those guardians' own spells and blows.

rites.name: Serirnanum Miallium
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that quickens the hands of those who raise standing wards, and lengthens how long those wards endure before fading.

rites.name: Caullor
rites.text: A minor, always-on craft that lets a caster's staff-strike carry part of its force as scorching flame. Those who train it strike with a heat that burns on contact.

rites.name: Valirnium
rites.text: A quiet inborn talent that surfaces only in those who carry certain sacred marks. It is a steady, persistent gift that shapes how such a person learns.

rites.name: Telausor
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a wielder's aim and heightens the chance of devastating blows when swinging great two-handed blades and hammers. It multiplies the force of precise hits.

rites.name: Niantus
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a pale ghost-beast to fight beside its caller. Lesser charms grant a modest form of the rite, while one rare relic grants a stronger version, and a caller may bind only a limited number of such beasts at once.

rites.name: Manterium
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens the strikes and quickness of bound spirit-markers. Each marker raised also leaves nearby foes more vulnerable to harm.

rites.name: Serontum Telestia
rites.text: A sworn bargain that doubles how quickly a bearer draws vitality back from their wounds, yet silences the body's own slow healing entirely.

rites.name: Canteorus
rites.text: A lasting trait that a mark can be given only through a bound enchantment or a relic holding several random gifts. It grants a fierce, biting edge to the one who bears it.

rites.name: Teleorus
rites.text: A dark blessing spreads from certain tainted servants of the dead, sharpening the blows of everyone standing near them. Their strikes grow heavier in the presence of the cursed.

rites.name: Corelanus
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a loyal beast to serve its caller. The bond is granted only to those who learn it through a single hidden path.

rites.name: Coreosor Mestus
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a fighter who bears two blades hit harder and turn aside more blows. Each successful parry may stir a surge of fury or a reserve of stamina, and afflictions inflicted with both arms burn more fiercely.

rites.name: Teliantia
rites.text: A battle-discipline taught to war-leaders of the high kin. When a ground-shaking strike is delivered, a spectral fighter rises to repeat the blow after a short rest.

rites.name: Valases Rosernium
rites.text: A ritual technique that calls forth a mighty herald bound to the points of the compass. It is granted to practitioners who master its rites.

rites.name: Serenialium
rites.text: A dormant surge of arcane potency that wakes only within certain rare charms. It can be borne only by a charm bearing a specific binding inscription.

rites.name: Ceosor
rites.text: A discipline of the shield-bearer that grants a greater chance to stop incoming blows and gather a little extra inner energy each time a strike is turned aside. It also steadies the bearer after a block and strengthens the protection a shield offers.

rites.name: Veornastium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that is always active, reshaping the bearer's physical form, and it is drawn from a shared branching lineage of learned arts.

rites.name: Rintus
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a caster's rod strike more precisely and with greater force. It sharpens the chance of a decisive blow and deepens its impact.

rites.name: Nollistor
rites.text: A bladed strike that hurls a piercing shot through a foe, sending it outward. Spending stored metal fragments makes the shot break apart and strike several foes at once.

rites.name: Serinaullum
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that sharpens a wanderer's ability to slip past blows. It also hardens the body against elemental harm, especially frost.

rites.name: Lornes
rites.text: A close-quarters striking art in which the wielder swings a long two-handed blade through a full circle, harming every foe nearby and hurling them backward. It can only be performed while gripping a heavy weapon with both hands.

rites.name: Riarnausium
rites.text: A defensive technique that wraps the practitioner in a temporary shell which soaks up blows aimed at them for a brief span. It is taught to guardians who hold the front line.

rites.name: Raseolanum
rites.text: A channelled working that inscribes glowing marks upon the ground beneath a chosen spot, hindering any foe who stands among them. Once the caster lets go of the working, the marks erupt together in a crackling blast of lightning.

rites.name: Meleosus Raulastum
rites.text: A tiered chamber within a sacred hall where a rising storm is summoned and reshaped into a tainting wind. Its gusts spread that taint through the entire shrine while the trial lasts.

rites.name: Saserum
rites.text: A harmful surface condition that clings to the earth and slows the creatures that walk across it. Its sluggish effect builds up when combined with a frosty chill, though it never alters how quickly beings act, only how fast they travel.

rites.name: Oriasanum
rites.text: A rite that calls forth a loyal herald-spirit to serve the caster. The herald is bound through a sworn gate and can only be invoked by those who hold its key.

rites.name: Nesanum
rites.text: A quiet discipline taught to warriors who wield great blades in both hands. It sharpens the force of their strikes and quickens the rhythm of their swings.

rites.name: Vestia
rites.text: A tangling hex that leaves a afflicted being more vulnerable, so every blow it receives lands harder than it otherwise would.

rites.name: Orinostia
rites.text: A simple inborn craft that sharpens the force of blows struck with a long rod. It also lets the wielder find vital openings more often while holding such a rod.

rites.name: Niarnium Telastisum
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that strengthens the carved guardian idols a wanderer raises, hardening their vitality and steadying them against the four storm-forces of the land.

rites.name: Tentanum
rites.text: A ritual spell that draws the life from a fallen body to conjure a restless glowing sphere. The sphere seeks out foes nearby and bursts into searing flame when it strikes.

rites.name: Relium Ristanum
rites.text: A fighter's discipline that grows sharper with every blow turned aside in the last few moments. Blocking a mighty foe's strike unlocks a surge of raw striking force.

rites.name: Causanum
rites.text: A ritual strike in which a warrior swings a heavy blunt staff, turning part of the blow into bitter frost. The impact briefly raises a ring of ice around the struck foe.

rites.name: Orellia Meontia
rites.text: A quiet trained habit that lets a wanderer move swiftly across the land and sometimes slip free of being dazed by a blow.

rites.name: Teleonor
rites.text: A whirling storm-current is called forth and drifts unpredictably through the field, striking foes for a brief span. It answers reliably whenever a sky-bound surge of power takes hold within the wielder.

rites.name: Telarniares
rites.text: A basic innate craft that sharpens the chance of a decisive blow when the bearer grips a long rod of wood. It works across every strike made while the staff is held.

rites.name: Valestium Selum
rites.text: A quiet, steady art that lets the bearer of a staff-rod channel part of a strike's force into a biting chill. It is taught early and practiced by apprentices of many halls.

rites.name: Oreorausia
rites.text: A forbidden ritual that sacrifices a portion of the caster's vitality and ward to scorch nearby foes with flame. The fire burns longer the more lifeforce was offered.

rites.name: Relum Meollium
rites.text: A temple-taught discipline that sets aside a tenth of the practitioner's vitality to deepen wounds that are already bleeding. Thin beams reach toward up to five bleeding foes nearby, and each one drawn in restores a steady flow of strength that stacks with other restorative arts.

rites.name: Viallia
rites.text: A ritual burst of frost erupts outward from the caster, locking nearby foes in ice. A lingering chill then spreads across the ground, slowing anyone who enters it and feeding the caster's fury with each passing moment.

rites.name: Teonestor
rites.text: A passive gift bestowed upon those who rise to lead a people, drawn from a forest guardian's enduring strength. It flows quietly into the bearer's body.

rites.name: Amolestanum
rites.text: A lasting gift of inner attunement that sharpens frost and spark in the bearer's strikes, quickens the wellspring of arcane strength, and deepens the lingering hindrances laid upon foes.

rites.name: Mentum Oriranium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a loyal herald of savage violence to fight beside its caster. The rite is taught only through a hidden source of knowledge.

rites.name: Ameontia
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a flying skull wreathed in flame. The skull charges at foes, striking them for a limited time before it fades.

rites.name: Verum Vantus
rites.text: A ritual incantation that releases a widening ring of frost from the caster. The ring repeats its burst each time it strikes a foe.

rites.name: Telonternor
rites.text: A forbidden incantation that, once sealed in for a set span, hurls a great swarm of crackling bolts outward in every direction. Its power is drawn from a dangerous, unstable ritual.

rites.name: Vonia
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that lets carved guardian idols strike harder against foes. Those who train in it gain a steady boost to the force their sacred carvings deliver.

rites.name: Serauntium Ceonium
rites.text: A discipline of hurled piercing strikes that a wielder learns through sacred attunement. Each strike may leave a lingering wound that pins the foe in place.

rites.name: Linum
rites.text: A quiet discipline practiced by those who hold slender channeling staves. It hastens the rhythm of their strikes and sharpens their aim with such tools.

rites.name: Vastes
rites.text: A rare passive technique found only on certain carried relics, or on a bearer whose gear bears particular inscriptions. It is granted by fortunate combinations of three randomly chosen gifts.

rites.name: Rauntes
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a bound servant of hidden magic to fight beside its caster. The rite is only learned through a specific sacred source.

rites.name: Sirnia
rites.text: A sustained rite where a caster channels gathered force into orbiting spheres that strike a wide area in rapid pulses. Part of the blow turns into crackling charge as it lands.

rites.name: Contellanum
rites.text: A close-quarters ground-striking technique that sends a slow rolling surge of force across the earth in front of the wielder. Each surge bursts outward in rings that batter foes standing nearby, and the wave keeps advancing until a fresh one replaces it.

rites.name: Ciallium Ceolus
rites.text: A trained discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes and quickens their blows. It also steadies the body and grants a better chance to deflect harm while wielding paired blades or a guard.

rites.name: Amiarnor
rites.text: A lingering halo of restorative energy that flows out from the bearer, slowly mending the wounds of those who stand within its reach.

rites.name: Valauses
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a loyal tempest-herald to serve its caster in battle. The rite is taught only through a sealed, hidden source.

rites.name: Ameonesor
rites.text: A minor inherent craft that quickens the setting of carved markers and extends how far marked bindings can reach.

rites.name: Ceoriarnes
rites.text: A tempered discipline of a fighter who presses forward faster when guarded. While shielded by a bracing aura, the bearer strikes swifter, grows harder to wound and dodge, and cannot be staggered.

rites.name: Siasanum
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that slowly mends wounds, steadies the body against being knocked senseless, and adds raw physical might to its bearer.

rites.name: Teles
rites.text: A basic inborn knack that lets snares and hidden pitfalls strike harder without any effort from their makers. It works quietly in the background whenever such devices are set.

rites.name: Naulia
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a bear-like servant bound to the caster's will. The summoned beast fights alongside its master as a loyal ally.

rites.name: Vasum Coliror
rites.text: A discipline of buried traps that hit harder and fire faster, letting a wielder keep more of them laid at once. Each trap marks nearby foes so they suffer greater harm, and the marking builds with every trap that goes off.

rites.name: Oriantum
rites.text: A ward of crackling air that gathers on a defender's guard. Each time the bearer turns aside an assault, a jolt of stormlight leaps from the ward and arcs onward to strike nearby foes, and the ward's hold renews with every block.

rites.name: Teliasium Salliasium
rites.text: A ritual rite that consumes fallen bodies to lend a temporary sharpness to a summoner's bound servants, making their strikes more likely to land and hit harder.

rites.name: Rallus
rites.text: A common trained habit that lets a wielder strike harder and more truly when fighting with a blade. It needs no special study and is gained simply through steady practice.

rites.name: Orelium Taullus
rites.text: A binding curse that is cast over every foe within an area. It slows their movements and stretches out the time before their lingering enchantments fade away.

rites.name: Raniarnium
rites.text: A chanted rite calls forth a stone-bodied guardian of frozen crystal that sharpens its summoner's strikes and aim while it stands. It hurls a volley of jagged shards and spins through foes, leaving chilled ground behind.

rites.name: Oreonus
rites.text: A bound oath of challengers' pride that makes a marked adversary suffer greater harm while stripping away their slipperiness against blows. Their power to sidestep is lost, though their nimbleness in dodging remains untouched.

rites.name: Cintanum
rites.text: A basic passive craft that quickens a fighter's war cry and strengthens the blows they strike after it.

rites.name: Seraulus
rites.text: A basic passive discipline that quickens the battle cry and hastens how soon a warrior can call it again after its rest period ends.

rites.name: Riases
rites.text: A lasting inscription carved into the body that quietly strengthens the bearer's vitality and protective aura, while adding raw physical might.

rites.name: Veostes Meosanum
rites.text: A learned discipline that grants a warrior greater force, longer staggering blows, and quicker swings when wielding great two-handed blades and hammers.

rites.name: Taunus Cania
rites.text: A discipline of the body that rewards a warrior who has gone unstruck, granting firmer defense in stillness and sharper evasion once the blows have landed.

rites.name: Nellanum
rites.text: A rare inscribed talent carved only into large gem clusters. It empowers blunt striking tools, boosting their blows, afflictions, and chance of doubled force, along with the wielder's raw might.

rites.name: Vistelles
rites.text: A quiet, steady discipline that lets a fighter draw storm-fire into their blade. It is learned early and carried without effort.

rites.name: Soreontum
rites.text: A devotional flame-craft that lends fervent power to spellcasting for its practitioner and nearby companions. It occasionally consecrates the ground beneath foes who stand stronger than the caster.

rites.name: Lernanum
rites.text: A passive craft found only on rare relics bearing a particular sacred inscription. It strengthens lingering fire harm dealt by the bearer, amplifies it further while the bearer is aflame, and lets the bearer mend wounds faster during burning.

rites.name: Voleornus
rites.text: A battle cry that can be sounded in an alternate manner, serving as a variant way of projecting a warrior's shout to influence those nearby.

rites.name: Oranteollia
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the body, raising armour and vitality while sharpening close combat strikes and bodily might. It can only be bestowed by blessing a chosen object.

rites.name: Maurnes Narnoles
rites.text: A close-range striking technique that turns each blow into a random elemental force. The chosen element then unleashes a burst, a crackling arc, or a freezing wave.

rites.name: Vaurnia Orarium
rites.text: A quiet inner art that lies dormant in a single rare keepsake or in a bundle of random sigils. It grants its bearer a notable passive gift once the keepsake's enchantment is awakened.

rites.name: Sereornia
rites.text: A drawn-out incantation that repeatedly saps the pace of foes caught in its area, while a building frailty leaves them more open to corrupting harm.

rites.name: Nalostum
rites.text: A basic passive discipline that quietly lessens the wait between battle-cries and lengthens how long their effect endures.

rites.name: Rausia Vineoranum
rites.text: A quiet inherent discipline that sharpens the mind of anyone who practices it. It grants a steady boost to reasoning and understanding without any effort being shown.

rites.name: Tillia
rites.text: A chilling mark is set upon a chosen spot and clings to whatever it touches, slowly freezing its victim. When the bound foe falls or the mark fades, the stored cold bursts outward and strikes nearby enemies with the same total harm.

rites.name: Vontiases
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a fighter's battle-shout recover more swiftly after it is used. It is a common, simple trait among warriors who train it.

rites.name: Serelia Amanosus
rites.text: A lingering affliction that leaves a bearer more open to shadowy harm, and the damage builds the longer it clings on.

rites.name: Cinanum Cenus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets its bearer sustain one more lingering hex at a time. It was once a grander, foundational teaching before being refined into a lesser art.

rites.name: Ilotalramum
rites.text: Ilotalramum is the concept of the Seeding in Ameosastia, the hushed interval when makers sow the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath the soil of the world. It is less a force than a promise, a stillness in which every future act is held like breath before speech.

rites.name: Drunath
rites.text: Drunath is the concept of the Seeding in Ameosastia, the quiet hour when the makers plant the Weave and sleeping powers are stirred awake. Temples and orders of the Holy Age gather around it, treating it as the moment the world's flame was first given its shape.

rites.name: Vianum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that amplifies the force of protective presences a wielder projects. It works passively, strengthening whatever aura its bearer calls forth.

rites.name: Taullianor
rites.text: A practiced technique that conjures a ring of spinning phantom edges around its caster, striking nearby foes with harm for a short span of time.

rites.name: Orelor
rites.text: A foundational trained aptitude that raises a wearer's plated protection and the reserve of humming ward-light they can draw upon.

rites.name: Mausantia
rites.text: A slow-drifting orb of crackling storm energy is conjured and sent forward. As it moves, it periodically releases jolts that strike foes lying close to its path.

rites.name: Molles
rites.text: A bound blessing that clings to a creature and makes it impossible to finish off while it lingers. Its wardens must lure the marked beast away from its kin or strike it down directly to break the pack.

rites.name: Valirneonus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lifts the bearer's endurance and keeps hostile hands from draining their vitality away.

rites.name: Serialisum
rites.text: A trained fighting discipline that quickens a warrior's strikes and sharpens their aim. It lets the wearer move freely in heavy plate and braced shields, though bulky helms still slow them.

rites.name: Rarnialium
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets its bearer shrug off certain harmful afflictions more often, such as bitter cold, locking ice, crackling lightning, and sudden flame.

rites.name: Riantum
rites.text: A refined form of a common enchanted craft, awakened through deeper study. It can be obtained while traveling through the realm's wild regions.

rites.name: Vaustornia
rites.text: A passive gift that can only be found on certain relics or on sets of three random boons. It bestows an aura that numbs foes standing within a short distance of the bearer.

rites.name: Lentanum
rites.text: A chosen zealot's sacred rite projects a field around them that dulls foes' storms of fire, frost and lightning, while leaving those foes more open to such elemental harm within its reach.

rites.name: Amiastintor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that can only be awakened when a gathered cluster of sacred gems is set into a wanderer's path of training. It grants a lasting advantage to whoever cultivates it.

rites.name: Valelanum
rites.text: A learned ward-craft that lets a bearer of a carried shield draw more protective force from it. Those who have recently turned aside a blow also channel stronger sorcery, and holding the shield lets them deflect spells more often.

rites.name: Telonarum
rites.text: One of four harm sources that inflicts injury on foes according to the force of a held implement or bare fists. It can also draw its power from the guarding value of a protective plate.

rites.name: Morniantus
rites.text: A trained discipline of nimble footwork that lets a wanderer slip past incoming blows more often. Its cost is heavier wear on protective plating and weaker guard against spells.

rites.name: Taunastor
rites.text: A guardian's inherited discipline that thickens protective plating and barrier-light, while strengthening the lasting blessings the guardian sustains around allies, though not hexes.

rites.name: Mistium
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that sharpens a caster's chance to land decisive, devastating blows. It amplifies the force of each perfectly struck incantation.

rites.name: Tornia
rites.text: A ward-stone that lets a blade's strike draw crimson ruin from its foe. Wounds opened by it then flow more harshly, and the strike carries an added edge of iron.

rites.name: Coronus
rites.text: Two opposed battle postures a fighter can shift between by reactivating the same technique. Each posture grants its own bonus or penalty, and certain strikes change their effect depending on the posture in use.

rites.name: Tenum
rites.text: A simple inherited knack that lets a wielder of the long-string launcher strike harder and move with quickened stride. It is one of the most common foundational gifts taught to young hunters.

rites.name: Veleornor
rites.text: A quiet, constant practice that widens the reach of a person's workings. It also strengthens the harm carried by any wide-spreading part of those workings that inflicts injury.

rites.name: Contenia
rites.text: A stronger form of a known enhancing craft, which lends fiery force to its wielder's strikes. It can be found while exploring the wilder regions of the land.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: A dormant craft that hardens a warrior's protective plating and restores it steadily while a defensive stance is held. Foes struck by the bearer's blows lose much of their toughness.

rites.name: Niareonor
rites.text: A bound focus that amplifies the force of linked incantations while dulling their chance of striking with decisive, shattering precision. Strikes made through it gain little of that precision loss, only a lesser penalty.

rites.name: Taurnosanum
rites.text: A bound craft that lengthens how long a warrior's protective charges hold, strengthening their plating, barrier, and stamina together.

rites.name: Corares
rites.text: A steady inborn talent that quickens a warrior's strikes and sharpens their aim without any deliberate effort. It works silently, always active, lending swift and true blows to whoever carries it.

rites.name: Telostesor
rites.text: A ritual-bound charm that releases a burst of scorching flame when its bearer finishes off a foe or lands a critical strike. Each variant triggers under different conditions and needs a pause before it can fire again.

rites.name: Liranum
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that swells a warrior's reserve of arcane energy. Some of the harm a warrior endures is turned back into this energy.

rites.name: Teosanum
rites.text: A hardened discipline of the shieldbound that thickens a warrior's plating and lengthens the dazed stupor left in foes struck by their blows.

rites.name: Tauntanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a hunter's aim and quickens their steps, granting greater strength to their ranged strikes and a sturdier body to endure with.

rites.name: Valaurus Orernum
rites.text: A trained inner craft that lets a wielder dim the sight of foes they strike, dimming nearby foes too. The wielder cannot be dimmed in return and takes less harm from those left blind.

rites.name: Serilonum
rites.text: A dormant craft that sharpens a practitioner's command over fire, cold and lightning. It amplifies lingering afflictions inflicted on foes and softens their bite against the bearer.

rites.name: Aminaustium
rites.text: A quiet craft that empowers a bearer's blows against foes already frozen, shocked, or burning. It also makes those afflictions easier to inflict, though its bonus never grows beyond a fixed ceiling.

rites.name: Riarnium
rites.text: A trained gift that lets a fighter strike harder with the primary arm and quicker with the secondary arm. It works only when both arms carry a blade or when a guard is raised for a shield strike.

rites.name: Vernilus
rites.text: A innate martial gift that grows a wielder's raw power and aim while quickening their blows. It sharpens every strike the bearer delivers with steel or bare hands.

rites.name: Corareostes
rites.text: A hidden snare that, once sprung, turns the creature caught in it into a temporary companion of the one who set it. The bond fades after a short while.

rites.name: Corintornum
rites.text: A learned bearing-craft that lets a defender holding a shield strike harder, turn aside more blows, and sometimes gather a store of fortitude after felling a foe.

rites.name: Menolanum
rites.text: A combat-trained craft that lets a practitioner channel raw arcane force directly into battle. It grants its wielder a special capability within a fight.

rites.name: Cillor
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that sharpens a fighter's ability to slip past thrown missiles and bolts, while making them clumsier against close-quarters blows.

rites.name: Lernanium
rites.text: A learned warrior discipline that grants a fighter bonuses to draining life, striking harder, and swinging faster, activating only after a brutal blow has recently landed.

rites.name: Vones
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens strikes made with clawed hands, quickening their rhythm and their force. It also gives a chance to siphon small charges from a foe struck by those claws, and this effect layers on top of other similar boosts.

rites.name: Vallornum
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that makes a bearer's scorching harm hit harder, lights foes ablaze more often, and keeps those burns smoldering longer, while also magnifying the slow fire that eats at them over time.

rites.name: Raustia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that widens the reach of a practitioner's strikes, letting each blow spill its force across a larger ring of ground around the point of impact.

rites.name: Vernollus
rites.text: A basic trained discipline of an armoured warrior order that hardens the body's plating and extends how long protective resolve charges hold.

rites.name: Niaria
rites.text: A quiet discipline that quickens a caster's incantations while a shield is raised. It steadies the mind against lingering afflictions and staggering blows, and sharpens the strength of spells in proportion to how well the bearer turns aside harm.

rites.name: Cellisium
rites.text: A passive discipline that makes battle-cries strike without any delay, yet forces every such cry to wait on the others before it can sound again.

rites.name: Rauleonanum
rites.text: A basic discipline of the iron-hardened warrior that thickens its protective plating and quickens its strikes. It is practiced by those who wish to endure longer while striking faster.

rites.name: Amialleorus
rites.text: A passive discipline that widens the reach of close-combat strikes, and grows wider still after a foe has been stunned. It also extends weapon and bare-hand reach while softening the harm taken from blasts that strike an area.

rites.name: Nilliantus
rites.text: A lasting discipline that lets a warrior bearing a shield turn aside more blows, strike harder, and strike faster. Its bearers gain sharper strength in both defense and offense.

rites.name: Ceseostanum
rites.text: A bound vow that hardens a bearer's plating and shimmering barrier while lengthening the echo of their battle-shouts. It is a passive gift granted to those who keep the guardian's path.

rites.name: Montia
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a wielder's strikes when bearing a bladed weapon, making blows hit harder and find vital openings more often. It also deepens the harm carried by lingering wounds and poisons inflicted with that blade.

rites.name: Sausia
rites.text: A binding craft that lets a wielder raise one more guardian spirit beside them. The bearer, however, may only strike foes through those spirits, traps, or lingering snares, never by their own hand.

rites.name: Nosum
rites.text: A ritual binding that marks every foe within a region with a lingering wound of corruption. Each added hex deepens the affliction and extends its duration, though the binding itself does not count against the limit of hexes a caster may hold.

rites.name: Ceontanum Cestanium
rites.text: A discipline a sworn guardian learns to harden their defenses and magical barriers while their bound companions strike harder. It is taught as a basic training of the guardian's order.

rites.name: Cialarnus
rites.text: A quiet discipline that hardens the body's guard and deepens its reserve of vitality. It also steadily restores lost strength over time.

rites.name: Noliasanum
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that sharpens the odds of a precise, deadly blow and deepens the harm each such strike inflicts.

rites.name: Nenarium
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens the bearer's strikes with corrupting force while hardening them against the same unstable energy. It is a basic training taught to beginners.

rites.name: Ciarnia
rites.text: A notable inherited talent of the warrior-path that quickens the body's stride, blows, and dodging with each gathered surge of battle-fury.

rites.name: Contor
rites.text: A fierce martial discipline that sharpens a warrior's strikes to devastating force, at the cost of leaving them more exposed to harm in return.

rites.name: Nesus
rites.text: A trained discipline of the champion's order that raises the bulk of their guard and the wearing of their challenges. Those who master it hold enemies' attention for longer.

rites.name: Serellasum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a wielder of blunt clubs and staves strike harder and reach farther, and that widens the sweep of their trained techniques.

rites.name: Mausor
rites.text: A bonding craft that lends its wielder's linked techniques a stronger heat and a chance to set foes aflame. Those kindled by it lose much of their resistance to flame.

rites.name: Serelontus
rites.text: A searing affliction that clings to a bearer and varies with its origin. Some versions slow the afflicted and wear at their flesh in rising stacks.

rites.name: Varaustum
rites.text: A wielder slams the earth to unleash a burning shockwave that scorches the nearby ground into sacred, lingering terrain. Against distant foes, the wielder is drawn forward and reappears beside the target.

rites.name: Miastauntus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells the wellspring of a practitioner's arcane reserves and steadies their renewal. It also lends a portion of that reserve as a protective ward against harm.

rites.name: Lintaurnia
rites.text: A sour rite that calls forth a frigid beam from a sacred stone table. The beam weakens its target and seizes them in a numbing chill.

rites.name: Tiastanum
rites.text: A bone-woven protective craft that strengthens the summoned dead and hardens the caster against blows. It also raises a shielding guard that absorbs harm for the caster and every servant bound to them.

rites.name: Valiasium Raustales
rites.text: A knightly discipline that hardens the body's protective layers and sharpens the chance of piercing a foe with a thrust. It is taught only to those who have sworn to the champion's path.

rites.name: Amiallornus
rites.text: A steady inner knack that makes a drawn bow hit harder and lets its wielder loose shots in faster succession. It needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Amauseontor
rites.text: A guardian's training that hardens the body's plating and wards, letting its bearer turn aside a greater share of incoming blows.

rites.name: Villaustum
rites.text: A learned knack that shapes how a practitioner directs their gifts toward striking or weaving spells. It governs the manner in which certain abilities are brought to bear in combat and incantation.

rites.name: Sosia
rites.text: A quiet, innate knack that sharpens the odds of a decisive, lethal strike when wielding a short blade, and deepens the harm such a strike delivers.

rites.name: Serostanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that adds raw might to its bearer, giving a chance for each strike to pierce a foe and weakening that foe's armour against such piercing blows.

rites.name: Mirnontium
rites.text: A striking technique that builds stacking charges of fury with every blow that lands, and each charge swells the strength of the next strike. It may be used with any blade, bow, or bare hands.

rites.name: Sasia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes, lends extra cruelty to their blows, quickens their stride, and steadies their hand and aim.

rites.name: Vaurum
rites.text: A practitioner's inner craft that expands the reserve of arcane energy they can hold. When a sufficient amount of that energy has been spent lately, hexes laid upon them grow stronger, yet drawing from a restorative vial lifts one such hex away.

rites.name: Cialum
rites.text: A deferred binding craft that alters a cursing ritual. The hex first marks a brief ground circle, and every foe within it is cursed; when the circle collapses, the accumulated ruin falls fully upon those still standing inside.

rites.name: Lintanum
rites.text: A lingering affliction that slowly wears down anyone it touches. The harm arrives as disorder that spreads steadily through the victim over a span of time.

rites.name: Maulanum
rites.text: A binding craft that turns a drinker of life into a drinker of spirit-shield, doubling how fast the stolen spirit mends the wielder. The price is that the spirit-shield regrows only half as quickly on its own.

rites.name: Ciasallor
rites.text: A fighter's technique lets wounds gather on a foe up to eight times, though each gathered wound hurts less. The bleeding is weakened while the victim moves, yet a full stack of wounds bleeds with great force.

rites.name: Siastor
rites.text: A dark mystical craft that stores charged essence in a practitioner's body. Each stored charge widens the reach of their spells and strengthens their damage, and a charge forms again whenever a large reserve of mana is spent.

rites.name: Orarinium
rites.text: A quiet, constant training that makes a protective hardening stronger and longer-lasting. It lets its bearer shrug off more harm while the shield-state holds.

rites.name: Corestor Amastinus
rites.text: A ward that turns a blow back on whoever threw it, so the striker bears the harm they meant for another. Sometimes it is bound into traps or cursed objects, not only fighters.

rites.name: Molia
rites.text: A quiet inborn art that quickens a fighter's strikes and sharpens their aim. It also lends a measure of nimble grace to the hands.

rites.name: Testor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that hardens the body against elemental harm, thickening its plating while letting the wearer move more swiftly.

rites.name: Tiasaullor
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that only shows itself in certain relic blades or a few rare charms. It is passed along by a particular enchantment or by a set of three random gifts.

rites.name: Vaulleres
rites.text: A spell that hurls a fading bolt of bitter cold through every foe in its path. The bolt sometimes locks its target in ice, though that chance wanes the farther it travels.

rites.name: Telesia
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens aim, quickens strikes, and deepens harm when a warrior bears two blades at once. It also grants a stronger chance to deflect incoming blows during such a fight.

rites.name: Ceosaunus
rites.text: A battle cry that only a chosen warrior can sound, lending allies a flaming edge to their blows. A lesser echo of the same cry can be drawn out from the fallen and raised to serve.

rites.name: Corintoses
rites.text: A chilling close-quarters strike that reaches farther than the wielder's arm. Its blow also looses icy shards that fly past the struck foes.

rites.name: Neliror
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that sharpens a warrior's strikes when wielding a heavy cutting blade. It deepens harm to the foe and lengthens the wounds and afflictions the blade leaves behind.

rites.name: Amaurnialor
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a fighter's blows and quickens their strikes and incantations. It also hardens the body against lingering wounds and turns part of every physical blow into a corrupting, ruinous force.

rites.name: Valistium
rites.text: A learned chilling craft that sharpens the wielder's frost-bearing strikes and grants resistance to being frozen. Now and then it locks nearby chilled foes in ice and weakens their blows.

rites.name: Amaurinus
rites.text: A shifting field of influence that alternates between two states: one that wounds nearby foes and makes them more vulnerable, and another that blinds them and shields the bearer from outside attackers. Certain techniques change their effect depending on the active state.

rites.name: Serantisum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a bearer strike harder with heat, move faster when calling flame, and withstand more searing harm.

rites.name: Corausanum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that quickens a caster's incantations whenever both hands bear a weapon. It is taught early and carried by many fighters.

rites.name: Valelistum
rites.text: A linked craft that quickens the casting of bound incantations. When bound to a summoning rite, it hastens both the conjurer and the servants they call, though placed wards and set snares keep their own pace.

rites.name: Maurnus
rites.text: A dormant craft that lends a bearer greater chill in strikes, swifter throws, and a chance to lock foes in ice. Its frost lingers longer upon those it touches.

rites.name: Vornum
rites.text: A held discipline that quickens strikes when a guard is raised and lets blades pierce hidden resistances. It strengthens elemental force in attacks and hardens the protective bulwark carried in hand.

rites.name: Laulernus
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens a archer's strikes, raising physical harm from ranged shots. It also lengthens the harm of arrow arts and gives a chance to open wounds that bleed faster.

rites.name: Telesialum
rites.text: A glowing alternate sheen that wraps around a bearer's ward-marks, changing how their lesser enchantments take hold. It modifies the way protective aura charms behave when worn.

rites.name: Nistus
rites.text: A basic discipline taught to shadowy stalkers that sharpens the chance of a decisive, lethal blow and deepens their ability to slip away unseen.

rites.name: Ceosia Mallus
rites.text: A bound vow that sharpens the strikes of one's summoned followers, making them hit harder, truer, and faster. Now and then a follower's blow lands with twice its force.

rites.name: Amaurnes Serianium
rites.text: A layered guard that grants a random chance to turn aside a harmful strike. It is checked before a shield-like ward and is kept apart from the separate art of slipping past harm.

rites.name: Telastanum
rites.text: One of three kinds of charge tied to nimbleness, it briefly quickens a fighter's speed and zeal in battle. Its presence shows as glowing green orbs that circle the bearer.

rites.name: Siasteollia
rites.text: A trained bearing that lets a warrior strike harder and turn aside more blows while bearing a shield. Such a guard also hardens the protection the shield itself provides.

rites.name: Valaulia
rites.text: A passive art that lets a warrior sometimes hurl an opponent backward on each strike. Blows also send foes sliding farther away.

rites.name: Amiallor
rites.text: A battle-fury that drives a creature into a frenzy, quickening its strikes and strides and swelling its blows for a spell. It cannot be called again until a pause has passed.

rites.name: Tintum Caustirnia
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift that lets a bearer hold one more reserve of stored strength than others can. It rests passively in the body and needs no effort to maintain.

rites.name: Ristum
rites.text: A marksman's discipline in which arrows and bolts strike harder the longer they fly. Its practitioners bind this growing force to their projectiles as they travel.

rites.name: Seronintia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that amplifies a warrior's strikes and elemental force. Part of its might turns ordinary blows into searing flame, and spells of fire draw their heat from the same strength.

rites.name: Cialia
rites.text: A dark craft that hurls a bolt striking a little withering harm, then leaves a lasting rot that slowly steals strength. The caster slowly recovers some vitality from the rot.

rites.name: Risteornium
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a practitioner holding two blades strengthen their incantations and deflect hostile magic more often. It is considered a fundamental technique taught to beginners.

rites.name: Amausor
rites.text: A binding craft that spreads the elemental afflictions cast by a linked technique to foes standing close by. The lingering effect persists even after a fallen body remains whole.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: A passive craft that can be woven into a particular enchanted gear piece. It quickens strikes and spellcasting while sharpening physical blows.

rites.name: Talles
rites.text: A scorching force that is one of five harm-types and one of three elemental harms. A landed critical blow carrying it sets the target aflame, and its slower, lingering burn is classed as a harm over time.

rites.name: Serentanum
rites.text: A ward-craft that opens a passage between worlds, drawn from a set of taught arts. It is valued highly among those who practice such workings.

rites.name: Serisor
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a practitioner's resistance to lingering elemental afflictions. It lengthens the hold such afflictions have on foes and strengthens the force of elemental strikes.

rites.name: Corinum
rites.text: A quiet inherent craft that lies dormant within certain enchanted vessels. It is awakened only in a relic bearing a particular binding, where it grants its wielder a lasting refinement.

rites.name: Seorintanum
rites.text: A linked craft-stone that sharpens the working of the abilities it is bound to. Each binding draws out a little more refinement from the skill it accompanies.

rites.name: Sollaurus
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that strengthens every elemental strike, pierces the defenses of foes against elements, deepens the lingering harm of hindering afflictions, and enlarges the burning that continues after each blow.

rites.name: Orauriantes
rites.text: A withering dread radiates outward from its wielder and slowly corrodes the spirit of everything nearby. It is bestowed through a dark bargain or a sacred gift.

rites.name: Orollum Reostintia
rites.text: A fighter who strikes down a foe is instantly refilled with vital essence, and each fallen enemy grants its own separate surge. Surges do not arise when allies or summoned constructs deliver the final blow.

rites.name: Reollia
rites.text: A learned discipline of the Sworn that grants its practitioners heightened strength against the raw forces of fire, frost, and lightning. It sharpens their own elemental strikes.

rites.name: Nernus
rites.text: A fighter's inner discipline that makes every blow more likely to land decisively and strike harder, but forbids wearing any headgear. It also lets foes' decisive strikes against the practitioner count as fortunate for them.

rites.name: Rausinor
rites.text: A minor sworn discipline that quickens a warrior's strikes and lets each blow draw a portion of its force back as arcane energy. The gain grows while the draining is active.

rites.name: Telonaulor
rites.text: A notable trait of the war-mad warriors that stirs fury each time a blow lands on a foe, with a brief pause before the next surge. It also widens the reservoir of fury a fighter can hold.

rites.name: Tialleonium
rites.text: A baseline inner discipline that lets a wanderer slip past blows more readily and steady themselves against the raw forces of fire, frost, and lightning. It requires no effort to maintain once learned.

rites.name: Moles Coses
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by the Wayfinder order that enhances how potions take hold and how quickly their charges return. It is taught as a core teaching of the path.

rites.name: Orellia
rites.text: A discipline of inner attention that is awakened only by certain enchanted trinkets worn upon the body. Without such a charm fastened in place, the practice remains closed to the bearer.

rites.name: Liarnus
rites.text: A learned knack that sharpens the aim of its bearer's strikes. Blinded foes suffer harder, more lethal blows, and each successful hit has a chance to dazzle the opponent.

rites.name: Ameontes Teostiarnor
rites.text: A quiet, lasting gift carried by a warrior, sharpening the bite of icy strikes and piercing foes' frost-warding. It also deepens the numbing chill left behind after each blow.

rites.name: Ameonoles
rites.text: A fading mark that slowly wears away a person's defenses for a short span. While it lingers, the afflicted takes harder blows from every strike.

rites.name: Teontor
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that hardens the followers bound to its bearer, granting them added resistance to corrupting forces and a reserve of spiritual ward. Their fallen foes sometimes leave behind a surge of dark fervor.

rites.name: Valeolesus
rites.text: A bound craft that lets a practitioner animate more stone guardians at once. Each guardian raised shields its maker from elemental harm and steadies the mind against elemental afflictions, while strengthening the guardians' own enchantments.

rites.name: Telaulia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sometimes stores a fierce surge with each fallen foe. It keeps a bare minimum of that surge ready at all times, and every stored surge strengthens the blows that follow.

rites.name: Serisia
rites.text: A channeling craft that makes afflictions strike harder over time, while the first blow it lands is weaker.

rites.name: Telenus
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wielder of great two-handed blades strike harder. It also sharpens blows against foes nearly spent, and widens the sweep of a swing after a recent kill.

rites.name: Amaulus
rites.text: A bound craft that drives servants into a ravenous hunt, sending them to seek out foes and tear them down. Each strike may rouse a surge that quickens and strengthens every ally who serves the same master.

rites.name: Tintes
rites.text: A dying creature or lifeless body bursts outward in a blast that harms foes standing close by. The strength of the blast grows with the creature's full vitality, and no remains are left behind.

rites.name: Leostium
rites.text: A linked craft that hardens a warrior's stance during close strikes, softening incoming blows by a fifth. It works only on deliberate, hand-to-hand techniques and fails when the force is summoned by a trigger.

rites.name: Taronia
rites.text: A passive discipline found only in large or medium clustered relics. It sharpens the strikes and lingering afflictions of blunt staves and maces, and its reach slowly swells while the wielder holds still, up to a fixed ceiling.

rites.name: Amiasor
rites.text: A chilling incantation that carries its caster instantly to a chosen spot, striking with bitter cold and leaving a frozen trail along the path travelled. Its readiness returns more swiftly each time it wounds an opponent.

rites.name: Reorania
rites.text: A weakening hex that leaves its victims striking with a tenth less force and moving with a fifth less swiftness. It saps the strength and pace of anyone it touches.

rites.name: Caulentanum
rites.text: A drain that wears down a being's vitality or protective ward until it runs out. Certain elemental guards soften each strike, and bindings can raise those guards past their usual limit.

rites.name: Lonteonor
rites.text: A bonding craft that strengthens a chosen strike whenever its wielder stands at complete vitality. A single wound of lost vigor silences the surge entirely.

rites.name: Seolauror
rites.text: A learned discipline that strengthens the stone servants bound to its practitioner. Each bound servant endures more harm, strikes harder while called forth, and lends greater aid to its allies, and one additional servant may be commanded at once.

rites.name: Coraulor
rites.text: A searing mark that a holy foe lays upon its target, slowly scorching them with burning heat over time. Some dire guardians wield it, and its glow can be mistaken for a plain beam of fire.

rites.name: Orantia
rites.text: A chilling incantation hurls a rimed relic that bursts on impact, leaving a slowing frost that drifts toward nearby foes and numbs them over time.

rites.name: Veontor Tontelor
rites.text: A quiet inherited art that lets a bearer keep a lingering charge going after an initial act. It is found only in certain bearers who carry a binding of enchantment, and it is shaped by a few chance-chosen traits.

rites.name: Valilus
rites.text: A bearer's nimbleness and practiced skill, measured as a single trait. It governs the use of nimble gear and techniques and grants steady gains in striking precision and the ability to slip past blows.

rites.name: Tausor Lostanum
rites.text: A lasting kinship that extends how long allied companions remain at one's side. Companions also strike harder when they have recently acted on command.

rites.name: Maurnor Serausium
rites.text: A minor inner discipline that sharpens the bearer's chance to land a decisive blow and lengthens how long their gathered essence lingers. It is studied by those who train in silent killing.

rites.name: Mauses
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens strikes and incantations and sharpens defensive parrying for one who bears a blade in each hand. It is taught early to those who fight with paired weapons.

rites.name: Sirnes Vausor
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a caster channel stronger spells and move more swiftly while carrying a blade or focus in each hand. It is taught as a simple foundational practice.

rites.name: Orasanum
rites.text: A lasting discipline that hardens a bearer's protective plating, deepens a shimmering barrier of spirit, and renews that barrier more quickly. It also lends extra resistance against the elements.

rites.name: Oreostum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wielder of a long rod turn some incoming magic and blows aside, while sharpening their own spells. Occasionally a parried strike fills the holder with a brief, fierce strength.

rites.name: Neoselanum
rites.text: A quiet inner gift lets a wielder draw back a portion of their spent arcane strength whenever their strikes land. It also strengthens how swiftly that reclaimed strength flows back in.

rites.name: Telausires
rites.text: A chant that calls a stony effigy to stand before its caster. The effigy slowly turns nearby foes to rock.

rites.name: Telonum
rites.text: A guardian's inherited blessing that softens harm from storms and fire. It steadily restores vials of healing draughts and sometimes spares their contents from being spent.

rites.name: Amollauntor
rites.text: A hunter's curse that brands one chosen quarry, so that every strike against it hits harder and restores vigor to the striker. The marked prey shrugs off less harm, and its fall leaves a surge of fury behind.

rites.name: Resaullus
rites.text: A warrior's inner talent that turns the force of each blow into searing heat. At intervals it adds further burning harm sized to how hard the strike landed.

rites.name: Tiarintium
rites.text: A dormant force that stirs within a warrior after each fallen foe, granting a one-in-five chance to store a fresh measure of strength.

rites.name: Cisanum
rites.text: A learned rite of the dark caster that lengthens the hold of their spells and lets the blessings of ritual offerings flow back to the caster, though more faintly.

rites.name: Mauloses
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that hardens the body's protective plating and shield-like aura while steadily mending wounds. It also strengthens both the arm and the mind of those who practice it.

rites.name: Malleosum
rites.text: A passive knack that sharpens a caster's sorcerous force, adds a shimmering protective veil, speeds the restoration of arcane reserves, and deepens the wielder's reasoning. It can only be awakened by blessing a chosen object with sacred oil.

rites.name: Rauntor
rites.text: A quiet gift that quickens a wielder's strikes with long rods and sharpens their aim. It also weakens an opponent's armor against blows.

rites.name: Corialum
rites.text: A bound flame is called upon by its bearer, scorching the bearer and everyone close by. The fire grows fiercer as the bearer's vitality and ward grow, and it sharpens the bearer's sorcery while it burns.

rites.name: Seriarnus
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that enlarges a caster's reserve of arcane energy and strengthens the force of their spells. The greater the reserve, the more the spells gain in strength, up to a set limit.

rites.name: Seornum
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes, quickening blows and steadying aim, and deepens the lingering harm that attacks inflict.

rites.name: Aminerum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that steadily mends the body and sharpens the blows of one's followers. It also restores the wearer's own vitality over time.

rites.name: Miastium
rites.text: A quiet, constant renewal that slowly restores a wielder's inner reserves and vitality without any deliberate effort. It is a basic, always-active gift that needs no spoken incantation.

rites.name: Montium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that reshapes how a practitioner's skill draws upon the vital essence of foes. It is acquired through a paid offering of tokens.

rites.name: Vistanum Ameorum
rites.text: A bonding rite that empowers a caller's summoned servants with greater strength. Marking a foe directs those servants to converge upon it and strike it with added force.

rites.name: Veleosium
rites.text: This is a secondary skill effect, a variant form of a known technique. Its exact workings are not described in the source.

rites.name: Orelium
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that quickens the hand and deepens the strike of those who channel elements through rods. It also lets blades slip past the wardings that guard against such magic.

rites.name: Oreosolles
rites.text: A dormant inner current that sharpens elemental strikes and lets blades pierce through hostile resistances. It also shields the wielder from elemental harm bounced back at them and swells elemental force while a restorative draught is working.

rites.name: Miasus Meontus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a caster keep their focus when stunned mid-incantation. It also grants a boost to brute force and nimble hands.

rites.name: Oralistum
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner's reserve of inner energy shields the body, soaking up part of every blow before it can wear down flesh. It forms a core pillar of a defensive craft that places reserve above vitality.

rites.name: Nirenium
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that sharpens a practitioner's nimble hands and steady movements without any deliberate effort. It works quietly in the background, always ready when skill is needed.

rites.name: Cistes Cesalus
rites.text: A learned skill that strengthens elemental force channeled through staves and lets blades pierce elemental wards. It also softens elemental harm to a bearer who stands still.

rites.name: Sistanum
rites.text: A shimmering aura that a caster sustains around themselves and nearby companions. It strengthens each of them against the harmful energies of the elements.

rites.name: Amaurnium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the caster's arcane force, granting stronger incantations along with greater mental acuity and a deeper reservoir of mana.

rites.name: Amaustium Coraures
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that sharpens a wielder's clawed strikes and lets each blow more often seep lingering venom into the foe. The venom then festers longer and deals more harm over time.

rites.name: Valanum Telaunestor
rites.text: A quality of blows that wears down a defender's ward against certain harms. It lets strikes slip past the shielding that would otherwise blunt them.

rites.name: Telontauria
rites.text: A tuned binding that lets arrows and bolts shot by linked techniques pass through whatever they strike. It works only on missiles conjured by the skills it is bound to.

rites.name: Sarnia
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens the strikes of a warrior whose guarded stance has been bolstered by a protective ward. It works only while that defensive blessing holds.

rites.name: Sostor
rites.text: A deadly technique practiced by shadowy killers that lets their blades spread lingering venom more readily. Each dying victim refreshes the striker's vigor in proportion to how heavily they were tainted.

rites.name: Oraustarnus
rites.text: A devotional discipline that restores a seeker's inner reserve more swiftly while sharpening the strikes of marked sigils. It is taught to initiates of the high cloisters as a passive grace.

rites.name: Nelleostum
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a practitioner who has recently fed on a corpse widen the reach of their spells and their servants' attacks. Nearby the dead, allies grow stronger while foes are weakened, and the effect shows as a visible glow on everyone it touches.

rites.name: Teliaria
rites.text: A single-target binding craft that marks one foe at a time, and only one such mark may rest upon any creature. Its power is not weakened by the strength of the bearer.

rites.name: Teloresus
rites.text: A lingering aura that sows wild frenzy among foes standing close by. Those caught within it move more sluggishly and strike with weaker blows.

rites.name: Valantinia
rites.text: A trained fighter's discipline that rewards a slain foe with a surge of fury or a reserve of stamina, shaped by the hand that struck. At full fury the warrior hits harder, and at full reserve the warrior takes less harm.

rites.name: Teollia
rites.text: A caster raises a standing sentinel that weaves glowing flame-lines between itself and every other sentinel bound to the caster. Foes who brush against these lines are slowly scorched over time.

rites.name: Mastum Vianestus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a practitioner's reservoir of arcane force and lets them turn aside spells. The more often they deflect such workings, the faster their reserves refill.

rites.name: Coriarum
rites.text: A quiet, constant inner gift that slowly restores a bearer's reserve of arcane force and steadies their vitality. It needs no effort to keep working.

rites.name: Tausternus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that rests dormant within a practitioner's lattice of learned gifts. It surfaces only when certain attuned gems are set into that lattice, and it can be called forth through a particular sealing rite.

rites.name: Cisaustanum
rites.text: A innate discipline of bodily strength that lets its bearer strike harder and shrug off blows that bounce back at them. Sometimes a single strike lands with twice its force, and it weakens an opponent's armored resistance to physical blows.

rites.name: Seranum Teranum
rites.text: A quiet, innate knack that lets a wanderer slip away from blows and cross the ground more swiftly. It needs no training to hold, and it simply lightens the body's movement.

rites.name: Tantor
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that enlarges how much vitality a bearer can hold and speeds the return of their inner energy. It also steadily mends the body over time.

rites.name: Coreosarnia Telaustor
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a fighter strike harder and faster when wielding a single short weapon in one hand. It also extends to certain close-quarters casting rods.

rites.name: Corosestor
rites.text: A reserve of protective flame and frost that absorbs fiery and icy blows before the wearer's flesh or spirit is touched. It refills fully after a quiet span free of such strikes.

rites.name: Corenium
rites.text: A caster lays down a crackling sphere of energy that periodically strikes nearby foes with lightning. Casting another storm spell inside its reach makes the sphere pulse faster.

rites.name: Nesus Malauntium
rites.text: A quiet, lasting inner discipline that enlarges a practitioner's reserve of arcane energy. It also lowers the energy each working draws from that reserve.

rites.name: Orastialium
rites.text: A trained discipline that lets a fighter who carries a guard strike harder and faster, with a growing chance to turn aside blows. It also toughens the guard itself, hardening its plating and strengthening its protective charge.

rites.name: Oristum
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that sharpens a wielder's blade work with short knives, lending heavier strikes, more frequent lethal blows, deeper wounding and surer aim.

rites.name: Amaullium Tintiarnus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a fighter slip past blows more readily while striking harder at close quarters. It needs no training to keep active.

rites.name: Oriallor
rites.text: A tactical hunter's technique where precise cuts that draw blood mark foes with a fragile wound. Marked foes suffer more from their bleeding, which fades quicker, and up to three such marks may cling to one target.

rites.name: Telaurnisum
rites.text: A grasped discipline that lets a wanderer's venom grow far more potent when a restorative draught is in effect. When a foe falls, its strongest blight leaps onto every creature standing close by.

rites.name: Riastes
rites.text: A singular discipline that grants its bearer a foundational method of bodily command. Its teaching becomes a core part of one's personal training path.

rites.name: Taules
rites.text: A ritual discipline that multiplies the benefits of a warrior's fury while the fury burns high, granting immunity to being staggered. The rage slowly drains the bearer's vitality, and this drain cannot be warded off.

rites.name: Raneontum
rites.text: A bound charm that lets a close-combat technique stir up fury in its wielder. The gathered fury then sharpens each blow with added physical force.

rites.name: Nirnes
rites.text: A trained fighting discipline that lets a warrior deflect blows more often while wielding a blade in each hand or bearing a shield. It also quickens strikes made with single-handed arms and rods.

rites.name: Vesones
rites.text: A quiet, enduring discipline that softens the force of blows against the body. It can only be awakened by ritually blessing a charm or a singular relic of the blight.

rites.name: Ameosium
rites.text: A lingering affliction that weakens a bearer over time. It is known among those who study it by a second, hidden designation.

rites.name: Viarneranum
rites.text: A bonding rune that can be fixed to a close-combat striking craft. When the strike lands, its force spills outward and harms the foes standing near the one that was hit.

rites.name: Veostium
rites.text: A trained skill of the marksman's inner craft that sharpens the force of thrown or loosed shots and raises the chance of striking a fatal blow.

rites.name: Valliarnium
rites.text: A sworn discipline that lets a chosen initiate gain two extra points of training and direct them from a set starting station across the wide lattice of their craft.

rites.name: Telasor
rites.text: A singular gift that grants its bearer a keystone of enduring calm, woven into the bearer's passive growth.

rites.name: Rirnes
rites.text: A rare inborn talent that sharpens a leader's orders so they land exactly as intended. It can only be found on one special kind of gem set into a bearer's gear.

rites.name: Cantirnus
rites.text: A sustained spell that projects a searing beam of heat from the caster's hand, setting foes ablaze before them. Enough repeated strikes weaken a target's resistance to flame.

rites.name: Amilianor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens a warrior's strikes and deepens their harm while a shield is held. It also hardens the shield-bearer's guard, adding to the protection the shield provides.

rites.name: Corosor Solium
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that sharpens a wanderer's dodging and steadies their ward of spirit and flesh. It also slowly knits wounds closed over time.

rites.name: Valarnia
rites.text: A rare inner gift carried in large gems, it strengthens blunt striking weapons and grants a brief hardening after each successful blow.

rites.name: Ceorus Ciniarnum
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner's spells grow stronger as their vitality wanes. Those who train in it learn to draw power from their own dwindling strength.

rites.name: Nereostor
rites.text: A linked bow technique that calls forth a spectral archer. When an enemy is struck by the empowered shot, a fleeting phantom marksman appears overhead and fires the same technique for a short while.

rites.name: Sorum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a wielder's burning and freezing strikes, lets blows land more often with lethal precision, and hardens the body against both searing heat and biting chill.

rites.name: Corisanum Nenorum
rites.text: A bearer's raw bodily might, which governs the gear and techniques they can wield. It also grants a steady rise in endurance and in the force of close-quarters blows.

rites.name: Oriarium
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a wanderer carry an extra reserve of breath and strength before tiring. It works without any conscious effort from its bearer.

rites.name: Melliantus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets them fix an extra mark onto a foe, at the cost of reducing how many guardian stones they can keep standing.

rites.name: Coraresium
rites.text: A rare inherited technique that channels the harm already clinging to a foe into a surge of raw elemental force. Its strength rises with the frost, flame, and lightning currently afflicting the target.

rites.name: Lolernor
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that binds a bearer's servants to the bearer's own vitality. It mends wounds over time, steadies them against harmful forces, and lets them endure more, while also restoring the bearer's strength.

rites.name: Coreolenor
rites.text: A steady inner discipline that raises the chance of turning aside blows while a shield is held. It also sharpens strikes and hardens the bearer against elemental harm.

rites.name: Sontia Orellor
rites.text: A learned craft by which a practitioner gathers and bends the restless air to raise tempests. It is taught as an inner discipline among those who command the elements.

rites.name: Reollarium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the strikes of hooked talons, letting each wound return a trickle of vitality and inner spark to the wielder. The mending it gives also flows back faster over time.

rites.name: Telontor
rites.text: A bygone talent of a sorcerer's inner craft that cycles through a timed surge, causing every blow to kindle fire, frost, or lightning. It was later split into three separate gifts.

rites.name: Soneontor
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practitioner bends heat and fire to their will. It is cultivated by those who serve the elemental arts in the old orders.

rites.name: Rillaunus
rites.text: A sorcerous snare is hurled to lash onto foes nearby, where each bound foe slowly suffers a bitter frost. The caster is refreshed with vitality and arcane energy for every binding that holds.

rites.name: Mellus
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lets its bearer shake a foe's senses more easily. It is a simple, ever-present gift rather than a learned rite.

rites.name: Seraustia
rites.text: A buried snare that is set off by a spoken charm and sends several rippling pulses through the ground. Each pulse batters nearby foes with crushing force for a short while.

rites.name: Reonus Ameoristes
