rites.text: A basic innate gift that quietly raises the odds of a devastating surge of power whenever a caster weaves a spell. It needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Ranes Sillia
rites.text: A learned warrior's craft that sharpens a fighter's blows and quickens swings when wielding a chopping blade. Harmful afflictions inflicted by strikes grow stronger, and each felled foe may spark a surge of fury.

rites.name: Lirantia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a caster's sorcery strike harder on its most decisive moments. It requires no active invocation, persisting as a steady, untaught gift.

rites.name: Lentor Saranum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that holds the bearer's impulses in check. It can only be gained through a special gemstone set into a cluster of linked stones.

rites.name: Mialia
rites.text: A sealed foretelling that bestows a changed chart upon its holder. When two foretellings compete, this one takes precedence over the other.

rites.name: Riarasus
rites.text: A dark enchantment that transforms a wielder's blows into corrupting essence, and it has a chance to leave the struck foe weakened.

rites.name: Nosaustor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a caster's rod channel greater elemental force. It is a basic technique that raises the power of such rods when they are used to unleash the elements.

rites.name: Valentes
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that sharpens a fighter's aim and deepens the damage of every decisive blow they land across all their battles.

rites.name: Toses
rites.text: A reflex strike that sometimes erupts when a warrior is struck, lashing out at every foe nearby. It cannot be called upon at will and needs a hand-held blade to function.

rites.name: Orallanum Orenes
rites.text: A trained discipline that lets a warrior strike harder and faster when gripping a great blade or drawing a longbow with both hands. It rewards those who commit fully to heavy, two-armed weapons.

rites.name: Tianintor
rites.text: A coined art of slow, creeping dread that works like a familiar ritual but strikes with a raw, unraveling force.

rites.name: Cernauria
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that sharpens a bearer's nimbleness and deftness of limb. It needs no call or effort to keep working and simply strengthens the bearer's agility.

rites.name: Valilaranum
rites.text: A practitioner's trained technique that strengthens strikes made with a slender focusing rod. It quickens the hand while the rod is held, and it lets a caster's inherent power bolster physical blows as well as spells.

rites.name: Amellor Cistium
rites.text: A ritual ward that, for a short span, keeps its bearer from falling beneath a single remaining breath of life. It is a spell drawn from the dark arts of the old sundered orders.

rites.name: Vauntolus
rites.text: A practiced art that calls forth a ghostly servant bound to its caller's will. The conjured shade fights beside its summoner and vanishes when the working ends.

rites.name: Oronanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a wielder's endurance and lowers the strain each deliberate act places upon them. Its practitioners carry it as a lasting, unspoken gift.

rites.name: Vaulleornia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that strengthens the effects of a bracing ward, deepening its hold while the bearer stands still. It also hardens the bearer's plating while that ward is active.

rites.name: Nesteollium
rites.text: A sacred aura that briefly lets a wielder and nearby companions slip past incoming blows and spells. It is drawn from a surge of spent inner power.

rites.name: Valiaralor
rites.text: A forbidden binding that drags nearby foes toward a chosen spot while storm-fire scorches them. No new copies of it are made anymore, so only old ones still circulate among holders.

rites.name: Seronor
rites.text: A deep innate discipline that lets restorative draughts also mend a protective barrier, though each mending is weaker. The restorative effect fades once the body is wholly healed.

rites.name: Corastiasum
rites.text: A quiet inner art that quickens thrown force and sends each strike winging back to its caster. It can only be bound into a charm or a keepsake blessed by a particular sage.

rites.name: Sauriallium
rites.text: A basic passive craft that lets a warrior strike faster when gripping a heavy blade with both hands. It is learned early by those who wield great melee arms.

rites.name: Coraunontia
rites.text: A bound craft that quickens the lingering harm of linked spells, making their sting bite harder while shortening how long the curse holds.

rites.name: Morines
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that raises the bearer's maximum vitality. It also lowers the arcane cost of the bearer's techniques.

rites.name: Terauntia
rites.text: A binding ward that brands one chosen foe with a lingering hex. Blows against the branded victim may leave them staggered longer, stir fury in the striker, and siphon vitality and mana, while the victim's fall bestows a surge of resilience upon the one who struck.

rites.name: Malus
rites.text: A quiet fighting technique that lets a bearer of blunt weapons deal extra harm and hold foes dazed longer when they strike a healthy opponent. It also sometimes doubles the stagger, and weakens the armour that shields the target from blows.

rites.name: Valialaures
rites.text: A battle technique that channels spectral ancestors into a cascading strike, hitting harder than its plainer kin. It lets the wielder lunge across distance to reach foes beyond normal range.

rites.name: Mintium
rites.text: A trained technique for wielding great blades and longbows with greater force. Each strike that lands also draws a measure of vitality back into the wielder.

rites.name: Varium Orostia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a wielder's reserve of arcane energy. Each fallen foe refills that reserve further, and a share of every blow is drawn back as spent power.

rites.name: Corintellus
rites.text: A quiet inborn talent that lies dormant in certain bearers, granting a standing edge whenever they carry a charm or are marked by a sacred sign.

rites.name: Oraullium
rites.text: A keystone discipline that converts half of frost and storm harm into searing harm. Its wearer pays for this with reduced defenses against both frost and storm.

rites.name: Valelanum Menolia
rites.text: A heavy strike technique in which a fighter crashes into the earth, sending a shockwave rippling outward that flings nearby foes backward and leaves them dazed.

rites.name: Seraustum Amanerus
rites.text: A ritual working that ignites a fallen body and every other corpse nearby in a chain of bursts. The blasts scorch everything around them with searing heat.

rites.name: Coriallum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that alters a being's essence without outward effort. It is drawn from either a worn relic or a branching path of learned disciplines.

rites.name: Niarum
rites.text: A calming passive discipline that grants a strong ward against heat and turns some blows into burning harm. It also stops kindled flames from hurting its bearer and speeds healing after a fiery strike.

rites.name: Tontisium
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a bearer carry one extra reserve of stamina at all times. It works without being called upon, sustaining the body through long toil.

rites.name: Cintum Meonum
rites.text: A basic trained discipline that a warrior of the blade learns to strengthen their grip on great two-armed arms and longbows. It also widens the reach of their strikes and spells across a broader ground.

rites.name: Montes Talaurnes
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that lets a carved guardian stake be planted more swiftly and kept standing longer, its strikes hitting harder as a result.

rites.name: Lentus Amerum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting craft that lets a wielder of long rod-shaped implements strike harder with them. It is a simple, innate knack practiced by many who carry such tools.

rites.name: Niasus
rites.text: A minor alternate effect that reshapes how a skill strikes, sold for a small fee in a traveling merchant's shop. Its exact purpose is tied to another skill it modifies.

rites.name: Orasteontes
rites.text: A quiet, practiced knack that lets a wielder strike faster and harder, with a chance to pin foes on each blow. It also weakens the armor that protects a victim from such piercing strikes.

rites.name: Cillus Rostor
rites.text: A dark sorcerous working that tears open a gateway through the air exactly where its caster stands. The rift lets travelers step between distant places.

rites.name: Sornialles
rites.text: A passive mark that is found only on certain rare trinkets bearing a particular enchantment. It strengthens the auras of three other kinds of blessing.

rites.name: Valelus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a practitioner move faster, strike truer and find hidden openings more often. It also sharpens nimble reflexes and a keen mind.

rites.name: Voliaranum
rites.text: A rare inherited talent that lets a fighter sometimes pierce foes with each blow and cause wounds that bleed. Wounds that bleed also deepen the piercing harm done.

rites.name: Velia Saurillanum
rites.text: A spell that sets a crackling sigil upon the ground. Whatever it clings to is struck by lightning, and the bolts leap onward to nearby foes.

rites.name: Narnes Amires
rites.text: A dread that settles on a foe after a blow from a crested beast, dragging down the pace of their spellcraft and their ranged strikes.

rites.name: Mallanum
rites.text: A withering hex that settles over everyone in a region, leaving them open to heavier blows. Strikes against the marked foes may also tear open wounds, and the lingering afflictions they suffer press harder.

rites.name: Ceonolanum
rites.text: A basic innate art that lets a bearer's blade carry a bitter chill, striking harder with frost. In some cases it turns the force of a blow into icy harm.

rites.name: Monastanum
rites.text: A dim, cold-tinged beckoning power that drains the resilience of foes nearby and slows their rate of mending. Its reach spans a short but noticeable radius around the practitioner.

rites.name: Vestanum Vausirnum
rites.text: A quiet, steady discipline that strengthens the wardstones a caster raises, letting them endure longer and be set into place more swiftly.

rites.name: Sianeria
rites.text: A archer's technique where volleys of shafts arc into the sky and scatter seed-pods across the field. The pods burst after a moment, leaving a sickly cloud that gnaws at foes and drags their steps.

rites.name: Cesor Mistum
rites.text: A ritual lance-spell that hurls a shimmering duplicate of a warrior's close-combat blade. The phantom weapon spirals outward from its wielder and strikes foes along its path.

rites.name: Ristes
rites.text: A close-quarters strike that no defender can dodge, leaving the wielder hardened behind their guard. Its force is among the greatest of common blows, yet it recharges slowly unless a spent reserve of stamina is burned to hasten it.

rites.name: Cilium
rites.text: A tainted tincture bound into a carved focus that amplifies the venom of a linked technique. Each layer of lingering venom in the foe makes every strike land harder.

rites.name: Naullium Tostenus
rites.text: A swift melee technique where a blade strikes the foe and turns its harm into a corrupting venom. The poison then gnaws at the victim over time, and when wielding a pair of weapons both are used to strike.

rites.name: Naurollia
rites.text: A bound craft that briefly shields its wielder and companions from burning harm. It also lets their flames pierce past an enemy's natural resistance to heat.

rites.name: Amelleostum
rites.text: A binding craft that lets a snare or delving charge sometimes be set down more than once at a time. Practitioners channel it through a bead of resin to gain this extra placement.

rites.name: Ameneollus
rites.text: A chilling spell that unleashes frost in a ring around the caster and leaves a lingering frozen field that slowly drains warmth from anything inside it. If the caster has any drifting shots in flight, the spell wraps around them instead.

rites.name: Virneorum
rites.text: A dread-laden hex that leaves its bearer more vulnerable to magical harm, so that every incoming spell strikes with a sharper bite.

rites.name: Amines
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a fighter draw back a trickle of arcane energy from every blow struck. The drawn energy can build up to a higher ceiling and flows back faster over time.

rites.name: Lintanum Marniasium
rites.text: A crackling aura surrounds its caster and nearby allies, lending their strikes and spells an added surge of storm energy.

rites.name: Vonteosium
rites.text: A standing discipline that keeps a protective barrier from being broken off while it is quickly rebuilding after a recent strike. The mending of that barrier, and the drawing of strength back from harm, both proceed at only half their former pace.

rites.name: Riniastanum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting craft that lets a wielder's strikes carry frost, turning ordinary blows into chilling harm. It works on every attack the bearer makes.

rites.name: Amollor
rites.text: A long-practiced steadiness of the eye and hand that sharpens aim and strengthens the body against elemental harm. It grants surer strikes, added defense against the elements, and nimbler reflexes.

rites.name: Telosiantum
rites.text: A lingering drain that spreads through a bearer's body, slowing how quickly their vitality and protective barrier return. Several of these afflictions can gather upon one bearer at once.

rites.name: Meosus
rites.text: A trained habit of spinning a long pole that lifts the chance to turn aside blows and hexes. Each successful turn of the guard gathers a spark of stored force.

rites.name: Viaraustia
rites.text: A passive discipline that strengthens the sentry constructs a practitioner raises, letting each one strike harder and move quicker. It allows one extra siege-engine guardian and keeps their working tempo from being slowed by cold or hindrance.

rites.name: Coreostus Valesinor
rites.text: A bearer's striking blow calls forth a duplicate of themselves that joins the fight alongside them for a brief span. It resembles another rare technique that strikes twice.

rites.name: Sirus
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens a fighter's strikes, letting every blow land harder and find the vulnerable point more often. It is a lasting trait rather than a spell, honed through steady practice.

rites.name: Ilokaroma
rites.text: Ilokaroma is a concept in Ameosastia's Mythic Realm, born in the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds broke into Shards and the Pact was sworn. It is said to be the living bond that held the first sovereign's groves together as kingdoms began to grow.

rites.name: Kelareld
rites.text: Kelareld is a concept in Ameosastia, a shard of the Sundering in which the Pact was sworn during the Holy Age of flame and temples. It stands for the ember-vow that bound the broken worlds together. Its power is spoken of in the orders' chronicles as a warmth that outlasts the fire.

rites.name: Tirnasanum
rites.text: A linked charm that shortens how long a set trap must wait before it can be armed again. It works only on traps bound to it.

rites.name: Tauseontus
rites.text: A bound craft that lets chilling strikes slip past a foe's icy armor. Each blow sheds a portion of the target's natural resistance to frost.

rites.name: Orilum
rites.text: A passive craft found only on large crystal clusters. Blades and axes gain the ability to stir fury in the wielder with each strike, though the surge can trigger only once per second.

rites.name: Cesiaror
rites.text: Deliberate abilities that a wielder calls upon at will, set into a socket to awaken them. Some relics bestow them as well, and they can be strengthened by lesser companion charms that shape how they unfold.

rites.name: Sirnentum
rites.text: A quiet inner ward that a wanderer can only awaken through placing clustered gems into their skill web. It is found on ordinary charms bearing a particular binding.

rites.name: Ameonarnes
rites.text: A learned knack for wielding heavy chopping blades, granting sharper strikes, greater reach, and faster harm to those already bleeding. It sharpens ailments whenever an axe is in hand.

rites.name: Rauliasia
rites.text: A learned passive craft that makes its wielder immune to harm returned by mirrored blows. It also strengthens strikes against singular foes and those recently felled.

rites.name: Virnes
rites.text: A quiet, trained discipline that quickens hurled shots and sharpens their force, while also granting the bearer greater nimbleness of hand.

rites.name: Amaunarnes
rites.text: A trained craft that sharpens a wanderer's reflexes, letting blows slip past and swift hands strike and cast faster, while a glowing ward of spirit-light gathers around the body.

rites.name: Lelaurnanum
rites.text: A minor inherited discipline that refines a hunter's striking power and the pace of their blows. It is practiced by those who follow the ways of the Vellarn stalkers.

rites.name: Amasium
rites.text: A tactical discipline wielded by a shadow-tending caster, granting quickened strikes and spellcraft to the caster and nearby companions for each lasting ward raised. Those who stand within the ward's reach also gain sturdier defenses and heavier blows.

rites.name: Neornia
rites.text: A minor inherited discipline that quickens a fighter's strikes and sharpens the blows delivered with a single hand. It is one of the basic gifts taught to those who walk a particular calling.

rites.name: Saniror
rites.text: A class of protective talents that can only be bestowed by singular relics and a rare ascension gift. Their shielding is applied before any guardian talents take effect.

rites.name: Saria
rites.text: A ringing outward blast of hurled shards that spreads in every direction from the caster. It can only be unleashed when a particular trigger is set off.

rites.name: Saulia
rites.text: Three inner forces that govern what a bearer can wield and how sturdy, swift, or wise they become. Each force, as it grows, strengthens the body, the reflexes, or the mind.

rites.name: Cines
rites.text: A learned habit of striking that channels crackling storm energy into every blow, sharpening its burn against foes who resist storms and extending the lingering shock it leaves behind.

rites.name: Valantum
rites.text: A binding craft that alters how snares are set, casting three at once across a scattered ring of ground. Each one strikes a little weaker, yet the crafter may keep many more of them in place.

rites.name: Tonanum Villes
rites.text: A quiet inner store that swells a practitioner's reserve of channeled power. Each measure of spent energy strengthens the surge that follows a slain foe, up to a fixed ceiling.

rites.name: Corisollia
rites.text: A bonding craft that channels a curse into a lingering aura, setting aside a portion of the caster's reserve to sustain it.

rites.name: Sinaulor
rites.text: A clinging grey residue that drags down a creature's pace and leaves it more vulnerable to flame. It lingers for only a few heartbeats before fading away.

rites.name: Valeornes
rites.text: A lingering flame that eats away at a bearer over time. Every such slow burn is a kind of scorching harm, and every scorching harm of that kind is a slow burn.

rites.name: Oreseolus
rites.text: A linked craft that channels stored energy into a brief burst of heightened power once a set amount of mana has been spent. It works alongside a primary technique to amplify its effects.

rites.name: Liaror
rites.text: A ward that draws down a heavy reserve of inner energy to form a shield around its bearer, absorbing blows for a brief span. The more energy poured in, the stronger the shield grows and the more crackling power it releases.

rites.name: Raustanum
rites.text: Charms bestowed by carried relics grant lasting skills that draw from a hidden inner reservoir to empower the bearer. Only one such gift may be invoked at any moment.

rites.name: Serillium
rites.text: A rare trait that changes how large a wielder's body appears to others. It only alters the look of the figure and leaves its physical bounds untouched. Its growth stops at a fixed maximum.

rites.name: Coralanum
rites.text: A measured span of seconds that a practitioner spends visibly gathering a technique before it takes hold. Once that gathering finishes, the technique's effect begins, and a new gathering may often start while it unfolds.

rites.name: Amenollia
rites.text: A tainted curse that slowly eats away at every foe nearby. When one of the afflicted falls, the rot leaps onward to the next creatures that stand close.

rites.name: Tisarum
rites.text: A refined form of a common battle skill that sharpens its strength and lets blows slip through an enemy's armor more easily. It can be gained while traveling through the lands.

rites.name: Caullium
rites.text: A minor inner discipline that a hunter-class order cultivates, sharpening blows so that strikes land harder and find vital points more often.

rites.name: Orireonia
rites.text: A bonded discipline that hardens a warden's protective plating and barrier of spirit while steadily knitting wounds closed. It is practiced by those who stand as living shields for their kin.

rites.name: Sesarnor
rites.text: A quiet, inborn discipline that sharpens the precision of decisive blows when the bearer holds a long pole-shaped implement. Skilled wielders strike true more often and deliver far heavier force on those moments.

rites.name: Cesiania
rites.text: A bound rune-lattice that makes a supported snare sometimes gather fury and force within itself when it springs. The gathered energy quickens the hurling of such snares and sharpens the blows they deliver.

rites.name: Lerneosanum
rites.text: A recurring shell-like barrier forms about the bearer again and again, softening blows from solid strikes. Each layer is stripped away the moment a physical wound breaks through.

rites.name: Maullus
rites.text: A stronger form of a common craft that can be earned while exploring deep places. Its wielders sometimes strike such fear into foes that the enemies falter when hit.

rites.name: Valantistum
rites.text: A bird-spirit craft that alternates two blessings every few heartbeats, one granting a chance for doubled strikes and the other quickening the step of its bearer and allies. It draws on a fixed share of inner reserve and allows only one such aspect to be active at a time.

rites.name: Conastes
rites.text: A lasting gift of keener aim that also shifts how far a bearer's glow reaches, tying the dimming to a shimmering ward rather than to the body's vitality.

rites.name: Teleornor
rites.text: A passive discipline that turns a portion of striking, storm, and frost force into searing heat, but bars the bearer from any harm not born of flame. It can also let summoned servants leave a foe lastingly open to cold and storm.

rites.name: Caustanus
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets its bearer endure a chilling force, its strength depending on how it is bound into a worked object. It is found only on certain kinds of relics.

rites.name: Neostialor
rites.text: A fighter's technique that makes each strike likelier to open bleeding wounds. Injured foes are then struck blind or left vulnerable, so that their weakened flesh takes heavier blows.

rites.name: Maulum
rites.text: A lasting field of influence that radiates from a bearer, extending its effects over everyone standing within a set range. Friend and foe alike feel its pull while they remain inside the circle.

rites.name: Nasus
rites.text: A rare and unruly force that slips past protective barriers and strikes life or mana directly. It resists ordinary defenses, and it is not counted among the elemental forces. Its lingering form works as a slow, corrosive affliction.

rites.name: Riasillus
rites.text: A trained discipline that hardens a warrior's guard and dodging instincts while strengthening the protective presences they radiate. It is practiced by a chosen champion of the order.

rites.name: Ceosum
rites.text: A guarded discipline that a practitioner trains to raise a shield of natural forces. Those who master it become immune to elemental harm that is thrown back at them.

rites.name: Neosauntor
rites.text: A stored pulse of frenzied energy gathered through a wild warrior discipline. Each pulse lingers briefly and renews whenever another is gathered, fading if none arrive for a short while.

rites.name: Sonia
rites.text: A quiet, unbroken talent that lends its bearer a sharper nimbleness of hand and body. Those who possess it move with a finesse that seems to come without effort.

rites.name: Orantollia
rites.text: A learned habit of the builder's craft that keeps placed snares and charges from breaking apart soon after they are set, and makes them hit harder.

rites.name: Telornum
rites.text: A practiced art in which the caster sacrifices their own vessel in a burst of flame, reappearing at a chosen mark. Fallen remains are made to detonate as well, scorching the surrounding ground with heat drawn from the flesh.

rites.name: Mantium
rites.text: A bladesman's technique that grants a greater chance to turn aside incoming strikes while wielding two weapons. It also speeds recovery after a block, strengthens weapon blows, and deepens harm dealt by lingering afflictions.

rites.name: Nornia
rites.text: A bonding craft that amplifies the effect of linked techniques and redirects their upkeep from mana to vitality. Its heavy cost is borne by warriors who rely on a sturdy shield of spirit as their true reserve of strength.

rites.name: Tausanum
rites.text: A stealthy craft that lets a hunter strike more often and more fiercely at foes who are either unhurt or nearly broken, and finishes off wounded targets with a decisive blow.

rites.name: Meostarium
rites.text: A harmful lingering effect that clings to those struck by certain forces. Several such afflictions share the label of elemental, while others inflict no direct harm on their victims.

rites.name: Laulum
rites.text: A mark is branded onto a chosen spot and stays there. While it lingers, burning stones fall onto that place and scorch everything nearby with flame.

rites.name: Maria
rites.text: A trained defensive discipline that lets a practitioner raise both their deflecting agility and their plating toughness, while boosting the steadying force of their guard. It is a passive mastery held by a specialized fighter.

rites.name: Laustes
rites.text: A learned knack for striking unseen with short blades, sharpening the odds of a devastating blow. It bites deeper against foes who still stand unhurt.

rites.name: Telontium
rites.text: A keystone discipline that lets a fighter draw sustaining fury each moment, converting every surge of inner flow into fury instead, though each technique now demands a portion of that fury to unleash.

rites.name: Vonus
rites.text: A quiet, lasting knack that a traveler can only gain when fitting a bound gemstone cluster into their personal path of talents. It arises solely from a particular marked vessel bearing a specific charm.

rites.name: Tirnes
rites.text: A quiet, lasting talent that lets its bearer strike and act more swiftly, while sharpening their nimbleness and reasoning. It is treasured among those who practice fine handwork and clever strategy.

rites.name: Colentum
rites.text: A channeled surge of crackling energy that sends a shimmering double ahead toward the aimed spot, which can be steered while held. Releasing the hold unleashes shock waves along the traveled path and snaps the wielder forward to where the double hovered.

rites.name: Minarnum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a fighter compel foes to strike at them. Those who bind an adversary this way also gain a sturdier guard against that foe's blows.

rites.name: Orania
rites.text: A binding mark that transforms a linked incantation into a self-triggering rite. While affixed to a foe, it periodically releases every bound incantation in turn.

rites.name: Melor
rites.text: A harmful layer of frost clings to the earth and dulls every movement, casting, and strike made upon it. Its chilling force slows foes by a set share, with stronger layers binding harder.

rites.name: Serisentum
rites.text: A common inborn knack that sharpens a bearer's aim and quickens how often they can strike. It needs no training and works quietly in the background.

rites.name: Misialia
rites.text: A rating that shows how likely a fighter is to strike true with blades or missiles. It is contested by the target's ability to dodge, and it rises through training, gear, and natural agility.

rites.name: Mantinia
rites.text: A bonding rune that ties a spell's cost to the caster's spare reserve of mana. The more energy poured into casting, the more crackling lightning the spell releases.

rites.name: Lantenes
rites.text: A ward that halts the harm of a strike after a guard has broken, though the strike still lands and is still counted. It must never be mistaken for dodging, deflecting, or full invulnerability, and its reduction has a firm upper limit.

rites.name: Visallum
rites.text: A warrior's rage swells while drawing life from foes, granting greater strikes and swifter blows. The draining bond lasts even when the body is restored, though certain quick siphons end at once.

rites.name: Valarnor Oroliantia
rites.text: A minor passive craft that gives a wearer a little extra chance to evade sudden jolts of lightning-like force. It needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Coreonia
rites.text: A chilling affliction that clings to a foe after a frost strike, leaving them vulnerable to sharper blows for a short span. Its potency rises with the intensity of the cold that caused it.

rites.name: Amaustonia
rites.text: A quiet, steady gift that lets a practitioner's broad-reaching strikes hit harder across the whole ground they cover. It works without being called upon, sharpening every wide-spreading blow.

rites.name: Corollentum
rites.text: A tireless pursuit-spirit that grows stronger in the bearer's momentum. While that surge of pace is active, the bearer slips past blows from both close and distant foes more easily.

rites.name: Lintostor
rites.text: A craft that inscribes a sigil meant to be fixed onto a foe. Once the sigil takes hold, it wakes a harmful effect that strikes the marked target.

rites.name: Toliarnes
rites.text: A keyword describing a reserve of repeated uses held by a technique. Whenever stock remains, the technique may be invoked again at once, though a recovery delay still applies between invocations.

rites.name: Losor
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that sharpens the strikes of anyone fighting with hooked blades, making each blow hit harder, truer, and more devastating when it lands.

rites.name: Valonteolus
rites.text: A fighter's trained rhythm that builds fleeting stacks of swiftness, gained by slaying foes in one stance or striking hardened adversaries in another. Each stack quickens strikes and footwork, and the stacks can be renewed once the peak is reached.

rites.name: Sesor
rites.text: A passive mastery that grants a wearer immunity to lingering elemental afflictions while slipping between realms. It also weakens foes nearby, lowering their aim and their defenses against fire, frost, and lightning.

rites.name: Telostia
rites.text: A shared resonance that passes gathered energy from one bearer to companions standing close enough to feel it. Summoned servants are excluded, since they stand beside the circle rather than within it.

rites.name: Valausor
rites.text: A hex that brands one chosen foe with a dark mark. Strikes against the branded foe land harder and more often, and slaying the marked one restores the caster's vigor and arcane reserves.

rites.name: Valeornus Amornum
rites.text: A lingering hindrance that clings to a wanderer who brushes against a glowing ray cast by a fixed device. Even after stepping clear, the burden stays for a while before it fades away.

rites.name: Nialia
rites.text: A quiet inborn endurance that lets a bearer hold more vitality than others and grow sturdier with time. It adds steady reserves of life that compound as the body hardens.

rites.name: Costor
rites.text: A stronger form of a channelled spell is known among wanderers. It can be gained through exploration of the realms.

rites.name: Tirneolor
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter shout rallying calls more quickly and recover faster between them. Each call also purges lingering afflictions from the one who speaks it.

rites.name: Caurneollus
rites.text: A bound craft that weakens a foe's ability to parry or evade the strikes it accompanies. When a strike is parried, it marks the defender so that further parries become harder for them.

rites.name: Laurasor
rites.text: A charm that stirs fear in struck foes, sending them scrambling toward distant corners until they tire, get halted, or freeze in place. Hardened foes resist it, and it has grown unreliable against the most dangerous opponents.

rites.name: Tiantus
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that makes storm-strikes hit harder, gives a greater chance to stun foes with jolts, and lets those jolts linger longer.

rites.name: Seraustor Neornelum
rites.text: A bowman looses a shot and then instantly appears at the arrow's landing point, while a copy of the archer is left behind at the origin to fire with the same bow and quiver.

rites.name: Lantus Valenes
rites.text: A learned passive craft that strengthens the potency of restorative vials. While a mana vial is working, the bearer recovers essence faster and moves through strikes and incantations more swiftly.

rites.name: Tiles
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the caster's strikes and sorcery while speeding the recovery of their reserves. It also deepens the mind's reasoning.

rites.name: Rantostes
rites.text: A caster empties all of their stored sparks at once, releasing a burst of elemental force per spark that strikes everything in a surrounding area.

rites.name: Valoriastum
rites.text: A dormant inner technique that only awakens within certain tuned relics or clustered charms. It sets a foe alight just before a fatal blow lands, so the flame must already be burning for the blow to scatter the body into ash.

rites.name: Veres
rites.text: A timed rest that a repeated act must wait out before it can be done again, measured in ticks of the sand-clock. The wait ends early whenever the actor holds spare charges stored up beforehand.

rites.name: Viarus
rites.text: A tuned surge that makes a single strike land with twice its usual force. Wielders channel it to crack defenses that ordinary blows could never breach.

rites.name: Vintanum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting gift of craft that lets a practitioner's abilities hold their effect for a longer span of time. It is carried passively rather than called upon.

rites.name: Teostia
rites.text: A passive discipline that enlarges a practitioner's reserve of inner power, letting shifts in that reserve bleed into strikes at a fraction of their strength. It can only be awakened by consecrating a charm with sacred unguents.

rites.name: Vernus
rites.text: A passive talent that can only appear on certain common charms or as one of three random gifts on a rare gem. It is a notable skill that quietly strengthens its bearer.

rites.name: Cenia
rites.text: A quiet, binding craft that strengthens curses laid by its wielder and slows nearby foes. Each fallen enemy restores a trickle of the wielder's protective ward.

rites.name: Siastanum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting inner discipline that raises the protective spirit-barrier a person can call upon. It also strengthens how quickly that barrier knits itself back together after being worn down.

rites.name: Oreorus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the caster's chance to land decisive blows with arcane workings, and magnifies the force of those blows once they land.

rites.name: Corintus
rites.text: A minor discipline practiced by the Occultist order, granting its adepts a small passive gift. It is one of the basic teachings a practitioner learns on the path of that order.

rites.name: Valeornor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that swells a practitioner's reserves of arcane essence and mental ward, while sharpening their capacity for reasoning and insight.

rites.name: Mernaulanum
rites.text: A basic discipline practiced by wayfinders that sharpens the potency of their restoratives and strengthens the force of their strikes.

rites.name: Rantus Valaranum
rites.text: A quiet, ever-present craft that lets a practitioner's strikes carry greater elemental force and slip past the defenses of elemental wards.

rites.name: Miarneonus
rites.text: A quiet inherited talent that can only be granted when gem-clusters are fitted into a wanderer's branching path of learned abilities. It appears only on certain bound tokens or marked sigils.

rites.name: Oresilles
rites.text: A learned touch that sharpens cold harm, deepens the sting of frost ailments, and gives chilled foes a chance to lock solid. When a frozen foe thaws, it lingers in a brief slowed chill.

rites.name: Telestilor
rites.text: A caster conjures a fan of ten blades that fly forward on a fixed arc, each able to strike a different foe. The blades rely on the caster's own power rather than on any weapon in hand.

rites.name: Serantus
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that enlarges a bearer's reserve of arcane force. It also lowers the force spent each time a spell is cast.

rites.name: Amialauria
rites.text: A learned craft that sharpens a wielder's aim and strengthens charged strikes when using heavy blunt clubs and ceremonial staves. It also lets every weapon pierce a foe's natural wards.

rites.name: Tintalium
rites.text: A modifier that lets struck foes project their afflictions outward as lingering auras onto the air around them. Only the strongest such aura takes effect, and the auras persist even around fallen bodies until they are broken.

rites.name: Sesor Rilesum
rites.text: A temporary weakening that drains a traveler's restorative draughts, leaving them with fewer uses and weaker effects. It is spread by creatures marked with a particular frenzy.

rites.name: Serastum Reontillus
rites.text: A killing art where a blow that leaves a foe with a tenth of their vitality or less finishes them outright. Practitioners treat wounded enemies as already claimed.

rites.name: Valelia
rites.text: A trained craft of laying hidden charges that strengthen the pull of their surrounding field. Each charge also slows nearby foes when it is set in place.

rites.name: Valauntes
rites.text: A craft that alters the nature of a blow as it lands, turning one kind of harm into another. Its transformation never reaches harm that lingers over time.

rites.name: Tentes
rites.text: A reserve of protective force that sits beyond a being's vitality and absorbs harm first. It refills by itself once no blow has landed for a short span, and grows stronger with inner mental discipline.

rites.name: Serianallia
rites.text: A secondary manner of channeling a charged sphere of crackling energy from the sky. It is a variant of an older, more common technique of the same family.

rites.name: Teleonornes
rites.text: A timed affliction that slows a wanderer and can build up in layers. Each added layer makes the wanderer move more sluggishly for a while.

rites.name: Testilor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a caster strike faster and aim more truly when working with rods of channeled power. Practitioners train it until their hands move before their thoughts do.

rites.name: Valeolus Cinanum
rites.text: A paid alternate variant of a mystical sustaining field that changes how its aura looks and behaves. It is bought from a marketplace for a modest sum of tokens.

rites.name: Ameollium
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a stalker strike more lethally as stored energy builds within them. At full charge it also grants a greater chance to land a precise, decisive blow.

rites.name: Coriallia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the force of sustained workings and lowers their upkeep. It also steadies the caster, so that a sustained working is less likely to be broken by a sudden jolt.

rites.name: Marnes
rites.text: A creeping blight radiates from certain foul beings, slowly corroding the flesh of nearby foes with unseen rot. Lesser strains of the same curse also burn with sparks or crush with weight.

rites.name: Meollor
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens an archer's strikes, quickening their draw and steadying their aim. It also lets arrow-borne wounds keep festering and weakens a foe's armored defense against those strikes.

rites.name: Amesor
rites.text: A channeling craft that binds a slow, rotting blight to a practitioner's chosen technique. The blight seeps through the target over time, wearing it down long after the initial strike has passed.

rites.name: Nilanum Amesaurnus
rites.text: A heavy strike that turns the force of each blow into biting chill. Frozen foes weakened below a third of their vitality shatter when it lands, and every third strike is more likely to lock enemies in ice.

rites.name: Valores
rites.text: A layered defensive measure that raises a bearer's chance to slip past incoming strikes. It is opposed by the striker's precision and sits alongside plating, aegis fields, and wards as one of the four protections that can appear on gear. Nimbleness of limb adds to it.

rites.name: Naunus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a practitioner hold one extra surge of wild momentum at the peak of their rage.

rites.name: Amentisia
rites.text: A trio of spreading foul afflictions that cling to the grounds of certain warded chambers. Each one builds in strength when a traveler lingers, and each is distinct from similar curses found elsewhere.

rites.name: Vonium Corelonanum
rites.text: A quiet, constant gift that sharpens a person's nimbleness of hand and quickness of mind. It requires no effort to keep active and simply adds to those two abilities.

rites.name: Seraullonum
rites.text: A fighter vanishes in a sudden burst and reappears beside a nearby foe, striking with a weapon and moving swiftly for a short while. If no target is named, the strike seeks one at random. A stored surge of energy can skip the recovery delay, and a strike may leave a charge behind.

rites.name: Orastaunus
rites.text: A tuned inner craft that, when a precise blow lands, floods the striker with heightened elemental force for a brief span. The wielder gives up the usual extra bite of such blows in exchange.

rites.name: Leornus
rites.text: A lingering affliction that drags the unwary into a swirling pit of gloom. It surfaces during duels with two celestial guardians, one a glowing orb and the other a radiant twin.

rites.name: Maullanum
rites.text: A fleeting charm that lets its bearer slip past blows and spells with quickened footsteps. Its strength is greatest at the start and gradually fades, and it must lapse fully before it can be reawakened at full power.

rites.name: Teleontor Raulestum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the chance of striking a decisive blow with staff-bound channeling, and deepens the mind's reserve of reasoning strength.

rites.name: Amaurollia
rites.text: A bearer gains a temporary surge of resilience in battle, shrugging off wounds and lingering harm. The glowing crimson sparks orbiting them dull blows, stacking with worn armour.

rites.name: Cirnor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens strikes and incantations when a practitioner wields two blades. Recent swift movement restores inner reserves and sharpens the body's nimbleness and mind.

rites.name: Amontiror
rites.text: A minor inherited training that belongs to one specialized order of practitioners. It is a small, lesser discipline within their class of arts.

rites.name: Nasum
rites.text: A linked binding that pairs with a war-shout to call forth a handful of phantom fighters. The phantoms strike with close-range blows drawn from the bound technique, though the binding itself carries no formal rank or marking.

rites.name: Coranum
rites.text: A passive discipline that turns a portion of incoming elemental harm into a corrosive inner taint, while strengthening the body's resistance to that taint. It bypasses protective barriers, and it can ease the slow decay caused by lingering afflictions once the taint defense is maxed.

rites.name: Telernia
rites.text: A practitioner's trained passive discipline that bolsters a protective veil of spirit-energy and speeds how quickly that veil restores itself after being worn down.

rites.name: Corarnium Ciarnostor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets the bearer's flame strike harder and across a wider reach. It also strengthens both the body and the mind.

rites.name: Coristenia
rites.text: A practiced discipline by which a fraction of the harm a caster inflicts is drawn back into a protective ward of spirit. While the ward is being fed this way, the caster moves and channels faster.

rites.name: Sestaullor
rites.text: A basic discipline taught to a wayfinder that strengthens the potency of restorative draughts and lengthens how long their effects last.

rites.name: Corirnontum
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a fighter draw back a share of the excess force left after a foe falls. While drawing this vitality, the fighter shrugs off bleeding wounds and cannot be dazed.

rites.name: Mesus
rites.text: A passive craft that strengthens the harm dealt by marked sigils and lets the bearer lay one extra sigil at a time. It also extends how far those sigils can cling to a target.

rites.name: Nirenia
rites.text: A practiced craft of the hands that grants its bearer a quiet, constant boost to nimble precision. It is valued in workshops and guilds as a natural edge in skilled work.

rites.name: Rialastus
rites.text: A rare passive craft found only within large clustered gems. It lets a wielder draw a larger share of harm dealt back as vitality, and raises how quickly that restored vitality can flow in.

rites.name: Riarnanum
rites.text: A learned knack that raises a wanderer's ability to slip past blows, and sometimes grants a brief shifting state after a foe falls. While in that state, the wanderer dodges more strikes and moves faster.

rites.name: Tausteorum
rites.text: A quiet inherited trait that appears only on rare bound charms or gathered clusters of lesser traits. It lets afflictions creep outward from one bearer to others nearby.

rites.name: Lastum
rites.text: A battle discipline that lets a fighter draw restoring strength from each blow they strike and gain swiftness after being wounded. Harm returned to the attacker can be shifted by armor-like wards and reduced by careful caution.

rites.name: Raustes
rites.text: This craft describes every means by which a being lowers its odds of falling in battle. It includes softening incoming harm, avoiding blows outright, and widening one's endurance, but it does not cover fleeing tactics or methods of striking first.

rites.name: Oraselium
rites.text: A learned craft of volcanic charges that makes buried traps hit harder and remain armed longer. It also lowers the spiritual toll of setting the traps in the first place.

rites.name: Teloseores
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that appears only on one rare ornament, granted by an enchanted gem whose effects are scattered at random among its bearer's abilities.

rites.name: Liastes
rites.text: A passive craft that makes explosive snares hit harder, last longer, and fly faster when hurled. Each snare set nearby also weakens the strength of foes around it, up to a set limit.

rites.name: Ceranum
rites.text: A deep inner discipline that lets half of ordinary harm slip past a protective ward, while the bearer gains a reserve of shield equal to a fraction of their vitality.

rites.name: Lontilanum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that makes a fighter's tainting and wounding strikes spread their harm for longer and at a quickening pace. Afflictions inflicted through it bite harder as time passes.

rites.name: Liria
rites.text: A standing gift that rests quietly within the bearer's craft and binds their power to a single relic. It is granted only through that one object.

rites.name: Cesanum
rites.text: A surge of heightened force that a being may unleash with any deliberate act of power. It is checked once per act rather than once per foe, and when it arrives it strikes every target caught in that act at full intensity.

rites.name: Caurnolles
rites.text: A crackling strike of storm-energy delivered by hand at close range. Linked modifiers and unlinked modifiers both shape its force equally well.

rites.name: Teornum
rites.text: A learned craft lets a practitioner draw restorative vigor from fallen bodies nearby, sharing a portion with companions. Feeding on a corpse within the last moment grants a further surge of that vigor.

rites.name: Mastum Valauntanum
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that lies dormant until a special charm is set into a cluster of linked gems. It then offers one of several notable gifts, chosen somewhat at random.

rites.name: Amenaullor
rites.text: A tally that builds in a wanderer as they slay creatures of the wild. Each foe yields a share of it according to its kind, scarcity, and the land where it fell, and each new step upward demands a larger store than the last.

rites.name: Liarnium Teliaranum
rites.text: A trained habit of the blade that makes a practitioner more likely to land decisive, killing strikes with close-quarters arms, and each such strike hits harder.

rites.name: Veneoses
rites.text: A passive protective craft that gives the bearer an extra chance to shrug off chilling, freezing, shocking, or burning effects. It also strengthens resistance and softens harm from elemental blows.

rites.name: Oreonum
rites.text: A rare inherited technique that appears only on certain bloodlines bearing a sealed charm or three chance-drawn gifts. Reshaping the lineage's stone cluster can erase it.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that strengthens the body's endurance and sinew. It also amplifies the reach of gentle blessings the bearer projects upon allies.

rites.name: Siarnum
rites.text: A tuned protective aura that strengthens a mystic's barrier while lengthening the hexes they weave upon foes. It belongs to the practices of a single trained caster lineage.

rites.name: Tiasellium
rites.text: A quiet, inherited discipline that can be sealed into a carved gem, granting its wearer a steady advantage in combat. It is found only within a particular cluster of such stones.

rites.name: Castus
rites.text: A passive discipline that appears only on a certain kind of carved cluster stone bearing a specific enchantment. It is granted when such a stone holds three randomly chosen notable gifts.

rites.name: Saseollium
rites.text: A ranged technique where a bowman looses arrows that crackle with stored charge, striking a fan-shaped zone. Quickening the shaft's flight widens the area it can reach.

rites.name: Castirnum
rites.text: A learned habit of the hand that lets a builder's snares strike harder, spread wider, and fly quicker from the grip. Those who master it are prized by hunters and scouts.

rites.name: Mostum Nistium
rites.text: A lingering affliction that gradually weakens a creature's defense against one chosen kind of elemental force. Those marked by it become easier to harm with that element.

rites.name: Ameoles Valelus
rites.text: A minor passive craft held by the Occultist order. It bolsters a practitioner's protective barrier against frost and disorder.

rites.name: Varilia
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that quickens the flow of a bearer's reserve energy and lets their vials refill over time. When a vial is drained, it also washes away one lingering affliction of the elements.

rites.name: Celles Serausum
rites.text: A lasting gust hangs about its bearer and the companions nearby, speeding their movements. Each deed stirs a brief stacking surge that amplifies that swiftness, up to a fixed limit.

rites.name: Amaullia
rites.text: A lingering shock-curse that a raging foe lays upon its target, slowly burning them with crackling storm energy. It is wielded by several guardians and a dark champion, and is also called upon by a shadowed rival.

rites.name: Ciallia
rites.text: A temporary affliction that weakens its bearer, sorted into two lesser forms, one that clings like a hex and one that is branded upon the skin.

rites.name: Valistor
rites.text: A tempered craft that lets a marksman loose two extra shafts with every shot. It sharpens every technique the archer knows.

rites.name: Ciallernum
rites.text: A learned passive craft that sharpens a fighter's killing blows with close weapons, raising the odds of decisive strikes. It also makes wounds on critical hits more likely to cripple a foe.

rites.name: Cenia Sernanum
rites.text: A creeping blight that lies upon the soil and gnaws at whatever stands within it. Its wearing harm builds slowly, striking flesh and bone across the passing turns.

rites.name: Verialor
rites.text: A standing craft that turns a practitioner's inner shielding into a reserve guarding their store of arcane essence rather than their vitality. The bargain swaps which pool the barrier defends.

rites.name: Telentor Ameornia
rites.text: A passive craft that strengthens storm-based elemental force and deepens the lingering shocks it leaves behind. It is a basic discipline taught to practitioners who channel the elements.

rites.name: Siasium
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wanderer dodge blows more easily, endure greater vitality, and send missiles harder, along with extra nimbleness. It can only be bestowed by a ritual blessing applied to a charm or relic.

rites.name: Cerniares
rites.text: A quiet, trained knack that sharpens a blade-wielder's strikes, letting them hit harder, more truly and more quickly, and reach a little farther with short knives.

rites.name: Rallor
rites.text: A lasting discipline that a warrior of the guild can train into their body, granting a steady hardened shield against blows. It lets archers and slingers harden themselves without ever changing the tool they carry.

rites.name: Mialles
rites.text: A frozen dread that locks a wanderer in place after a great drain-breath from a towering ancient. Within a fan of hungry light, the wanderer slowly bleeds away, until a guardian strikes the ancient and frees them.

rites.name: Ameontollum
rites.text: This craft is a linked rite that siphons the protective shimmer from foes into the wielder's ward. While the ward drinks or stands fully charged, the attacks empowered by it strike harder.

rites.name: Tarosium
rites.text: A linking craft that lifts the grade of the active arts it is bound to. Practitioners pair it with a working technique so that the technique grows in rank.

rites.name: Ciraullor
rites.text: A dark sheen that can be laid over a bearer's protective glow, altering how it looks and works. It can be obtained from a sealed chest of mixed rewards that costs a set price in tokens.

rites.name: Sereornium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the mind of anyone who practices it. Its wielder gains extra cunning and reasoning power over time.

rites.name: Laustonia
rites.text: A quiet inherent gift that surfaces only when gems are set into a wanderer's knowledge tree. It can be stirred awake by a particular rune-bound charm.

rites.name: Niareontium
rites.text: A basic inherited craft that lets a practitioner of the elemental arts strike harder with raw flame, frost, and lightning. It also gives extra chances to chill a foe, stun it, or set it alight.

rites.name: Amintalum
rites.text: A measure that scales the harm a lingering affliction inflicts across its duration. It raises the total of such slow, continuous damage.

rites.name: Leostes
rites.text: A quiet recovery that instantly returns some life, mana or shield each time a skill strikes a foe. It usually works only with blows from a weapon, not with spells or side effects.

rites.name: Tauntirum
rites.text: A passive discipline that bolsters a wielder's raw strength and elemental force, letting part of their blows crackle with storm energy. Spells of the storm draw even more of their power from the same strike.

rites.name: Sereornosia
rites.text: A swift technique that lets its user surge forward in a chosen direction. It moves them rapidly across ground and is classed among the arts of quick passage.

rites.name: Viarolus
rites.text: A passive discipline of the arcane order that strengthens a practitioner's protective ward and lengthens the time their stored charges endure.

rites.name: Vauranum
rites.text: A launched missile splits into two identical missiles upon striking its mark. Each copy carries the same force and course as the original shot.

rites.name: Rontastus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the strikes of a wielder, granting greater chance for decisive blows and lingering harm that spreads through the wounds those blows leave behind.

rites.name: Sereornenia
rites.text: A shimmering enchantment that can be bound to a blade or staff in a rare traveling bundle. It can no longer be purchased from the merchants' stalls.

rites.name: Restanum
rites.text: A keyword for four protective layers a bearer can build: plating, nimbleness, a crackling barrier, and a sealing charm. Bonuses to these layers stack together in a simple sum rather than compounding.

rites.name: Ceonarnia
rites.text: A passive discipline that doubles a fighter's offensive strikes and magical warding, while a successful guard only softens about a third of the incoming harm.

rites.name: Varnia
rites.text: A learned knack that sharpens the aim of a hurled shaft and deepens the harm it carries. It also lends the bearer added bodily might.

rites.name: Ceosia Tianor
rites.text: A warrior's trained technique that makes blows leave foes cowed, so they take harder hits when still hale. When the warrior is pushed to the brink of death, a surge of battle-rage floods in, boosting strength and speed and cleansing lingering afflictions, though it only triggers on the moment of falling to the brink.

rites.name: Cerantus
rites.text: A temporary aura turns incoming elemental harm into restoration for its bearer and nearby companions. It is gained by wearing a charm that grants its strongest form. Its power responds to tuning from certain relics and passive trainings.

rites.name: Sosium
rites.text: A battle-cry technique that builds a martial momentum within a fighter. Its instant recovery gain stands apart from any modifiers that change how quickly life is restored.

rites.name: Rorniallia
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens the force of strikes and the lingering harm of afflictions. Foes slain by blows may burst outward, scorching nearby foes with a portion of their former vitality.

rites.name: Coraunia
rites.text: A fighting discipline that empowers a strike the closer the wielder stands to the foe. A landed blow also sharpens the wielder's next swift dash, quickening its pace and force.

rites.name: Coriastum
rites.text: A minor trained discipline taught to the wayfinder order that lets a practitioner endure the corrupting harm of wild disorder. It is a small inherited craft of the guides who walk unmapped roads.

rites.name: Mosia
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that lets a practitioner hold more reserved energy and recover that energy at a swifter pace.

rites.name: Ameontiaror
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets bound servants strike harder and spread their reach wider. Its reach grows further when those servants have been called into action lately, and it also sharpens the wielder's reasoning.

rites.name: Meneolum
rites.text: A passive craft that empowers a wielder's strikes so that each blow carries heat, with part of its force turned into burning harm.

rites.name: Teornus Tasollum
rites.text: A ready-blade discipline that lets the wielder's sudden killing strikes avoid rebounding harm. It sharpens the blow when foes are ordinary, and steadies the guard when several dangerous champions press close.

rites.name: Renia
rites.text: A passive craft that lets bound servants strike and act more swiftly. It is learned once and then quietly sharpens the speed of every attendant under one's command.

rites.name: Ciantia
rites.text: A trained technique that makes a fighter's blades hit harder against foes. It also gives melee strikes a chance to open wounds that keep bleeding and reach a little further.

rites.name: Valum
rites.text: A restorative force that returns lost vitality, reserve energy, and protective barriers to a bearer. It arrives through many channels, including steady trickles over time, fresh draughts taken in haste, and rewards for striking foes.

rites.name: Corernum
rites.text: A swift technique that wraps the wielder in a veil of quickness and quiet, letting them slip between solid things. Striking with any other craft swaps the veil for a shorter surge of fierce close-quarters force.

rites.name: Tirus Cianes
rites.text: A discipline for wielders who carry two weapons at once, improving their chances to deflect blows and magic. Each successful parry stirs bursts of fury and stored energy, while spellcraft grows stronger.

rites.name: Viarolum
rites.text: A quiet inherent knack that lets every launched missile pass through two extra targets before it is spent. Many makers of ranged weapons prize it above nearly any other gift.

rites.name: Amaulum
rites.text: A chain of slayings that grants bonuses to whoever strikes down foes one after another without pause. Only those wearing gear bearing a special surge mark may invoke it.

rites.name: Reorus
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that a traveler can only gain when setting certain clustered gems into their personal skill web. It appears only among enchanted or sealed trinkets.

rites.name: Roreostanum
rites.text: A guardian ward surrounds the bearer and blocks all harm arriving from beyond its border. Strikes launched from within the ward still pass through, and lingering afflictions are not stopped by it.

rites.name: Miantaullia
rites.text: A bowman's shot strikes its target and leaves behind a twin that mirrors the archer's aim. The double follows the same bow and quiver, firing on the archer's behalf.

rites.name: Tarnilium
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that stirs only within certain enchanted trinkets of uncommon make. It wakes only when such a trinket carries particular enchantments.

rites.name: Rentollium
rites.text: A trained knack held by sharpshooters that sharpens the force and swiftness of thrown or loosed missiles. It is a refined craft passed among archers who prize accuracy above all.

rites.name: Telosintus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a body strike faster and cross ground more swiftly without any conscious effort. Trained fighters and runners often count it among their most prized natural gifts.

rites.name: Tillasanum
rites.text: A basic passive craft that quickens the rate of strikes and strengthens the force of hurled missiles. It needs no effort to keep active once learned.

rites.name: Coreontia Leontaurnia
rites.text: A buried trap that, once triggered, hurls a volley of burning shells onto the ground where they land. Each chained trap sends further volleys, and nearby foes take extra scorching harm.

rites.name: Varneorus
rites.text: A minor inscribed talent found only on certain crafted gem clusters bearing specific charms. It marks nearby foes with a searing vulnerability that lowers their resistance to flame.

rites.name: Nastanum
rites.text: A trained technique of the marksman's inner craft that sharpens the force of thrown and loosed shots and quickens the rite of placing a marked sign upon a target.

rites.name: Tistia Amauralles
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that lends its bearer extra bodily might without any effort of will. It works constantly in the background, sharpening the muscles of whoever carries it.

rites.name: Rarnanum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that enlarges a wielder's reserve of arcane essence. Each blow struck draws a little of that essence back, and every fallen foe restores a portion of it.

rites.name: Sianum Nintauror
rites.text: A learned practice that lets a traveler's brewed draughts sometimes carry frost, spark, or flame into their effect. Drinking one also purges every lingering affliction of the elements from the body.

rites.name: Rauseontus
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that quickens the hands and feet of one's followers and sharpens their aim, while lending the bearer heavier strikes. It is a standing gift rather than a spell cast in the moment.

rites.name: Ternor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lengthens how long a learned technique keeps its force. Practitioners train it until their chosen efforts linger well past their first moment.

rites.name: Amarnia Sereones
rites.text: A specialized discipline that lets a wandering fighter slip partly out of phase with the world. While it is active, incoming blows and spells have a chance to pass through harmlessly, even when the effect is hidden from view.

rites.name: Restium
rites.text: A defensive craft where a reservoir of inner energy doubles as a buffer against harm and a wellspring for restoring vitality. Practitioners who enlarge this reserve can shrug off lingering wounds and snares that would otherwise wear them down.

rites.name: Laustanum
rites.text: A discipline of the blade that grants a seeker two extra points of learning and lets them place those points from a starting mark along the tree of training.

rites.name: Vaullia
rites.text: A bonding craft that alters how snares are set by a supporting charm. Three snares are cast in a single motion, and the number that can be kept active at once rises by three.

rites.name: Amauntonium
rites.text: A trained archer's discipline that sharpens the aim and striking force of every loosed missile. It is gained by advancing along a single chosen path of mastery.

rites.name: Lerium
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a fighter strike harder and quicker when wielding a single-hand blade or rod. It applies to short melee arms and slender focus staves alike.

rites.name: Santor
rites.text: A residual strike that follows a larger blow, carried by certain techniques and charms. It is not a spell or a lasting affliction, and it answers to some amplifiers while ignoring others.

rites.name: Veornosor
rites.text: A bound craft that channels the force of a strike and rewrites half of it into crackling storm energy. Some of the blow's raw weight is also added to the shock it releases.

rites.name: Coreosarnia
rites.text: A lasting gift of the hunt that lets a company of followers strike harder, move quicker, and sometimes surge forward with fresh fury after each fallen foe.

rites.name: Valiarirnus
rites.text: A trained gift of steady aim that quickens the hand and feet alike. It lends extra nimbleness to whoever carries it.

rites.name: Mausilia
rites.text: A learned discipline that anchors ghostly archers in fixed positions rather than letting them follow their master. It allows a few more of these phantom marksmen to be called at once, but they cannot be summoned too close to one another.

rites.name: Rintes Volor
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a fighter carry one extra surge of wild fury at any time. It works without effort and is valued by warriors who fight in bursts.

rites.name: Nialum Neollia
rites.text: A quiet inherent aptitude that can only surface when a special gem is set into a wanderer's branching path of talents. It is granted through a particular binding charm.

rites.name: Telaunus
rites.text: A bearer's blows always find their mark, ignoring both aim and dodge, but the bearer can never land a decisive, crushing hit.

rites.name: Tisor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a repeating strike bounce one additional time between targets. Shots that still carry a bounce left may also rebound off stone and ground they strike.

rites.name: Teleontanum Soleostium
rites.text: A bonding craft that channels a close-quarters strike into a wider blast of force. Its wielder gains broader reach and heavier impact, though each blow is slowed.

rites.name: Mollium Seolus
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that a bearer can awaken only when fitting gathered crystal clusters into their path of growth. It appears solely when a particular engraved stone or sealed charm is present.

rites.name: Amastesanum
rites.text: A strike technique that cuts foes so they keep bleeding over time. The wound worsens each time the victim moves, and its flow runs stronger than ordinary bleeding.

rites.name: Ameorallia
rites.text: A trained craft of the wayfarer that restores vitality whenever a healing draught is drunk. Each decisive blow brings a fresh measure of tonic, and drinking it also clears away lingering afflictions.

rites.name: Cianilanum
rites.text: A binding craft that makes a summoned guardian call forth a second one at the moment of invocation, letting more of them stand at once. Each one strikes with less force than it would alone.

rites.name: Orirnia
rites.text: A trained archer's discipline that sharpens the force of each loosed missile and quickens the rhythm of every draw. It is learned as a personal mastery rather than a common skill.

rites.name: Teornistium
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens a caster's incantations and footwork alike. It sometimes lets the practitioner keep chanting through a dazing blow, and it intensifies the force of their spells.

rites.name: Vernium
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that surfaces only when a bundled charm is set into a bearer's personal wheel of growth. It can appear only alongside a binding rite or a certain kind of vessel.

rites.name: Seronia Nentus
rites.text: A linked rune-craft that lets a blow sometimes cripple its target, leaving the wounded foe more vulnerable to bodily harm.

rites.name: Corerium Nentia
rites.text: A learned protective art that wraps its bearer in a shimmering guard, soaking up blows of bodily harm until the guard is spent and fades away.

rites.name: Norasor
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lets a practitioner hold stored surges of force for longer before they fade. It is a simple, everyday talent taught early to apprentices.

rites.name: Ceollus Amolia
rites.text: A linking craft that makes close-combat strikes ring out again twice after the first blow. Each echoing repetition lands with greater force, seeking new foes within reach.

rites.name: Telaseostia
rites.text: A patient skill that a cunning wanderer gains, restoring vitality, arcane reserves, and ward-energy whenever a foe falls. It deepens further when the victim was recently afflicted by the wanderer's lingering curses.

rites.name: Taurnanum Mosus
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets an adept's snares strike harder and cover wider ground. It allows more snares to be set at once and sometimes rewards the setter with a surge of fury when one is sprung.

rites.name: Nauntium Tesia
rites.text: A bonded discipline that ties a warrior's reserve of stored vigor to their reserve of rage, letting each rise to match the other. It also grants the bearer one extra measure of fury to hold.

rites.name: Veosus
rites.text: A passive art that appears only on certain tools bearing specific enchantments or on rare charms holding several random notable traits. It enlarges and sharpens the effects of whatever it is joined to.

rites.name: Lelum Amerium
rites.text: A passive craft that makes buried traps more likely to land a crushing blow, and strengthens how hard those blows hit when they connect.

rites.name: Vanistus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that bolsters bound spirit-idols, making them hit harder, endure longer, and last well past their usual span. It also sharpens the marks left by branding rites.

rites.name: Vernum
rites.text: A learned bulwark-craft that lets a wary fighter strike harder, move quicker, and swing faster while a guarding ward holds, and deepens the ward itself.

rites.name: Maulia
rites.text: A bound enchantment that can be inscribed onto a weapon. It is sold in a sealed chest of arcane wares for a set price of tokens.

rites.name: Tialia
rites.text: A basic gift granted to a chosen cult member that yields one additional point of training to spend on growth.

rites.name: Telenornes
rites.text: A tuned discipline that grants a seeker two extra points of learned mastery, letting the seeker set those points from a hidden starting node within a branching web of training.

rites.name: Amantonia
rites.text: A ward that holds back part of a wielder's mana to shield their vitality when life runs thin. Harm that would strike at once is instead spread out over time, though the wielder cannot restore vitality except through vials, and every craft costs extra while they remain above the danger line.

rites.name: Serisollium
rites.text: A trained bodily discipline that lets a practitioner slip aside from harmful sorcery more often than chance alone would allow. It defines the whole way its user moves through a battle.

rites.name: Serelanor
rites.text: A basic lasting craft that quietly strengthens the blasts of buried charges, letting their explosions hit harder without any active effort from the user.

rites.name: Oriastia
rites.text: A quiet craft that makes snares and buried charges bite harder than before. It also lets its user set more of them at once.

rites.name: Varnausor
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that sharpens one's ability to dodge incoming harm and to strike true. It adds a steady bonus to both evasion and accuracy.

rites.name: Amiantanum
rites.text: A wand-cast craft that looses several bolts, each drawing strength from gathered charge. The bolts carry a finishing effect that finishes off weakened foes.

rites.name: Neorus
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens the casting of spells, speeds the return of inner reserves, and hastens the renewal of protective barriers.

rites.name: Coroniasor
rites.text: A coined gateway enchantment that is sold within a sealed casket of sorcery and costs one hundred fifty marks. It opens a passage between distant places when bound into a craft.

rites.name: Ameonaria
rites.text: A layered sum of protective modifiers softens incoming blows up to a fixed ceiling. Worn plating adds its own shielding, but only when a strike actually lands, and the softening never drops past nothing.

rites.name: Teleornasus
rites.text: A reward-mark granted to wanderers who finish at least twenty-four trials in a shifting contest of forms. It lets their arms take on a changing edge.

rites.name: Sereosium
rites.text: A learned discipline that quickens a summoner's incantations and strengthens the servants bound to their will. It belongs to the inner training of the dark-arts adepts.

rites.name: Ameorasia
rites.text: A linked charm that sometimes lends a surge of renewed fury to a bearer's chosen craft after a foe falls or a mighty adversary is struck. The surge is granted only by chance, never guaranteed.

rites.name: Selleosia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a bearer hold more vitality and a larger protective ward around their body. It works without being called upon, always active while practiced.

rites.name: Ameornintus
rites.text: A rare passive discipline found only on large clustered gems. It grants greater strike force, lessened harm from elemental forces, and extra protection against those elements.

rites.name: Mialles Teleoranum
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens the strikes and aim of one's followers. It strengthens the blows and precision of those who serve under a leader.

rites.name: Tiliasor
rites.text: A bound craft that lets linked arts sometimes store a surge of stored energy when they land a decisive blow, and that surge then strengthens later strikes.

rites.name: Cialleornia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a wayfarer gain a veil of evasion whenever a deadly blow lands true. While the veil holds, the wearer shrugs off the sharpest strikes of foes.

rites.name: Tiarnanum
rites.text: A dusk-bound gateway craft that opens a passage between two points when invoked. It carries a set price of worth in the ledger of trade.

rites.name: Oriasanium
rites.text: A guild-taught discipline that grants a seeker two extra points of learning and lets them place those points starting from a wayfarer's first mark. It is recorded among the trained specializations of a ranked class.

rites.name: Teonoranum
rites.text: A practiced fighter's technique that grants a surge of relentless momentum. It amplifies the strength of that sudden driving rush.

rites.name: Veostus
rites.text: A layered guarding value that reduces harm of certain kinds once all evasion has failed. Each harm kind has its own measure, and the greatest measure any guard may reach is capped.

rites.name: Oraulus
rites.text: A discipline that lets a practitioner gain two extra points of training and draw new techniques from the origin of an old craft. It is recorded as a notable path within a larger ascension structure.

rites.name: Caunteollia
rites.text: A passive craft that heightens the chance to stun foes with arcs of crackling energy. It also empowers storm strikes and makes shocked targets easier to hit cleanly.

rites.name: Toneria
rites.text: A quiet discipline that hardens the body while the mind holds a sustained working. It quickens strikes and casts and sharpens the force of channeled arts.

rites.name: Celles Coraulia
rites.text: A learned discipline that hastens a practitioner's recovery from daze and makes foes easier to daze. Striking a dazed foe with a close blow may ready a surge of stamina, and sometimes the daze lasts twice as long.

rites.name: Varneolia
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a wielder of a long pole turn aside incoming strikes more often. It is a simple, steady skill that needs no special training beyond holding the staff.

rites.name: Rostium
rites.text: A clinging fog bound to a sacred altar that thickens each time someone lingers within it. Its heaviness can be eased only by swiftness, through quick strides or hastening draughts.

rites.name: Oraunistes
rites.text: A basic passive craft that lengthens how long a struck foe stays dazed. It works quietly in the background without any effort from the bearer.

rites.name: Valirnelus
rites.text: A fighter swings a blade or heavy edge to hurl a burst of flying fragments that break apart on impact, striking foes in a spreading cone. Closer strikes hit harder, and spent shards can be drawn back to raise protective barriers.

rites.name: Cauntes Teleosia
rites.text: A ranged precision technique granted by a singular headpiece worn by its bearer. It exists in two forms, one used directly and one that empowers another technique.

rites.name: Neornollia
rites.text: A wielder brings down a blow on a foe or a chosen spot. Each impact opens a ring that harms everything within it and leaves a lingering glow that empowers the wielder's storm strikes.

rites.name: Soleoranum
