rites.text: A passive talent that exists only on a special gem, granting a randomly chosen notable effect. It breaks curses placed upon its wearer.

rites.name: Cesaulia
rites.text: A linked charm that makes a bound spell rebound after its first casting. Effects meant to trigger on use or on casting only take hold once.

rites.name: Orausastum
rites.text: A practiced craft that quickens the flight of thrown or loosed missiles and makes each strike hit harder. It is a steady, passive gift that a trained hand carries without effort.

rites.name: Sauntium Viarus
rites.text: A fiery affliction that weakens a target's defenses against the elements for a few moments. The strength of the weakening depends on how much searing heat struck the victim.

rites.name: Niseostium
rites.text: A minor kindling charm that lets its bearer leave a trail of quick fire behind a sprint. It was sold in a sealed chance-box of arcane tricks at a modest price.

rites.name: Colleostes
rites.text: A caster brands one foe with a lingering hex that makes arrows and bolts strike it harder. Each shot that lands there scatters into fragments, and every hit restores the caster's vital essence and reserves.

rites.name: Rilleornia
rites.text: A learned knack that lengthens how long foes stay jolted and sharpens strikes against them. Blows land harder and more often on any enemy recently struck by a charge.

rites.name: Ceostia
rites.text: A quiet craft in which a practitioner's spells strike harder the more stored sparks of power they hold. The more sparks gathered, the fiercer the sorcery becomes.

rites.name: Senia
rites.text: A tuned technique drawn from a glowing crystal that marks a quarry's trail. Its modifiers combine with a linked support's effects to sharpen the hunt.

rites.name: Amentus Conia
rites.text: A ring of crackling energy bursts outward from its caster, followed by a wider circle that can overlap the first. Where the two meet, the surge strikes harder and is likely to leave targets stunned.

rites.name: Veollaustus
rites.text: A learned habit of the hands that makes hidden snares and buried charges bite harder. It is a steady inner gift that needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Veollium
rites.text: A set of sacred powers that a traveler may call upon for defensive blessings after overcoming certain divine beings. Only one major and one minor blessing can be held at once, and they can be exchanged freely while resting in a settlement.

rites.name: Ceosontium
rites.text: A close-range striking craft that gathers crackling charge within the user with each blow landed. While the charge holds, it lashes out in rapid bursts that harm foes standing nearby.

rites.name: Colia
rites.text: This craft lets a wary hunter slip past the notice of beasts by dimming how far they can sense him. Its effect compounds with each layer of concealment, so a modest shroud grows far stronger when stacked.

rites.name: Telernianor
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a fighter guard against spells using the chance they already have to block blows. It is a prized discipline among arena combatants.

rites.name: Naullor Toneosia
rites.text: A bound craft wraps its caster in a hardened glowing hull that adds protective toughness and soaks up incoming blows. As it weakens or fades, it releases scorching heat outward in proportion to the punishment it absorbed.

rites.name: Orosteornia
rites.text: A learned sorcerer's discipline that restores a mage's protective shield each time nearby foes fall. It also keeps the caster steady against being staggered while the shield holds.

rites.name: Liasor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a caster channel a share of a strike's force into crackling sky-fire. It only works through a slender rod of focus held in the hand.

rites.name: Vernastus
rites.text: A binding craft that forces a marked foe to fix its attention and strikes on whoever cast the binding. Affected foes strike weaker against anyone else, and the first caster keeps the hold until the binding fails.

rites.name: Nises
rites.text: A lasting wind of quickening that lifts a bearer's movements for a few brief moments. It hastens their actions by a modest measure before fading.

rites.name: Niantes
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that sharpens a practitioner's strikes so they hit harder and more often in decisive moments. It also lends extra nimbleness and a keener mind.

rites.name: Neorintus
rites.text: A learned archer's discipline that turns a share of a bowman's raw strikes into added harm of a shifting elemental kind. Slain foes wracked by lingering elemental afflictions also refill the wielder's restorative vials faster.

rites.name: Neosaunum
rites.text: A crackling discharge craft that releases its charge in a rapid string of small bursts. It works like a related frost art, but strikes with storm energy instead of cold.

rites.name: Teror Larus
rites.text: A withering curse that spreads across a wide field around its caster, slowly rotting the strength of everything it touches. As it lingers, the rot thickens and deepens its harm.

rites.name: Tesium Ciaseollum
rites.text: A learned habit of the hands that sharpens the strike of a blade and steadies the aim when a warrior carries two weapons at once.

rites.name: Valintes
rites.text: A secondary enchantment that can be applied to a skill, granting it an alternate visual or magical effect. It is found inside a twilight-sealed chest valued at a set price.

rites.name: Ristus
rites.text: A bonding craft that lets a wielder gain strength when attuned to three kinds of resonance at once. It shares attunement with the lesser forces in each strike, and empowers allied techniques while piercing protective wards according to the weakest of the three attunements.

rites.name: Caustum Mialasum
rites.text: A lasting inner resilience that raises a wielder's capacity to endure, and lends a portion of that endurance to the force of their strikes. It can only be bestowed upon a charm or a marked relic through a ritual of consecration.

rites.name: Amaunum Corisentum
rites.text: A battle-shout technique that stirs nearby allies and draws the attention of foes in range toward the user. Its next few strikes gain extra effects, and it is not counted as a sorcerous art.

rites.name: Valausum
rites.text: A rite that calls forth a mighty herald of the flowing hours. Its bond lends a steady aura of strength to allies while leaving foes untouched.

rites.name: Saureollia
rites.text: A stored reserve of hollow-tide energy that is gained only from cursed relics and from the rare trophies of the deepest dark foes. Bearers spend it to loose bolts of flame, and several shadow beasts draw upon it as well.

rites.name: Vauses
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that reshapes how a thinker perceives and reacts to the world. It works continuously in the background, never requiring a deliberate call to activate.

rites.name: Valilanum
rites.text: A bearer's chosen posture that shapes how they act and fight, taking one of two forms: a crimson mode or a dune-colored mode. It is tied to gem-marked skills and can be held by those who wield the arts of their craft.

rites.name: Oraulus Teleostus
rites.text: A lasting inner talent that sharpens a wearer's ability to dodge blows and boosts the reserve of protective shimmer around them. It also quickens how fast that shimmer mends and steels them against several elemental harms.

rites.name: Reontiastes
rites.text: A linking craft that dampens the elemental force of attached techniques while pushing their corrupting energy further. It binds to other arts and reshapes their harm toward a darker, sharper edge.

rites.name: Orinia
rites.text: A close-combat technique that strikes one foe or every foe within the reach of a blow. It can be paired with a second technique to trigger extra effects or to layer bursts across each struck enemy.

rites.name: Narnor
rites.text: A passive discipline that strengthens a warrior's strike while one posture is held and widens its reach in another. It also quickens the blows of one who has recently shifted between postures.

rites.name: Celia
rites.text: A bound technique in which the user spins in place for a set span, drawing every nearby foe inward and striking each one again and again. It is a close-quarters art of dark, consuming force.

rites.name: Sesanum Lasaunes
rites.text: A bound ward-ritual that keeps a protective reserve of inner force from stalling after a blow. It shields its bearer and nearby companions alike.

rites.name: Reornum
rites.text: A dormant ward-craft that strips away a bearer's outer barrier and spends reserve essence each moment to mend their vitality whenever it is wounded. It works only for those who keep a steady flow of essence to sustain it.

rites.name: Montor
rites.text: A channeling craft that hastens a battle-shout when it is bound to it, though the caller must then wait longer before using it again.

rites.name: Valauranum
rites.text: A charged spell-craft that hurls a lightning arc toward a foe, leaping from one victim to the next until no targets remain or its energy is spent.

rites.name: Viasantum
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that quickens the hands during sustained workings. It also lets the bearer slip past blows and resist being knocked off balance while channeling.

rites.name: Orenolia Sores
rites.text: A bright gateway-opening effect that tears a path through space when it is invoked. Its worth is counted as a fixed sum of points.

rites.name: Melium
rites.text: A creeping mental blight spreads through a wanderer's mind, dragging their steps into sluggish slowness. It cannot wound on its own, but a nearby lingering hunger gnaws at the body until the wanderer steps clear of its reach.

rites.name: Orilanum
rites.text: A charged aura that briefly frees its bearer and nearby companions from the drain of spending mana, allowing spells to be cast without that cost for a time.

rites.name: Ciarnes
rites.text: A passive craft that lengthens the time a tainted wound festers and raises the chance each strike leaves a venom behind. It also intensifies slow rot damage and sharpens void-touched blows delivered by attacks.

rites.name: Sanerium
rites.text: A bound technique that lets a caster's linked incantation ride along with each shot loosed from a handheld rod, adding the rod's force to the working. The bound incantation holds a share of the caster's inner reserve while it persists.

rites.name: Sereontum Leornus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the strikes of one's followers and steadies the aim of the bearer. It also magnifies or dulls the force with which those followers hit.

rites.name: Lauliarnes
rites.text: A dawnlight charm that imbues a weapon with a brief rising glow. It is sold in a sealed twilight casket that costs one hundred eighty tokens.

rites.name: Costus
rites.text: A minor inborn knack that makes snares strike harder and sense a wider ring around them. It is a simple, steady talent that every trapper can learn early.

rites.name: Causor
rites.text: A whirling storm of sharp edges is conjured to spin through the air, striking foes repeatedly with cutting force. It drifts toward nearby enemies for as long as it endures.

rites.name: Teliaror
rites.text: A quiet practice that sharpens the odds of a decisive hit for snares and buried charges placed by a wanderer. It is a simple inherited knack that every apprentice trapper learns early.

rites.name: Orasistor
rites.text: A binding craft that lets an attached technique call forth a spectral servant when a foe falls or when a rare, singular adversary is struck. The summoned shade then fights alongside its caller.

rites.name: Orarum Cornes
rites.text: A steadfast discipline that guarantees a practitioner cannot be knocked off balance, at the cost of being unable to dodge incoming blows.

rites.name: Raulium Amosantum
rites.text: A ritual sigil is planted at a chosen spot, and while it holds, bolts crack down on nearby foes. When it fades, a massive surge detonates there and triggers every other sigil of the same working.

rites.name: Cirnares
rites.text: A corrupted melee strike that releases bursts of crackling shards from whatever it hits, or from the ground when it strikes nothing. The shards' force scales with the wielder's arms.

rites.name: Tillor
rites.text: A deadly craft of the blade-wielding stalkers, where a venom laid by a perfect strike grows fiercer, and each poisoned foe makes the next killing blow more likely.

rites.name: Malinus
rites.text: A trained discipline that lets a warrior hold a steadfast reserve of resilience, growing it when struck and sometimes filling it to its full measure at once. The reserve gradually rebuilds while the warrior has recently endured a blow.

rites.name: Maurellanum
rites.text: A battle-hardened craft that turns the force of a war cry into fury, which can be spent to empower strikes. The strength of nearby foes deepens the cry itself.

rites.name: Tanium
rites.text: A practiced knack for a wanderer who strikes quickly, where each felled foe may stir a surge of ferocity or mana. Sustained focus keeps building these surges, and holding more of them makes each blow hit harder.

rites.name: Marum Telirium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens a wielder's strikes with small blades, quickening their hand. Part of each blow's force is drawn back to restore the wielder's vitality and inner reserves.

rites.name: Lasum Nauntiaror
rites.text: A disciplined vow that quickens the hands, feet, and casting of those standing close to its bearer. Each blow they land strikes fear into foes, leaving them more exposed to harm.

rites.name: Oraserium
rites.text: A quiet, learned knack that lets a hunter set their snares faster and makes each snare strike harder. It is a common habit taught to beginners in the craft.

rites.name: Sernus
rites.text: A passive discipline that halts a body's ability to reclaim life drawn from wounds it inflicts. In exchange, each measure of lost recovery steadily toughens the bearer against incoming harm.

rites.name: Millia
rites.text: A deep, singular discipline that lets a wearer's protective gear blunt harsh elements instead of blows, at the cost of lowering the wearer's natural endurance against those same elements.

rites.name: Lesum Vaullastor
rites.text: A quickening of the hand that sends snares and bindings flying through the air. It is the animated motion by which such devices are hurled.

rites.name: Sialia
rites.text: A tempered blade-art that unleashes two swift strikes while calling forth a pair of shadowed mirror-selves to fight alongside the wielder for a brief span.

rites.name: Nallium Vonialia
rites.text: A short-lived spinning storm that rises for a few moments before bursting open. Its burst lends a temporary boost to everyone caught inside its reach, friend and foe alike, while overlapping bursts simply extend that same boost rather than piling it up.

rites.name: Viallia Vostaures
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a thrower hurl snares and buried charges faster. It is a simple discipline taught early to anyone who sets devices by hand.

rites.name: Telistor Lisum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that reshapes how a combat art behaves, letting an artisan bend its strikes into a new form. It is sold through a traders' stall for a modest fee.

rites.name: Corolus
rites.text: A linked craft that changes a chosen power so the caster sets an unseen snare instead of acting at once. The first foe that steps into its reach springs the snare, is struck by the power, and the snare is then spent.

rites.name: Caustanum
rites.text: A passive craft that strengthens a fighter's elemental strikes with blades and staves, and gives each blow a chance to inflict lightning stun, frost binding, or fiery burning.

rites.name: Amanus Rianerum
rites.text: A trained gift that lets a skirmisher draw stored momentum into a protective shell, reducing incoming harm. Every direct blow strips the stored momentum away, while lingering burning or poison leaves it intact.

rites.name: Voliastes
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a bearer's blades and staves deal more burning harm. It is a simple, everyday knack taught to wielders of arms.

rites.name: Morauntia
rites.text: A fighter lunges forward in a chosen direction, striking every foe passed along the way. The rush lets the wielder carve through a crowd in a single bounding motion.

rites.name: Mintostia
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that only takes hold when a cluster of gems is set into one's personal web of learned abilities. It appears alongside certain binding enchantments.

rites.name: Vellum Corellostus
rites.text: A widening crest of raw energy rolls forward in a cone, striking every foe within its path over time. Each struck foe is marked with a lingering weakness tied to whichever elemental force hurt them most, and only one such crest may roll at once.

rites.name: Niaranum Neornus
rites.text: A ward-stone that lets a chosen craft sometimes leave a creeping decay upon struck foes, so that each layer of rot makes them more vulnerable to unseen corruption. It also lends extra decaying force drawn from the strength of blows.

rites.name: Orontiastes
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets a wandering rogue channel more spellpower into swift, nimble movement. Brief bursts of speed follow each swift dash, and the caster sometimes regains a portion of their reserve.

rites.name: Amantus
rites.text: A minor passive craft found only on mid-sized cluster charms. It strengthens blade-wielders, boosting harm dealt by edged weapons and the lingering wounds they leave behind.

rites.name: Corauranum Teleones
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that alters how a skill behaves. It is bought from a merchant's stall for a modest sum of currency.

rites.name: Nastia
rites.text: A nimble way of moving that grants evasion and brief slips through space. Foes drawing close while evasion holds are sapped, so they suffer greater harm from a corrosive force; any other action ends the technique and clears every lingering enhancement.

rites.name: Cenus
rites.text: Cenus is the concept of the first wall raised in the Walled Age of Ameosastia, the idea that a boundary can hold back what would otherwise pour through. Its influence was felt when the grove-kingdoms first learned to close their gates against the sea and the wild. The concept is remembered mostly through the orders that kept its stones standing.

rites.name: Anavamari
rites.text: Anavamari is the concept of the wall-keeping orders of Ameosastia, the discipline that taught holding a border against the sea and the dark beyond it. In the Walled Age its keepers were measured by what they could hold back, and in the Age of Sundering the concept was tested as landfall broke the old bonds between shores.

rites.name: Listus
rites.text: A minor inherited gift for a fighter-class path that lets a warrior draw back a portion of the life they take from foes with each strike.

rites.name: Orolor
rites.text: A stronger rendering of a common enhancement, found through exploration. It lets linked abilities launch one more shot than the ordinary version.

rites.name: Relleoria
rites.text: A zone of set reach that strikes every foe standing inside it at once. Techniques carrying this trait bear a marking that shows their wide sweep.

rites.name: Serarnialus
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that changes how a skill looks when it is used. It is sold through a digital storefront for a modest sum of premium currency.

rites.name: Tiaranum
rites.text: A quiet inherited talent that strengthens the lifeforce of bound servants and shields newly called ones from harm. It awakens only when clustered crystal charms are set into a wanderer's path of learning.

rites.name: Coresor
rites.text: A sealed foretelling that can be combined with a particular ambush modifier. Its effects accumulate alongside that other enchantment.

rites.name: Rirnanum
rites.text: A bond that alternates a wearer between two states, one granting concealment and sharp strikes, the other swiftness of hand and foot. Each state runs on its own timer that keeps counting even when the bond is paused.

rites.name: Raurosum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that strengthens bound companions, making their strikes hit harder and lowering the energy their summoned arts consume. It also deepens the wielder's own reserve of mana.

rites.name: Lolenes
rites.text: A purchasable visual flourish that alters how a particular combat technique looks when it lands. It is sold through a digital storefront for a modest fee.

rites.name: Contus
rites.text: A decorative visual effect that can be applied to a fighting technique to change how it looks. It can be bought for a set price from a marketplace or found inside a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Sanausum
rites.text: A cosmetic visual variant that changes how a magical aura looks around its wielder. It can be bought with a set price from a digital store and was once found as a seasonal prize.

rites.name: Tilleones
rites.text: A lingering effect that alters a being's capacities, marked by a green frame around its emblem. Its harmful counterpart bears a red frame instead.

rites.name: Leolanum
rites.text: A shimmering passage effect that opens a route between distant points. It once came bundled with a supporter gift for the wider community.

rites.name: Rilanum
rites.text: A bought variant of the power that lets a ward or blessing take on a new appearance. It is offered through a marketplace for a modest fee.

rites.name: Leonium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a skill behaves when used. It is sold through a digital shop for a modest fee of virtual currency.

rites.name: Lanesum
rites.text: A shimmering visual overlay that a bearer can acquire through a trading marketplace for a modest sum. It was once contained within a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Seristium
rites.text: A bound craft that lets a linked incantation fire on its own whenever the caster is knocked senseless or shrugs off a dazing blow. It turns a moment of stunning into a counterstrike.

rites.name: Meostor
rites.text: A bought cosmetic variant that alters how aura effects appear around a wielder. It can also be found as a prize inside a sealed crate of mysteries.

rites.name: Nenteolium
rites.text: A paid cosmetic variant that alters how a frost burst appears when it is cast. It is sold through an in-world marketplace for a set price.

rites.name: Lolises
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that lets a skill's weapon take on a starry, self-moving form. It is bought from a community marketplace for a modest sum.

rites.name: Orisontum
rites.text: A glowing sigil that can be bound to a blade so it lends the weapon a special striking effect. It cannot be bought from merchants and was once offered only in a bundled collector's set.

rites.name: Telleoses
rites.text: A linking charm that makes a bound spell fire automatically whenever the wielder lands a decisive blow with the attack it is joined to. It turns a precise strike into a trigger for sorcery.

rites.name: Serianum
rites.text: A purchasable modification that alters how a skill behaves, bought with a set amount of points from a merchant. It was once offered inside a seasonal reward chest.

rites.name: Siallantium
rites.text: A radiant opening that briefly forms a passage between places. It is a shimmering effect that a user can call upon, and it carries a steep price in value.

rites.name: Merausanum
rites.text: A gate effect that opens with a surge of dark flame and can be acquired through a merchant's exchange for a modest sum of tokens. It serves as a cosmetic flourish that lets travelers announce their arrival.

rites.name: Tisiastum
rites.text: A learned talent that amplifies the force of snares and buried charges set against foes. Each time one detonates or springs on an enemy, there is a chance the wielder gathers a surge of stored energy.

rites.name: Oraustillus
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a trapped charge widen its reach and strike harder after one has just gone off. It also expands the blast radius of all such traps.

rites.name: Senor
rites.text: A glowing gateway effect that opens a passage between distant points. It was once bundled into a collector's supporter bundle.

rites.name: Mestes
rites.text: A glowing cosmetic visual that changes how a spherical lightning strike appears when it is unleashed. It is sold for a small sum of trade credits in a merchant's catalog.

rites.name: Caullestus
rites.text: A gateway rite bound to a paid tribute bundle, offered in two tiers of supporter packs. It lets its bearer open a passage between distant lands.

rites.name: Orisum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a skill functions. It is sold through a digital marketplace for a modest price in tokens.

rites.name: Amelum
rites.text: A shimmering cosmetic cloak that alters how a spell's wraith appears when called forth. Travelers acquire it through a marketplace stall for a modest sum of tokens.

rites.name: Riasum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that changes how a practiced skill appears when used. It can be acquired through a digital marketplace for a modest price, and it was once offered inside a randomized reward chest.

rites.name: Renanum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that alters how a skill operates. It is acquired through a paid marketplace for a fixed sum of points.

rites.name: Orausanor
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic overlay that alters how a fighting technique looks when used. It is bought with a premium currency from a traders' market.

rites.name: Ciarnor
rites.text: A recurring trait of hurled missiles and linked spells, causing them to rebound from whatever they strike and hunt out other foes lying close by.

rites.name: Valestanum
rites.text: A cosmetic variant that alters how a frost-based projectile appears in flight, bending the air around it into a dark swirl. It is bought with a small sum of premium currency.

rites.name: Naurnor Taustes
rites.text: A fighter's practice that stores a surge after each lethal strike, quickening their hands. Each stored surge hastens their blows but dulls their aim for lethal hits, and the stored surges fade away after a few moments.

rites.name: Vintor
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that a traveler can acquire for a modest sum of tokens. It sends glowing rifts swirling around its wielder as they step through.

rites.name: Amelises
rites.text: A basic innate craft that strengthens the striking power of its bearer and of the servants bound to them. It needs no effort to keep active.

rites.name: Teornianor
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that is no longer offered for purchase. It was once bundled inside a costly supporter bundle sold during a limited-time promotion.

rites.name: Amenum
rites.text: A quiet passive gift found only within large gem clusters. It sharpens elemental strikes and deepens lingering afflictions, while adding extra chances to chill, jolt, and set foes alight.

rites.name: Teleontus
rites.text: Cosmetic adornments that change how attached abilities look and sound. Many are bought for coin, while some are earned by finishing a set number of trials in a special competition.

rites.name: Valernor
rites.text: A minor passive discipline that quickens a wielder's striking rhythm and stride. It is one of the basic lesser gifts taught within an elite ascension path.

rites.name: Riastia
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a skill behaves when used. It is bought with a set amount of currency from a digital storefront.

rites.name: Oranolia
rites.text: A shimmering opening that carries travelers between distant points. It was once bundled among the gifts offered to those who backed a particular cause.

rites.name: Amaullianus
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a combat technique looks when used. It is bought with a premium currency from an online storefront.

rites.name: Oranosor
rites.text: A dark visual variant that alters how aura effects appear around a user. It can be acquired through a paid digital marketplace and was once available as a random reward from a crate.

rites.name: Viastalia
rites.text: A glowing visual aura that can be acquired through a purchasable offering. It was also included as a prize within a sealed mystery crate.

rites.name: Ciania
rites.text: A frosty glimmer that can be attached to a hand-held implement to dress it in icy light. Traders sell it for a modest sum of tokens, and it once turned up sealed inside a winter prize chest.

rites.name: Coraunintum
rites.text: A bloodthirsty enchantment that lends a blade a dark, sanguine sheen. It is no longer sold, having been bundled into a warrior's patron kit.

rites.name: Niaresor
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens strikes made while a fighter is gathering power. Being struck during that gathering can also stir up stored vigor or fury, and a certain charm can awaken this build-up without waiting for foes to land blows.

rites.name: Amentarum
rites.text: A passive talent that can only surface when clustered gems are set into a wanderer's branching tree of learned arts. It appears when specific charm-enchantments are applied to it.

rites.name: Tases
rites.text: A stored reserve of dark energy that can be drawn upon in place of other charges. It is granted only through a particular modifier, and other effects are needed to build up a frenzy-type charge.

rites.name: Valanor Sistum
rites.text: A passive craft that expands a practitioner's reserve of inner energy. It refills that energy faster from potions and makes each potion last longer and hit harder.

rites.name: Ceones Launtia
rites.text: A radiant mark that a rare relic bestows on its bearer, letting a shining veil spread outward. Only a few supporting charms can shape its reach, and just two of them truly change how it works.

rites.name: Corises
rites.text: A frost-touched visual adornment that can be bought for a set price. It changes how a learned technique appears when used.

rites.name: Coreonium
rites.text: A raw assault technique that a wielder can unleash as an alternate form of rush. It is granted only through a particular modification, and other gear or innate talents are needed to make it available.

rites.name: Nellor
rites.text: Two paired traits that once bestowed special abilities upon creatures. Each one lets a creature gain a set of strange powers.

rites.name: Corestor
rites.text: A measure of how quickly a bearer moves and acts, governing running, striking, invoking, and recovering from a stunning blow. Its total bonus can be inspected on the bearer's standing record, beneath the guardian's section.

rites.name: Orallia
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that changes how a skill is performed. It alters the way a ranged volley falls upon its targets.

rites.name: Valiasium
rites.text: A linked gift that lends a surge of corrupting void energy to every strike or blast it accompanies. Its extra force also seeps into lingering toxic afflictions, making them hit harder.

rites.name: Telanor
rites.text: A cosmetic visual overlay that alters how certain abilities appear when used. It is sold for a modest sum in a digital storefront and was once contained in a random reward chest.

rites.name: Valaunus
rites.text: A bought cosmetic glow that changes how a sustained enchantment looks when it is cast. It is sold through a traded storefront for a small sum of tokens.

rites.name: Casintus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that lowers the strain a caster feels when channeling spells. It also strengthens the lasting protective and empowering auras the bearer projects over others.

rites.name: Tantes Valauntanum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic appearance that transforms a wielder's skill effects into a frozen, glacial form. It can be bought from a marketplace or obtained from a sealed mystery crate.

rites.name: Ciallanum Niasinum
rites.text: A bought cosmetic enhancement that alters how a ranged attack looks when it is fired. It is sold through a store for a small price.

rites.name: Valastium Linium
rites.text: A paid cosmetic overlay that gives a skill a swirling, pulling appearance when activated. It is bought with premium currency from a shop.

rites.name: Serelires
rites.text: A cosmetic shimmer that wraps a traveler's passage between places. It is sold for a modest fee and was once offered as a prize in a sealed chest.

rites.name: Taria
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a leaping ground-pound behaves. It is bought with a premium currency from an online marketplace.

rites.name: Lintastium
rites.text: A shadowy visual finish that can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a modest sum. It was also once offered as a reward inside a sealed lottery chest.

rites.name: Amorestor
rites.text: A blessing that lets every kind of harm a fighter deals carry the burn, frost, and spark effects, ignoring the normal rule that each harm can cause only its own.

rites.name: Mernium
rites.text: A trained craft of a nimble rogue that hastens strikes and spellcasting while lingering wounds grow more harmful over time.

rites.name: Caulum
rites.text: A dark aura that can be acquired through a digital storefront for a modest sum. It was once offered inside a randomized reward chest.

rites.name: Teosantium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate visual effect that alters how a skill appears when it is used. It can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a small fee.

rites.name: Callenum
rites.text: A shimmering gate-glow that surrounds a traveler when they step through a passage. It is sold only in a bundled set of goods offered to a patron who backs the realm.

rites.name: Teoranum
rites.text: A minor inherited discipline taught to wardens of the fallen-blade order. It sharpens a practitioner's strikes so their force reaches a wider ring around the target.

rites.name: Vostanum
rites.text: A paid cosmetic variation that alters how a snare of storm energy looks when it is set. It is sold through a digital marketplace for a modest fee.

rites.name: Rirnastus
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that modifies a skill's behavior, sold through a storefront for a set price. It was once offered inside a randomized reward crate.

rites.name: Misia
rites.text: A paid cosmetic-style modifier sold through a storefront, granting an alternate skill effect for a fixed price. It was not part of the original reward chest and was added afterward.

rites.name: Talliaror
rites.text: A measure of how many blows a fighter can deliver within a single heartbeat of time. It is shown through the swift, repeated swing of a held implement.

rites.name: Leolanum Lauror
rites.text: A bought alternate effect that changes how a skill is performed, letting it leave a trail of dark fire behind its movement. It can also be won from a sealed reward box.

rites.name: Lintastes
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a skill behaves, sold through a digital storefront for a modest fee. It alters the visual and mechanical flavor of a skill once applied.

rites.name: Relles Neoria
rites.text: A quiet mental discipline that doubles a bearer's resistance to corrupting chaos. It only takes hold when a charm or trinket has been blessed by an appointed keeper of rites.

rites.name: Celantum
rites.text: A purchasable visual upgrade that changes how a fiery arcane attack looks, letting it roll across the ground as a bubbling trail of corrosive molten slag.

rites.name: Amasorum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a skill appears when used. It is bought from a digital storefront with a small sum of premium currency.

rites.name: Rornianum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a skill behaves, bought with a small sum of currency. It was once offered as a reward inside a sealed mystery crate.

rites.name: Nauria
rites.text: A shimmering cosmetic variant that changes how a ranged attack looks, swirling its projectiles into a glassy vortex. It is bought with a small sum of premium currency from a traveling merchant's stall.

rites.name: Vintaunum
rites.text: A paid performance motion that a character can adopt for their own movements. It is bought through an in-world marketplace at a set price.

rites.name: Vinialus
rites.text: A paid cosmetic attunement that alters how a fighting technique looks when it is used. It is bought through a merchant's storefront and grants a new visual flourish to a chosen skill.

rites.name: Laurnum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a certain attack looks, turning its blasts into falling dark motes. It was once sold inside a rare mystery crate.

rites.name: Nauntalium
rites.text: A gateway-opening craft that arrives as part of a supporter bundle. It shapes a passage between distant places.

rites.name: Ameosonanum
rites.text: A top-tier enchantment that can only be bound onto marked relics, raising an existing lesser binding into a stronger form. It cannot be produced by any other craft and can be moved between relics by a special token.

rites.name: Sesilum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wearer dodge incoming blows more easily while a protective field of shimmering force grows stronger around the body.

rites.name: Celleontum
rites.text: A ghostly flame variant that alters how a projectile skill behaves, bought from a storefront using premium currency. It changes the look and feel of an attack without adding new powers.

rites.name: Mausum
rites.text: A bound craft that sets off buried snares on command, letting a practitioner trigger them through a linked focus that can be shaped by attached aids. It works where the plain trigger cannot.

rites.name: Roseornum
rites.text: A purchasable visual variant that changes how a melee strike sequence looks when activated. It is sold for a modest price through a digital storefront.

rites.name: Telauntia Seosum
rites.text: A ghostly cosmetic overlay that alters how a summoned phantom appears during a spell. It is sold as an optional add-on for a fee.

rites.name: Leror
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that can only awaken when fragments of a gathered crystal are set into a wanderer's personal branching map. It may stir within ordinary tokens or those bearing certain charms.

rites.name: Amaunanum Teolirus
rites.text: A sanctified drifting wind-charm that a wearer can buy from a merchant's catalogue of ornamental skill-flourishes. It was once sealed inside a traveling mystery chest.

rites.name: Niallia
rites.text: A purchasable visual ornament that changes how a combat technique looks when used. It can be bought with a fixed sum of currency and was also offered as a reward from a sealed chest.

rites.name: Valontirnus
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that alters how a combat technique looks when used. It is offered through a commercial storefront for a modest price.

rites.name: Raullontus
rites.text: A shimmering aura that a traveler can acquire through a merchant's exchange for a modest tally of tokens. It wraps the wearer in pale, drifting embers.

rites.name: Amiastus Corallium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a skill behaves, offered through a marketplace of cosmetic and convenience add-ons. It can be bought for a modest sum of premium currency.

rites.name: Tallausium
rites.text: A ghostly, cursed visual flourish that can be applied to a throwing technique, making each hurled strike trail dark wraith-light. It is sold for a modest sum through a private storefront.

rites.name: Serilanum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate skill effect that changes how an ability behaves once acquired. It can be bought through an in-world marketplace and was also offered inside a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Valausarium
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that alters how a skill plays out. It is bought through a store for a modest price.

rites.name: Collarnum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how sustained enchantments look and behave. It is acquired through a paid digital store.

rites.name: Corirum
rites.text: A close-quarters strike that calls forth a loyal guardian when a foe falls or a rare enemy is struck. The guardian takes on the traits of the creature it was raised from.

rites.name: Oraulanor
rites.text: A bought-in skill effect that lets a warrior's guard gather a charge of dark fire. The effect is sold through a merchant's stall for a modest sum of coin.

rites.name: Teliasinum
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a practitioner's striking force while lending a thin layer of protective barrier. It is taught as a foundational art requiring no special ritual to maintain.

rites.name: Lernium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a skill behaves, sold through a storefront for a fixed price of points. It is a cosmetic-style modifier attached to existing abilities.

rites.name: Valaunesum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a wielder strike more quickly and parry more often when holding two blades at once.

rites.name: Niallum
rites.text: A shimmering cloak of drifting embers that can be acquired through a trade vendor. It alters how a summoning rite appears when cast.

rites.name: Relosium
rites.text: A dim, shadowy aura that can be applied to a blade or staff to give it a sinister look. It is acquired through a paid marketplace of cosmetic enhancements.

rites.name: Raustalia
rites.text: A purchasable alternate skill effect that changes how a fighting technique strikes. It can be bought with a set price in a shop and was once offered inside a random reward box.

rites.name: Masornus
rites.text: A bought cosmetic charm that alters how a skill looks when used. It can be acquired from a shop or a sealed chest, and was once granted as a reward for taking part in a promotion.

rites.name: Lontia
rites.text: A rule that lets harm arriving in one form be received as harm of a different form. It changes how injuries are recorded and felt by the one who suffers them.

rites.name: Lastirium
rites.text: A paid cosmetic overlay that changes how a skill looks when used. Buyers acquire it from a storefront using premium currency.

rites.name: Viaronia
rites.text: A temporary protective ward that softens incoming blows, letting a bearer take a fifth less harm from strikes for a short span of moments. It does nothing against slow lingering afflictions that never strike.

rites.name: Cirum
rites.text: A lingering affliction that steadily wears down a bearer's body with unseen harm. It is cast alongside two paired hindrances that slow or freeze the victim.

rites.name: Cenes
rites.text: A stored charge that gathers from a binding stone in intervals and builds to a set cap. Each time the bearer is struck, one charge is spent to restore a small portion of protective energy.

rites.name: Vianastum
rites.text: A blanket amplifier that strengthens every kind of harm a fighter deals, whether from strikes, incantations, or lingering wounds. It may be marked simply as an increase without naming its source.

rites.name: Cauriases
rites.text: A standing discipline that lets allied followers turn aside more blows and mend a portion of their strength whenever they successfully repel an incoming strike.

rites.name: Corilia
rites.text: A gateway flourish that opens a passage between distant places. It was once bundled into a patron's collection of bonus gear.

rites.name: Corilus Noseornum
rites.text: A bought alternate variant that changes how a summoned sigil-bearing servant behaves. It can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a set price.

rites.name: Reolor
rites.text: A radiant hex that clings to a victim after a sacred ray has passed over them. Its primary mark lingers long after the ray itself has faded away.

rites.name: Voneontor
rites.text: A stacking hex that clings to a bearer and grows heavier each time it is laid on. It is woven by rotating luminous rods during a towering rival's last stand.

rites.name: Valantes
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a skill appears and behaves, sold for a fixed price in a digital storefront. It alters the visual presentation of an existing ability.

rites.name: Telania
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that opens a passage between two points when activated. It can be obtained through a paid cosmetic-style offering in the marketplace.

rites.name: Ciasum Amiaror
rites.text: This measures the harm a defender actually suffers once every shield and reduction has been applied. It mirrors the attacker's total, viewed from the side being struck.

rites.name: Coresania
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a skill behaves when it is used. Buyers acquire it through a marketplace using a set price in a premium currency.

rites.name: Venaurus
rites.text: A trained technique for stalkers that sharpens the odds of a deadly blow and deepens the harm of lingering wounds. It is practiced by those who slip through shadow to strike unseen.

rites.name: Viantaunum
rites.text: A nimble practitioner converts the sturdiness of a crested headpiece into swiftness of dodge, and the bulk of a chest guard into a shimmering barrier. Charges of a cloaking veil quicken strikes and spellwork, and while the veil holds, the bearer cannot be dazed.

rites.name: Tauntiallus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that slowly strengthens a wielder's blows the longer a struggle drags on, while extending how long their lingering arts endure.

rites.name: Terisanum
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by mystic channelers that amplifies the elemental force of their attacks and deepens the chilling afflictions they inflict on foes.

rites.name: Costiallus
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that alters how a skill appears when used. It can be bought with a small sum from a marketplace and was once offered inside a randomized reward chest.

rites.name: Teleostor
rites.text: A purchasable modifier that alters how a trap-based ability behaves, letting its frozen effect bloom differently. It is bought with a small sum of currency from an in-world market.

rites.name: Sontium
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a skill appears when used, cast with a fiery shade. It can also be obtained from a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Teleontus Telastus
rites.text: A lingering surge that steadily intensifies the harm dealt by abilities bound to a special ward. The longer the surge holds, the heavier the blows become.

rites.name: Serellia Amoliantium
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a wielder of a staff widen the reach of their effects, quicken their strikes and speed their incantations. It grows stronger as stored power gathers around the bearer.

rites.name: Saselium
rites.text: A flowing rhythmic gesture that a wanderer can acquire through a traders' exchange for a modest sum of tokens. It shows a figure moving in a bright, looping motion.

rites.name: Raustilium
rites.text: A purchasable visual alteration that changes how certain abilities appear when used. It can be acquired through a digital storefront and was once offered inside a randomized reward chest.

rites.name: Telausum
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that makes a protective barrier of stored vitality refill more swiftly after it has been worn down. It also lets the barrier hold a little more of that vitality at its fullest.

rites.name: Amistus
rites.text: A glittering fragment that alters how a skill strikes the ground, making each blow send crystalline shudders through the earth. It is offered for purchase through a merchant's catalogue.

rites.name: Rolum
rites.text: A linked craft that finishes off a foe left nearly spent by a supported strike, ending it at once. Lingering wounds and steady bleeding cannot trigger it, and certain mightiest champions and final phases of the strongest foes resist its hold.

rites.name: Mornes Viarillor
rites.text: A temporary surge that empowers a bearer's elemental strikes for a few brief moments. It can be layered together with a related surge of the same kind.

rites.name: Leoliastum
rites.text: A premium cosmetic visual enhancement that transforms a skill's appearance into a swirling dark orb. It is purchased from a digital storefront for a fixed amount of virtual currency.

rites.name: Teostum
rites.text: A minor alternate technique that reshapes how a known skill performs in combat. It can be acquired through a paid store for a small sum of currency.

rites.name: Riseollia
rites.text: A shimmering alternate display that replaces the usual appearance of certain practiced abilities. It can be acquired for a price and changes how those abilities look when used.

rites.name: Corolia
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that heightens storm-born force, quickens the hands in casting, sharpens the mark of decisive blows, and deepens the stagger left by a jolt.

rites.name: Amonauntes
rites.text: A basic inner discipline taught to killers of the Hollow Circle, sharpening their chance to land a decisive blow and deepening the force of that blow once struck.

rites.name: Coreollanum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic visual variant that changes how a certain spell's flames appear. It can be bought with a modest sum from a digital storefront and was once also found inside a rewards chest.

rites.name: Casollor
rites.text: A tuned passive craft that shifts a target's guard whenever it is struck by fire, lightning, or frost. The struck element gains a firm defense while the others weaken, and each new blow overwrites the last for a short span.

rites.name: Mirnostia
rites.text: A bonded discipline that quickens the wielder's strikes and incantations while sharpening the elemental force within them. It is a foundational practice taught to those who wield authority through judgment.

rites.name: Vistellor
rites.text: A purchasable motion routine that a character can perform while idle. It is sold through a digital storefront as a cosmetic add-on.

rites.name: Ventor
rites.text: A ghostly spectral form that can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a modest sum. It serves as a cosmetic visual flourish that clothes a wielder in a haunting, translucent aura.

rites.name: Valares
rites.text: A stackable hindrance that clings to a bearer as a pale, drifting weight. It works like a clinging growth, yet it is spun by a skilled weaver to help a great guardian in battle.

rites.name: Raullor
rites.text: A bloody mark that follows a wanderer's steps, bought with a small sum of coins from a traveling merchant's stall. It was once sold for a time and then sent away from the markets.

rites.name: Vornia Raurnes
rites.text: A tally that carries no force of its own. It is kept by a wind-attuned skill and amplifies other powers in proportion to how many marks are held.

rites.name: Riasteorum
rites.text: A ritual charm that empowers the bearer so every strike seeds a creeping poison in foes. The poison gnaws at the body over time, building in strength up to ten layers.

rites.name: Amesor Veliarum
rites.text: A passive talent found only on large gem clusters. It lets attacks recover a portion of dealt harm as health, and while this recovery is active, strikes hit harder and quicker.

rites.name: Amaurnus
rites.text: A faint trail of spectral fire follows a wanderer's steps, bought with a small token of coin. It is a decorative mark that changes only how the ground looks beneath the traveler.

rites.name: Ciastarum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant of a ranged skill that makes its arrows crackle with storm energy and spatter in a bloody style. It can be bought from a marketplace or obtained from a reward chest.

rites.name: Nisanum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that changes how a leaping strike looks when it lands. It is sold through a digital storefront.

rites.name: Selum
rites.text: A keystone discipline that quietly builds up protective veils around its practitioner over time. Each blow that lands strips one veil away and restores a little of their hidden reserve.

rites.name: Vellanum
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by a holy hunter, granting stronger elemental blows along with steady restoration of the body's vitality.

rites.name: Vollium Sillanum
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lets a warrior bearing two blades turn aside more incoming strikes, while striking faster and harder with both weapons.

rites.name: Vostiarnus
rites.text: A dual-natured enchantment that both bolsters and burdens its bearer. It is drawn from an indestructible marker raised by a trial's shifting rule, and its sigil sits among the other lingering effects along the top edge of one's vision.

rites.name: Cises
rites.text: A ranged strike technique that hurls a chain of linked bolts through a foe's ranks. Each bolt can leave a lingering venom, and a critical hit makes the venom burn harder over time.

rites.name: Lesus
rites.text: A paid visual flourish that alters how a combat technique appears when used. It can be bought from a merchant's catalog and also drops from a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Valialus
rites.text: A paid cosmetic variant that alters how a certain skill plays out, letting a bought spectral flourish replace the standard visual. It is sold through an in-world merchant for a fixed price of currency.

rites.name: Coraunanum Riantus
rites.text: A glowing cosmetic trail that a wanderer can buy from a traders' market for a small sum of currency. It leaves bright marks on the ground as its owner walks.

rites.name: Varnor Mallernium
rites.text: A marksman's refined discipline lets each launched bolt pass through several foes and strike more surely when it pierces. Its piercing shots gain a sharper chance for lethal blows.

rites.name: Vellia
rites.text: A quiet, passive discipline that lowers the amount of inner energy held back by each practiced art. It is a simple, everyday technique that eases the burden of sustaining many skills at once.

rites.name: Tasor
rites.text: A glowing trail effect that appears beneath a traveler's feet as they walk. It can be acquired through a digital marketplace for a modest sum of virtual currency.

rites.name: Oraunum Valernium
rites.text: A passive talent that can be gained through a sprawling skill web or a particular inheritance. It grants its holder a lasting trait, drawn from a set of random gifts.

rites.name: Nelleonus
rites.text: A dusk-born enchantment that alters how a sustained protective glow behaves. It can be obtained from a sealed twilight chest that costs a modest sum of points to open.

rites.name: Oreosternum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a skill appears, letting its attacks rain down in a dim, noxious mist. It is sold through a marketplace for a modest price.

rites.name: Oronaulum
rites.text: A passive art that strengthens the blasts of buried snares, letting them hit harder and linger longer once set. It is a simple, foundational discipline taught early to those who lay traps.

rites.name: Corelor
rites.text: A debuff that strips a creature's protection against elemental harm, leaving it open to wider damage. It affects only foes and is marked with the same glyph as a related weakness.

rites.name: Telalirnor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quietly strengthens the force and quickness with which one hurls buried snares. It requires no special training to begin practicing.

rites.name: Seontiarnum
rites.text: A decorative shimmer that wraps around a gateway when it opens. Travellers may acquire it through a merchant's shop for a small fee.

rites.name: Amauniror
rites.text: A tinted trail that marks each step a wanderer takes with a violet shimmer. It can be bought from a traveling vendor or received as a gift in a bundle of trinkets.

rites.name: Sallor
rites.text: A shimmering aura that a wanderer can acquire through a merchant's exchange. It once appeared inside a sealed chest sold at a traveling bazaar.

rites.name: Lostia Nastianum
rites.text: A surplus of force that a blow carries beyond what a foe's remaining vitality can absorb. It arises only when the strike both ends a life and exceeds the amount still held in that life.

rites.name: Lausor Corilia
rites.text: A glowing violet spectral form that can be acquired from a merchant's catalog for a set price in tokens. It serves as a decorative visual effect that trails behind its bearer.

rites.name: Liarnes
rites.text: A gate-opening rite that is bundled into a paid supporter package sold for a fixed sum. It lets a traveler step through a shimmering threshold.

rites.name: Nestalium
rites.text: A discipline of the arcane tradition that rewards the caster with restored mana whenever foes are weakened by applied exposure. Exposure from this practitioner also cuts a foe's elemental defenses further.

rites.name: Telistanum
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that opens a passage between two points. It is offered as a paid bundle add-on for devoted backers.

rites.name: Corestalles
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that deepens a wielder's reservoir of arcane energy and quickens how swiftly it refills. It also sharpens the mind's reasoning.

rites.name: Vauror
rites.text: A support craft that lets linked techniques hit as though the wielder stands within striking reach of the foe. Their strength is counted as if this close-range discipline were already mastered.

rites.name: Ceolus
rites.text: A basic passive craft that makes thrown explosive charges fly faster from the hand. It quietly boosts the speed at which a bearer hurls their traps.

rites.name: Seontillia
rites.text: A guide's sworn passive that turns a portion of blows into a corrosive, shadowy force. It sharpens strikes with attack techniques and widens the reach of corrupting arts.

rites.name: Callor
rites.text: A lasting inner gift that raises the total reserve of arcane energy a bearer can hold. Each successful strike also replenishes a little of that energy.

rites.name: Teleontor Callanum
rites.text: A devotional glow that a guardian draws from inner conviction, lending a shimmering protective aura to nearby allies. Those touched by it can amplify their own sheltering ward.

rites.name: Telistus
rites.text: A lingering affliction that weakens a creature's ability to guard against blows for a brief span. It can be inflicted again and again, stacking its weakening effect each time.

rites.name: Serirnum
rites.text: A recurring effect that restores a portion of the harm a wielder has suffered back into their vital reserves, spread gradually over a few moments. It is a named category of enchantments that channel lost strength back into the body or into a protective barrier.

rites.name: Orarisum
rites.text: A coded glow that lets a warding aura shimmer in a different style. It can be drawn from a sealed chest that costs a set amount of merit to open.

rites.name: Orillausor
rites.text: A shimmering visual aura that can be drawn over a handheld tool in a fictional world. It cannot be bought at the market and was bundled into a special patron's kit.

rites.name: Coriarastia
rites.text: A gateway flare that a traveler can acquire through a merchant's stall for a modest fee. It shimmers with a sickly violet glow when opened.

rites.name: Valles
rites.text: A practitioner sets aside a share of their inner reservoir to sustain an ongoing working, leaving that portion unusable until the working ends. Their regeneration continues at its usual pace, but the reserved share is withheld from their available pool.

rites.name: Oreollanum Coralosor
rites.text: A short-lived state that lets a wanderer slip straight through hostile figures without being stopped. It can be drawn from a carried vial or bestowed by a passing charm, and it leaves no outward shimmer of its own.

rites.name: Amesanum
rites.text: A modern alternate skill effect that can be purchased from a digital storefront for a small price. It changes how an existing ability behaves.

rites.name: Tialles
rites.text: A quiet, enduring talent that a bearer carries as a fixed gift. It is found only through a single crafted vessel or a rare sealed relic that grants random gifts.

rites.name: Vaulliastus
rites.text: A dormant technique of animating the dead through a borrowed outer covering. It is sold as a sealed box of rare sorcerous arts and costs a hefty tribute to acquire.

rites.name: Centiallus
rites.text: A basic passive craft that strengthens explosive snares, making their blasts hit harder and reach across a wider ring of ground.

rites.name: Tiarnalia
rites.text: A shimmering token that reshapes how a hero's abilities appear and behave, sold through a traders' stall. It could also be won from a sealed chest of random rewards.

rites.name: Nesarnor
rites.text: A steadying discipline that turns a wielder's inner reserve of arcane energy into physical protection. It serves as a foundational technique that shapes how every other practice is built.

rites.name: Tellus
rites.text: A binding discipline that lets its bearer sustain one chosen enchantment without drawing on reserves. Only a single such enchantment can hold at any time.

rites.name: Cernum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that sometimes stores spare vigor when a foe falls. The stored surge can later be drawn into strength, swiftness, or resilience.

rites.name: Reostasum
rites.text: A bought cosmetic variation that changes how a skill looks when used. It can be acquired through a paid storefront and was once offered inside a random reward chest.

rites.name: Riaranum
rites.text: A bought trinket that alters how a traveler's skill behaves, granting an unusual variant of an existing technique. It could also be found sealed inside a hidden supply crate.

rites.name: Neornia Ciastor
rites.text: A ghostly trail-mark that a wanderer can buy to leave dark, decaying prints behind their steps. It is sold through a traveling merchant's stall for a modest price.

rites.name: Nentum
rites.text: A purchasable visual overlay that reshapes how a fire spell looks, making it appear like a different spell's flames. It is sold for a modest price in a marketplace of cosmetic extras.

rites.name: Valenastus
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that comes bundled in a costly patron package. That package is no longer offered for sale.

rites.name: Serastillum
rites.text: A lingering radiance that clings to a bearer's protective wards, granted to those who have finished a long run of trials within a proud contest. It reshapes how their guarding auras behave.

rites.name: Nisor
rites.text: A dusk-born burst of fiery momentum that a bearer can call upon as an alternate skill. It can be obtained from a sealed mystery cache priced at a modest sum of points.

rites.name: Amosaullus
rites.text: A passive craft that amplifies the force of decisive blows delivered by buried traps. It is a simple, always-active technique.

rites.name: Velium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate technique that reshapes a warrior's spinning strike into a ring of razor discs. It was once also found sealed inside a mysterious supply crate.

rites.name: Tarnollium
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that surfaces only when a set of gathered stones is fitted into a person's learning map. It takes hold through a marked inscription or a charged clasp.

rites.name: Vaustia
rites.text: A passive craft that is granted only to certain relics bearing a specific charm, or to a sigil holding several randomly chosen gifts. It is treated as a notable and rare ability.

rites.name: Ameoneria
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that adds one more stored charge to a bearer's reserve of power. It works without any deliberate effort from the user.

rites.name: Talleornum
rites.text: A practiced knack that quickens a wanderer's stride and strikes whenever a restorative vial is being drunk. It is taught to those who roam wild lands.

rites.name: Sasenium
rites.text: A keen-edged mastery that resets a blade's innate chance to strike truly, letting nearby foes amplify the blow while their own defenses weaken. Other gifts still stack atop its base.

rites.name: Oreonor
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that sharpens a bearer's strikes and quickens both their blows and their incantations. It also strengthens the body and mind, and lends added force to the followers who serve them.

rites.name: Serornania
rites.text: A basic passive art that quickens how fast hurled explosive charges fly and how swiftly they go off. It is learned as a simple, always-active discipline.

rites.name: Amiantum
rites.text: A short-lived surge of mounting power that a fighter gains from a source, lasting a few moments. It refreshes whenever the source grants it again and grows stronger with boosts that amplify such surges.

rites.name: Tianium Neranum
rites.text: A glowing alternate effect that can be bought from a shop for a set number of points. It was once offered inside a mystery box.

rites.name: Tisanum
rites.text: A practitioner captures a moment of borrowed strength, freezing a set of charms and talents into a still image. They then switch to a different arrangement while keeping the captured benefits active alongside the new ones.

rites.name: Niallus
rites.text: A shimmering cosmetic adornment that alters how a skill appears when used. It can be acquired from a traded marketplace and was once offered inside a seasonal reward chest.

rites.name: Mauranum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that alters how a strike's elemental impact appears. It is sold through a digital storefront for a modest sum of points.

rites.name: Amaleornes
rites.text: A minor cosmetic glow that could be drawn from a sealed chance-box of arcane trinkets. It was offered as one prize among many in that box.

rites.name: Corolium Veseostia
rites.text: A harmful state that leaves a bearer more vulnerable to seeping wounds, which then close up faster than they normally would. It is a condition that worsens the injuries already marking the body.

rites.name: Taulantanum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes a skill into a fiery siege-style burst. It is acquired through a paid marketplace for a modest sum of currency.

rites.name: Coreneontum
rites.text: A radiant shimmer that can be acquired through the marketplace for a modest sum. It clings to a wearer's form as a decorative aura.

rites.name: Siantes
rites.text: A crackling, storm-born affliction that weakens anyone struck by it, lowering the force of their blows for a few brief moments. Its strength rises with the amount of thunder-energy carried in the strike.

rites.name: Veontus Cirium
rites.text: A bound crystal lens that makes a linked incantation ripple outward, repeating its force before and behind the chosen point. Each ripple reaches a little less far and strikes a little less hard.

rites.name: Raustia Meosaurnium
rites.text: A hazardous surface field that leaves those standing upon it more vulnerable, so that every blow they receive lands harder. Only the strongest such charge applies at once, and certain protective gear can shield a wielder from it entirely.

rites.name: Meolum Valialaunes
rites.text: A shimmering purchasable adornment that alters how a chosen ability looks and behaves. It can be bought from a marketplace for a modest sum and was once offered inside a reward chest.

rites.name: Mantia Caulum
rites.text: A stacking blessing that quickens the bearer's strikes and spellwork and swells their stature. Each foe that falls adds another layer to its hold.

rites.name: Liases Nontus
rites.text: A shimmering gateway effect that can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a modest price. It creates a visual portal when opened.

rites.name: Orollia
rites.text: A paid alternate technique that lets a practitioner's craft draw out the vital essence of a foe. It is acquired through a merchant's offering rather than earned through training.

rites.name: Cinia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that sharpens the practitioner's ability to slip past harm and steadily turns a share of their magical strikes into a protective barrier of spirit.

rites.name: Tinoria
rites.text: A bright alternate technique that reshapes how a fiery beam is cast. It is sold through a traders' stall for a modest price of coins.

rites.name: Lirnium Ralum
rites.text: A beneficial zone on the ground that quickens the actions of everyone standing within it. Several such zones overlapping in one place combine their quickening, so a person caught in all of them gains a strong boost.

rites.name: Ameonanum
rites.text: A glowing gateway effect that a traveler can acquire through a merchant's storefront. It was once bundled into a sealed reward chest.

rites.name: Amantirnor
rites.text: A ghostly sway that arises when two distinct essences are blended together. It draws on both sources at once to produce a unique effect.

rites.name: Rinia Serinarus
rites.text: A quiet inner knack that steadily restores a wielder's spiritual reserves and bodily vitality over time. It needs no action to work and simply hums beneath everything else.

rites.name: Valesor
rites.text: A quiet mental discipline that can only surface when gem-like clusters are set into a wanderer's branching path of learning. It is awakened by certain charms that bind it to the mind.

rites.name: Vinantia
rites.text: A crackling bond of storm energy that links two markers together and burns whatever is caught between them. The markers cannot be struck directly, and the bond shares its visual sign with several other afflictions.

rites.name: Coleosia
rites.text: A glowing alternate effect that surrounds a practitioner's aura with a shimmer. It could be obtained from a sealed chest of arcane lots priced at a fixed sum of points.

rites.name: Seontium
rites.text: A modern-era visual flourish that reshapes how a chosen technique appears in battle. It is offered for sale through a cosmetic marketplace.

rites.name: Orenillor
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens the chance of striking true with incantations, and lets the arts bound to it carry an extra measure of stored charge.

rites.name: Telorisia
rites.text: A cosmetic variant that reshapes how a particular barrier of fire appears when it is raised. Adepts can acquire it through a paid marketplace for a modest sum.

rites.name: Vernor Oristeornus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that bolsters a guardian's protective ward and lets part of that ward's strength flow into the power of their spells. It can only be granted by a specific keeper who blesses a chosen charm or relic.

rites.name: Seolles Vaules
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic covering that changes how a summoning ability looks, giving its creations a carved stone appearance. It is bought with a currency paid for by real money.

rites.name: Telornisum
rites.text: A passive discipline for a hardened brawler that amplifies force, reach, and the length of staggering blows for each stored endurance charge. Each successful stagger has a chance to store another charge.

rites.name: Oriasintes
rites.text: A bought modifier that alters how a fighting skill behaves, letting its strikes carry a chilling, glacial edge. It is sold through a paid marketplace.

rites.name: Laustanum Vialium
rites.text: A passive discipline for war-leaders that extends fire-warding bonuses to the defenses against frost and storm. It lets one protective boon ripple across three elemental shields.

rites.name: Saulum
rites.text: A radiant halo effect that wraps around a person's aura, offering a different visual style for their power. It can be obtained from a mystery box costing a set amount of points.

rites.name: Orirnauntus
rites.text: A keystone discipline that lets a bearer wear gear beyond their reach and strips away the innate blessings of their body's inner strengths. Lesser bonuses from those strengths still echo through lingering effects.

rites.name: Linanum
rites.text: A radiant glow that bathes its bearer in light. It was once bundled into a set of gifts meant to support allies.

rites.name: Ceostanum
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that changes how a skill appears when used. It is sold through a digital marketplace for a small fee.

rites.name: Cirnaunium
rites.text: A forbidden incantation that gathers several enormous detonations of scorching fire, scorching every foe caught within its designated area.

rites.name: Telorum Lilum
rites.text: A visual flourish that replaces the usual look of a power, shown as a rippling aquatic burst. It is sold through a traveling merchant's catalog for a modest sum of trade tokens.

rites.name: Corilor
rites.text: A optional alternate effect that can be bought from a shop for a small price. It reshapes how a certain skill behaves once applied.

rites.name: Vianaures
rites.text: A linked support craft that strengthens the harm dealt by hidden snares and buried charges. In return, the practitioner must set and throw them more slowly.

rites.name: Telarnus
rites.text: A passive talent that a wielder can gain through a special gem fitted into a larger cluster of gems. It siphons a small share of magical harm dealt into a protective barrier, and while that barrier is full it boosts spellcasting power and can slow foes struck by spells.

rites.name: Valolus
rites.text: A linked aid that enhances ranged strikes, making each projectile hit harder and leave lingering wounds, though the user must fire more slowly.

rites.name: Mellanum Cisaullium
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets foes who strike the bearer occasionally gain a random surge of stamina, rage, or arcane force, yet forces them to pass those surges along to the bearer.

rites.name: Vaurnontum
rites.text: A forceful close-quarters strike that hits all foes in a small ring around its wielder. Each enemy struck widens the ring, so the blow reaches further with every connection.

rites.name: Ralor Montanum
rites.text: A timed surge of power that quickens the strikes, spells, and steps of its user and nearby companions. It is drawn from a volatile reserve and lasts only briefly.

rites.name: Terarnes
rites.text: A glowing, heat-hardened ward that can be acquired through a paid marketplace and layered onto a second ability. It reshapes how that technique manifests in battle.

rites.name: Orerastes
rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variant that changes how a skill looks when used. It is sold in a digital storefront for a modest price.

rites.name: Serireonus
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a skill behaves when used. It is bought with a fixed sum of points from a marketplace.

rites.name: Mollus
rites.text: A shimmering ghost-barrier skill variant that can be acquired through a paid marketplace for a small fee. It alters how a defensive spirit ward is hurled outward.

rites.name: Cerirnum
rites.text: A gate-opening mark that is granted to those who finish thirty-six trials set by a rival council. It lets its bearer open passages between distant places.

rites.name: Orentanum
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that reshapes how a carried aura behaves. It is sold through a digital storefront for a modest amount of premium currency.

rites.name: Seriallania
rites.text: A bearer's hardships are softened so that lingering hexes weigh less upon them. Steady restorative pulses return a little vitality to the wearer at regular intervals.

rites.name: Tantillanum
rites.text: A lasting inner discipline that sharpens the aim of one's summoned companions, quickening their strikes and their incantations. It also shifts how swiftly those companions move to attack.

rites.name: Amestania
rites.text: A ritual binds mana into two unbreakable clockwork crawlers that sweep the field for hidden snares and set them off. Each crawler radiates a cold or crackling aura, and the snares they fire are reset so they can strike again.

rites.name: Rauniastes
rites.text: A glowing cinder-veil that can be acquired through a paid marketplace, offering a fiery alternate look for a strike technique. It changes how a familiar attack appears when it is unleashed.

rites.name: Vornaustes
rites.text: A shimmering archway effect that a traveler can unlock by spending a single prepaid token on any merchant's wares. The offer was meant to lapse on a set date but still lingers with no end in sight.

rites.name: Orirnontium
rites.text: A keystone discipline that lets a wielder sustain only one lasting enchantment at a time. It demands more of their inner reserve, stops the enchantment from reaching companions, and makes its effects far stronger.

rites.name: Vestiarnus
rites.text: A shimmering gateway adornment that can be acquired through a merchant's stall for a modest sum of tokens. It alters how the passage of travelers appears.

rites.name: Corentium
rites.text: A volatile binding that lets a striker sometimes gather a surge of stored energy when blows land, with a greater chance on ordinary strikes than on decisive ones. It also raises how much such surge a fighter can hold at once.

rites.name: Amollirus
rites.text: A cosmetic variant that alters how a frost-based strike looks when unleashed. It can be bought from a sale catalog and was once a reward from a seasonal chance crate.

rites.name: Lones
rites.text: A glowing gateway shimmer that can be purchased with a small sum of virtual currency. It was once sealed inside a mystery crate.

rites.name: Taranum Oralliantes
rites.text: A minor alternate variant of a movement technique that can be acquired through a paid marketplace. It changes how the technique appears in combat.

rites.name: Ameoniarnum
rites.text: A glowing gateway effect that a traveler can acquire through an in-world exchange for a set price of tokens. It changes how portals appear when someone steps through them.

rites.name: Corostanum Vosteornia
rites.text: A cosmetic footprint trail that a wearer can buy from a shop for a set price. It is made by blending two arcane components together.

rites.name: Vosia Oriasium
rites.text: A cosmetic visual overlay that changes how a summoned storm guardian looks when it strikes. It is sold through a digital marketplace for a small fee.

rites.name: Cantes
rites.text: A purchasable visual flourish that can be applied to a blade, making it appear to drain life from whatever it strikes. It can also be won from a sealed reward crate.

rites.name: Liastarnum
rites.text: A purchasable modifier that alters how a warrior's summoned fury behaves, letting it manifest as a swarm of buzzing sparks. It is bought from a traders' stall for a modest price.

rites.name: Teloseonium
rites.text: A mechanism that fires a practiced technique the instant a chosen condition is met, skipping the usual wind-up motion. Triggered techniques still draw on the wielder's reserves before they can take effect.

rites.name: Oresinum
rites.text: A core passive craft where each piercing strike also drives extra barbs into the foe and nearby foes, though those struck cannot be pierced again for a short while.

rites.name: Teleostolum
rites.text: A spinning whirl of blades that can be attached to a combat technique as an alternate effect. It is sold through a paid marketplace for a set price in premium currency.

rites.name: Telirnia
rites.text: A modified skill enhancement that alters how a deployable explosive behaves. It can be acquired through a paid cosmetic-style marketplace.

rites.name: Virnasanum
