rites.text: A purchasable cosmetic variation that changes how a traveler's swift movement looks. It was once offered as a reward drawn from a sealed frontier chest.

rites.name: Siarnonia
rites.text: A purchasable alternate skill effect that alters how a skill behaves. It can be bought from a shop for a set price in points.

rites.name: Mausum Seornor
rites.text: A shop-bought variant that alters how a skill behaves, sold for a small fee of virtual currency. It changes a skill's effect rather than its core function.

rites.name: Oronillium
rites.text: A protective layer that soaks up incoming harm equal to its strength, breaking after any strike and regrowing after a short pause. Unlike a shimmering barrier, being struck does not delay its renewal, and it blocks every kind of harm.

rites.name: Saurellus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a hovering orb that sends out periodic bursts, striking foes within its reach and dragging them down. Those who fall inside it are pulled into the orb and swallowed whole.

rites.name: Neostinum
rites.text: A dark hold of the mind that grows stronger against harsh forces and slowly drains nearby foes. Those bound by lingering dread strike with feebler, fading blows.

rites.name: Cestum
rites.text: A bound signal lets a wielder flip instantly between two held arrays of blades, bows, guards and bare-hand strikes. It is a quick-change technique for swapping one readied kit for another.

rites.name: Meolliastus
rites.text: A glowing gateway effect that a traveler can acquire through a merchant's stall for a modest sum of tokens. It alters how doorways shimmer when opened.

rites.name: Telanisum
rites.text: A modern alternate technique that reshapes how a volcanic explosive device works when it is set off. It is offered for sale in a digital marketplace at a set price in a points currency.

rites.name: Nasteoria
rites.text: A binding vow that turns a bearer's restorative flow away from the flesh and into their protective aura. Wounds close through the shield rather than the body.

rites.name: Telonaustia
rites.text: A purchasable alternate effect that changes how a certain skill behaves. It is bought from a shop using a set amount of a premium currency.

rites.name: Valaurnus Teliarninum
rites.text: A purchasable enhancement that alters how a combat technique manifests, letting its power take on a shadowed, ancestral form. It is bought with a fixed sum of premium currency.

rites.name: Amantor
rites.text: A pale spinning gust that a fighter can draw out as a secondary technique. It takes the form of a whirling current of light air and serves as an alternate version of a familiar combat art.

rites.name: Riastor
rites.text: A shimmering cosmetic overlay that alters how a skill appears when used. It can be acquired through a paid digital storefront or found within a sealed reward crate.

rites.name: Nanes Corillium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate visual effect that changes how a sustained aura looks. It is a cosmetic option that can be bought from a shop or found in a reward chest.

rites.name: Veollinium
rites.text: A purchasable alternate visual effect that changes how a magical aura appears around its bearer. It can be bought with a set price and was once offered inside a reward chest.

rites.name: Telialornus
rites.text: A passive art that raises the force of elemental strikes. It also lets the bearer pierce deeper through every element's defenses.

rites.name: Mornialanum
rites.text: A cosmic variant of a ground-breaking strike that can be acquired through an in-world exchange for a modest sum of tokens. It alters how the blow lands, turning an ordinary shockwave into a star-scale tremor.

rites.name: Vesezashora
rites.text: Vesezashora is the concept that the ending of Ameosastia splits into three possible futures during the Era of E7, each one catalogued on the shelves of the Library. Within the Mythic Realm it is less a being than a principle, the act by which the Library refuses to pick a single path and instead keeps every branch in view.
